profile_epoch.rationale: Open Research in Depth by establishing which retained mechanisms support reliable endpoint search in the exchange-free L01 Anchor n-c55c3d520a2c. Its complete historical mean is 0.595670 with SD 0.026593; exchange removal gained 0.021326 on all three seed macros but lost four task/seed endpoints and increased dispersion. The original c-402ef46220 exchange grouping contains condition-dependent results: adding exchange under binary L01 in n-9edaa26007c3 gained 0.007397, whereas removing it under the count composition improved the current Anchor; the L16 removal n-cdac02dcd338 changed mean by only -0.000841 and is a contextual boundary, not transferable L01 evidence. Global family navigation separates predictive representation (f-200000000007), posterior allocation (f-100000000002) and graph transformation (f-100000000001), so this round isolates count features, residual influence, residual correlation and crossover rather than conflating them. The frozen catalog composition is reviewed, but its eight current contribution gaps remain experimental gaps. n-ae9cc6c2ca09 leaves correlation utility unresolved after a timeout; n-852bc7be4d7c and n-1faebb978a01 show substantial removal losses only under the earlier exchange-containing Parent; c-cf4ce43a7c contains duplicate count trajectories, not independent confirmation. Select batch size 10 to preserve the established feedback cadence and pool scale and avoid adding a second change while those composition questions are resolved. This is a comparability choice, not evidence that ten is optimal; smaller allowed batches would change feedback frequency and pool size and increase fitting frequency. The actual opening action is the mandatory fresh complete Anchor baseline under the protocol-owned Research in Depth profile. These four portfolio positions record the next contribution wave, to be reconsidered against that baseline before admission. No existing score is promoted to current-profile evidence and no scientific criterion is completed now.

observed_bottleneck.summary: Stalled evaluation budget is not converted into realized incumbent gain, and the campaign has no reference that separates a channel effect from path divergence at the same trigger. About a fifth of this Anchor's announced batches run with no new incumbent best, and round 38 showed that a state trigger can act there without disturbing the Anchor's improving sessions; but of the four channels tested, the two that gained (+0.007648, +0.004664) draw their margin from one cell where unrelated departures from this Anchor usually gain and identify no mediator, while the one directional hypothesis about the regime itself - that it should sample more uncertainty - is refuted with same-pool evidence that the uncertain tail holds worse molecules. The account's stagnation condition fired because round 38's results had not yet been recorded as progress. The open methodological problem is therefore twofold: what to do with measurably unproductive batches, and how to read a thin gated panel delta at all.

About a fifth of this Anchor's announced batches run with no new incumbent best, and round 38 showed that a state trigger can act there without disturbing the Anchor's improving sessions; but of the four channels tested, the two that gained (+0.007648, +0.004664) draw their margin from one cell where unrelated departures from this Anchor usually gain and identify no mediator, while the one directional hypothesis about the regime itself - that it should sample more uncertainty - is refuted with same-pool evidence that the uncertain tail holds worse molecules. The account's stagnation condition fired because round 38's results had not yet been recorded as progress. The open methodological problem is therefore twofold: what to do with measurably unproductive batches, and how to read a thin gated panel delta at all.

combination.compatibility: The two registered elements touch disjoint code paths and share one trigger implementation: the floor-one requested mutation-call law lives in the ordinary single-parent proposal route, the pool target lives in the bounded fresh-pool generation loop, and both read the same integer counter of consecutive non-improving announced batches. Each was verified to activate exactly on this Parent with unexposed sessions byte-identical, neither touches the allocator, the count-GP, identity admission, the sulfur gate, survivors or the breeder, and no value of either element is changed, so the joint recipe needs no new mechanism and no re-derivation.
combination.known_interactions: They are not independent. The extra candidates of the widened pool would themselves be bred under the heavier continuation law, so stalled pools contain both more candidates and candidates further from their generating parents; the unchanged allocator already filters lengthened products (25.7% of the stalled pool against 13.9% of emissions in n-e5dba2059cfe), which can absorb part of either effect. Generation cost compounds, because four times as many candidates each request more edits, and must fit the frozen task and node timeouts. On the thirteen cells a K=3 gate can change the single arms are +0.008824 and +0.005381, and Curate forbids reading those as additive.
combination.predicted_behavior: Both activation audits reproduce: stalled floor-one optional-call share near 0.50 against a same-draw replay near 0.18, stalled pool target 640 with no truncated pool, roughly 86 to 96 exposed announced batches in 13 of 15 sessions, unchanged behaviour outside the regime and the two never-stalling deco_hop sessions byte-identical. combination.validation: Complete matched three-seed fifteen-cell panel against n-1744a1494180 with every task/seed sign and dispersion, both activation audits against same-draw replays, the divergence-index audit against the Anchor's published trajectories, generation-cost, retry, saturation and timeout receipts, leave-one-cell sensitivity and the thirteen-cell restriction reported separately, and the joint delta read against the round-39 path-divergence reference arm. sources.applicability: The Anchor already has the population of 64, the seven mutation families, two-parent connected-fragment crossover and score-quantile (rank-like) parent sampling; what it lacks is the corpus-pretrained sequence policy as a proposal source. Only the prior and the alternation of policy-generated with GA-generated candidates are adopted now. The trajectory-balance update, KL coefficient, reward temperature and replay training are deferred to a reserved follow-up because this profile allows 300 accepted observations per task, and the inherited GP allocation, not the policy, chooses what is evaluated.
sources.finding: A GRU SMILES policy pretrained by maximum likelihood on an unlabeled corpus (ZINC 250K, reusing the PMO REINVENT prior) is combined each round with Graph-GA crossover and seven SMARTS mutations over a rank-selected population of 64; policy samples and GA offspring both go to the oracle and into one buffer, and the policy is then updated for eight loops per round by a trajectory-balance loss with a KL penalty toward the pretrained prior on rank-weighted replay batches (weight proportional to (k|D| + rank)^-1). The authors report state-of-the-art sample efficiency on the PMO benchmark at 10,000 oracle calls, and 1,000 evaluations in their multi-objective study.
sources.title: Genetic-guided GFlowNets for Sample Efficient Molecular Optimization (NeurIPS 2024)

sources.applicability: The unlabeled corpus supplied to prepare is that training set (data/guacamol_v1_train.smiles, 1,273,104 lines, 1,272,851 unique molecules, canonical sha256 deb87923...). Training the prior there uses no oracle label, no benchmark answer and no retrieval, and keeps the prior inside the campaign's unlabeled-preparation contract. The paper's own leaderboard scores use a different budget and scoring and are not campaign evidence.
sources.finding: Defines this benchmark suite and its standardized ChEMBL-derived training set of about 1.27M SMILES, and evaluates goal-directed baselines in which a SMILES LSTM prior trained on exactly that corpus is among the strongest, together with graph genetic baselines.
sources.title: GuacaMol: Benchmarking Models for De Novo Molecular Design (Brown, Fiscato, Segler, Vaucher)

sources.applicability: Score reuse and augmentation are the natural first reserved follow-up if the frozen prior's proposals are admitted but rarely selected, since they are the cheapest way to move a policy with very few labels. They are not adopted in this first node because they require a training loop over this session's 300 accepted observations and would confound the proposal-source question with an online learning question.
sources.finding: Combines experience replay with SMILES randomization so that one set of oracle scores updates the generative model several times, which the authors report as the source of its sample efficiency and as state of the art on the PMO benchmark, beating the previous best on 19 of 23 tasks in the preprint version.
sources.title: Augmented Memory: Sample-Efficient Generative Molecular Design with Reinforcement Learning (JACS Au 2024, doi 10.1021/jacsau.4c00066; arXiv preprint)

sources.applicability: Its 1,000-call budget is still more than three times this profile's 300 accepted observations per task, which is the reason the policy-training elements are deferred and only the corpus prior enters now. Its architecture change is not adopted: the campaign's own receipts show a 2-layer GRU prior trains on the supplied corpus in 240 s, and the sequence architecture is not the question this round asks.
sources.finding: Builds on Augmented Memory with a Mamba sequence policy and reports its first experiment under a 1,000-oracle budget with threshold-based hit metrics, and comparisons against the PMO suite of 25 models on 23 tasks.
sources.title: Saturn: Sample-efficient Generative Molecular Design using Memory Manipulation (NeurIPS 2024 workshop)

sources.applicability: Sets the comparison discipline for this round - a method is judged under a fixed budget, not at convergence - but supplies no transferable number: this campaign scores the final Top-1 on five frozen tasks at 300 accepted observations with three seeds, so no PMO ranking is evidence for or against this Parent.
sources.finding: Evaluates 25 molecular optimization methods on 23 oracles under a 10,000-call budget with the AUC of the top-10 mean, and finds that many newer methods do not beat their predecessors once the oracle budget is limited, so sample efficiency rather than unconstrained best score is the discriminating metric.
sources.title: Sample Efficiency Matters: A Benchmark for Practical Molecular Optimization (PMO, NeurIPS 2022 Datasets and Benchmarks)

conditions: Code Parent is the new formal Anchor n-61b9b3bfb40d (stall-conditioned top-forty eligibility over the inherited correlated Thompson allocation, K=3, M=40 of 160, full mask restored on the first improving batch); its own receipts and ten-hunk diff must be read before the intent is bound.

Research in Depth epoch 1, the protocol-issued complete Search panel: seeds 0/1/2, the five frozen independent tasks, 300 accepted observations per task including ten initial records, announced batches of ten, unchanged scoring, resources, timeouts and oracle budget.

Task-agnostic and offline: only this session's chronological accepted real observations and freshly generated de novo molecular graphs. No task identity, no absolute score level, no cross-task or cross-session state, no benchmark answer, no equivalent oracle, no finite-library screening or retrieval, no runtime network.

Niche features are molecular properties computed from the graph alone - never an absolute score level, a task-dependent quantity or a cross-session statistic - and the accepted incumbent is always retained, so the arm cannot lose the best record.

Breeding, score-quantile parent sampling (0.1/0.25/0.5 edges at weights 0.6/0.3/0.1), the seven operator families, the connected-fragment crossover, the continuation law, the allocator and the mask stay byte-identical; only survivor membership changes.

The published source's measured advantage is efficiency, success ratio and diversity with an explicit tie on maximum-median-molecule benchmarks, and its numbers are 100-run rediscovery statistics at another budget; they are context, never campaign evidence, and median_2 is not expected to carry this arm's effect.

candidate_methods.method: Motif-granularity proposal operator with an offline corpus-mined substructure vocabulary
required_elements: A substructure vocabulary extracted during prepare from the permitted unlabeled corpus only, with substructures taken as single rings or ring systems and frequent multi-atom groups above one declared frequency threshold, following DST's atom-or-ring definition and frequency-threshold construction; no runtime retrieval, no finite-library screening and no corpus molecule entering a pool, a population or an evaluation.

Motif-level moves that attach, exchange or replace a whole ring system or functional group in one accepted operation, with explicit attachment-point resolution following the enumeration rule DST takes from JT-VAE (an atom may attach at any eligible ring atom; two rings join by a bond or by sharing two atoms and one bond; spiro-type products excluded), and the inherited valence, identity, duplicate and sulfur admission path applied to every product.

MoLeR's mixed granularity: the inherited seven atom- and bond-local operators and the connected-fragment crossover are retained as the fallback and the motif move is added with one declared probability, so the arm is a repertoire extension and not a replacement of measured-positive components.

The vocabulary must stay objective-blind: unlike GenMol's property-scored, dynamically updated fragment vocabulary, no accepted score level, task identity or oracle feedback may enter vocabulary construction or motif choice.

Pre-registered structural observables that distinguish this from the refuted refinement stage: the share of accepted products whose Murcko framework changes, the heavy-atom change distribution, the count of accepted moves installing a complete ring system, and the admission and selection rates of motif products against the single-atom path - the quantities h-ac59f26982d33138 shows the current repertoire cannot move.

sources.applicability: This is the only source that states a complete, implementable recipe for the two parts our approach lists as the hard ones: an offline frequency-thresholded vocabulary and an explicit attachment-enumeration rule. Both are corpus-only and run in prepare, so they fit the frozen offline, task-agnostic profile. Nothing else is adopted: the differentiable scaffolding tree, the GNN knowledge network and the protocol of 10K-20K precomputed labels plus 5K online calls are incompatible with 300 accepted observations per task and with the rule that no corpus molecule may enter a pool or an evaluation, and its reported single- and multi-objective results are on different tasks and budgets and transfer no effect size.
sources.finding: Defines a substructure vocabulary where a substructure is either a single atom or a single ring, mined by decomposing a corpus (ZINC250k) and keeping substructures that occur more than 1000 times, which yields 82 substructures including frequent atoms and frequent rings such as benzene; edits a scaffolding tree with SHRINK, REPLACE and EXPAND at leaf nodes and EXPAND or nothing elsewhere; and assembles a tree into molecules by enumerating chemically valid attachments after JT-VAE, where an atom may connect to any ring atom and two rings join either by a bond or by sharing two atoms and one bond, with spiro and phenalene-like products unsupported.
sources.title: Differentiable Scaffolding Tree for Molecule Optimization (DST)

sources.applicability: Supplies the principle our structural limitation names - a move whose unit is a whole ring system or group, with attachment resolution as an explicit step rather than an afterthought - and it is the recorded root cause of why the round-43 refinement stage could only re-decorate (the winning edit was a single-atom change in 9,830 of 12,181 replacements and no refined output assembled a new ring system). The hierarchical encoder-decoder itself is not adopted; we add one operator to an existing graph-evolution loop.
sources.finding: Builds molecules from larger, more flexible motifs instead of atoms or small substructures: the decoder adds one motif at a time and interleaves motif selection with resolving that motif's attachments, because atom-by-atom generators degrade on larger molecules.
sources.title: Hierarchical Generation of Molecular Graphs using Structural Motifs (HierVAE)

sources.applicability: Gives the exact shape this arm needs: mixed granularity, with the inherited single-atom and bond operators retained as the fallback and the motif move conditioned on an already admitted molecule. That matters here because both previous coarse-chemistry attempts on this lineage replaced the operator set and lost (-0.044214, -0.094793). Its pretrained model, its corpus and its sampling cost inside a per-slot budget are not adopted and its reported benchmark position is not campaign evidence.
sources.finding: Mixes atom-by-atom and motif-by-motif generation with motifs discovered from the training data, decomposes an input molecule into motifs and single atoms, conditions each decoder step only on the encoder output and the partial graph so generation can start from a fixed scaffold, and reports comparable results on unconstrained optimization with better results on scaffold-based tasks and an order of magnitude faster training and sampling.
sources.title: Learning to Extend Molecular Scaffolds with Structural Motifs (MoLeR)

sources.applicability: This is the only direct, matched-budget comparison I found between a fragment-level and an atom- or token-level edit inside one optimizer, and it points the same way as our own diagnosis. Its honest bound is that the margin is about +0.12 of sum AUC over 23 tasks, so it supports the direction of the operator change and supplies no transferable effect size for a three-seed, five-task, 300-call panel. Its pretrained discrete diffusion model, its SAFE sequence machinery and its property-scored dynamic vocabulary are not adopted: a property-scored vocabulary would read accepted score levels into the generator, which this profile forbids, so our vocabulary stays frequency-based and objective-blind.
sources.finding: Treats fragment remasking - replacing one fragment of a molecule and regenerating it - explicitly as the mutation operation of a genetic algorithm over a fragment vocabulary that is scored by the average property of the molecules containing each fragment, kept at the top 100 and dynamically updated. On the PMO benchmark it reports sum AUC top-10 of 18.362 against Mol GA 14.708 and Graph GA 13.751, and its own ablation gives attaching only 17.641, attaching plus token remasking 18.091 and attaching plus fragment remasking 18.208, with the stated reason that each token of a SAFE or SMILES sequence represents a single atom or bond.
sources.title: GenMol: A Drug Discovery Generalist with Discrete Diffusion

sources.applicability: A caution rather than a mechanism, and the reason both literature positions this round are registered as bounded repertoire or model changes with their own structural audits instead of expected wins: published rank does not survive a budget change, and our budget is 300 calls per task, thirty times smaller than the one in which these rankings were measured. It also records that assembly granularity is one of the few factors that does matter, which is why the operator-path experiment is worth its position.
sources.finding: Evaluates 25 molecular design algorithms on 23 single-objective tasks with a focus on sample efficiency and reports that most state-of-the-art methods fail to outperform their predecessors under a limited oracle budget allowing 10K queries, analysing the optimizer, the molecular assembly strategy and the oracle landscape as the factors that matter.
sources.title: Sample Efficiency Matters: A Benchmark for Practical Molecular Optimization (PMO)

sources.applicability: This is our recorded defect stated as a model property: the mechanism that makes predictive variance depend on where the input sits, rather than on how many predictive means the model has - which is exactly what the round-44 mixture failed to deliver (far/near SD ratio below the single GP in 435 of 435 batches, because fixed per-component amplitudes leave mean disagreement as the only new variance and that is largest near the archive). We adopt only the input-dependent signal-amplitude principle as one bounded deterministic warp of the archive distance the selector already computes. The Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and MAP inference of latent amplitude and lengthscale processes is explicitly not adopted: at 300 accepted observations in ten-member batches it is neither affordable nor identifiable, and the paper's regression experiments carry no effect size for this panel.
sources.finding: Makes the signal variance and the lengthscale explicit functions of the input, with separate Gaussian process priors on their logarithms to keep them positive, and infers them by Hamiltonian Monte Carlo with a gradient-ascent MAP alternative; the authors state it is the first model to combine heteroscedastic noise, a non-stationary lengthscale and an input-varying signal variance.
sources.title: Non-Stationary Gaussian Process Regression with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo

sources.applicability: Used as a reference that input-dependent kernel parameters are a known and separable design choice, not as an adoptable mechanism: training a network to set kernel parameters from 300 accepted labels per session is outside this profile and would confound the one quantity the position is built to move. It is cited to bound the claim that our warp is one point in a known design space rather than a novel model.
sources.finding: Reviews the non-stationary kernel literature and proposes a framework in which a deep neural network predicts the lengthscale and noise variance as functions of the test input, so the covariance structure itself is input-dependent rather than globally fitted.
sources.title: Deep Gaussian Covariance Network

sources.applicability: Carried forward from the frozen round-44 review as the basis of the route this round ends, and reported here only to record what the campaign now knows: the construction ran exactly on this Anchor (230 of 435 batches with two or more multi-member components, zero posterior fallbacks, 20 of 20 Gibbs sweeps per batch) and was refuted at its registered calibration-direction clause with a panel of -0.136643, and Curate recorded the structural reason why no bounded variant of fixed-kernel components can produce archive-distance-growing uncertainty. Its membership-mass weight rule remains the leading untested suspect for the magnitude of that loss and is listed below as a deliberately deferred method, not as a position.
sources.finding: Replaces a single Gaussian process by a Dirichlet-process mixture whose latent regimes are inferred online by collapsed Gibbs sampling with an adaptive concentration schedule, gives each regime its own hyperparameters, and splits acquisition uncertainty into intra-regime and inter-regime parts, reporting gains on synthetic tasks, molecular conformer optimization and virtual screening.
sources.title: Regime-Adaptive Bayesian Optimization via Dirichlet Process Mixtures of Gaussian Processes (RAMBO)

r0045-01-improve-L01.question: Does a covariance whose prior variance grows with archive distance actually produce comparable cross-chemotype uncertainty on this Anchor at 300 observations, and does that uncertainty convert into realized incumbent increments rather than into broader activity?
r0045-01-improve-L01.rationale: h-95936ff259407586 names the binding object precisely and round 44 is the measurement that moved it: giving the model several predictive locations and scales did not make its uncertainty grow where its knowledge stops. In n-1c27fae8e61d the archive-far to archive-near predictive SD ratio fell below the passive single GP's in 435 of 435 batches (mean 1.3942 against 1.7477) and the inter-regime share of predictive variance was higher in the archive-near half in 15 of 15 sessions, with the recorded structural reason: with each component's kernel amplitude and lengthscale held at the inherited values the only new variance term is disagreement between component means, which is largest where components overlap - near the archive. h-4dd9850598959272 therefore states the untested requirement as a change to the covariance: per-regime amplitude or lengthscale, an explicit distance-dependent prior variance, an ensemble, a deep kernel or a conformal interval. The question this serves is not new and the cheap remedies are closed with receipts: forcing the allocator to buy distant candidates failed twice (n-df6911ea1fe2 reserved 870 of 870 picks and converted at parent-beat 0.0989 against free picks 0.1552; n-82195b802723 converted at 0.000503 per evaluation against the near half's 0.001243 while the inherited rule's own far-half choices converted best at 0.001767), so the ranking-override class is refuted on two Parents (h-b2785e70f134cc20, h-8f75b2df9443d3af) and the model is the only remaining object. The decisive purchase of n-df6911ea1fe2 was under-predicted by 0.271 at a posterior SD of 0.013, which is the same defect stated as a calibration failure rather than an allocation failure, and no parameter of the present selector addresses it - which is why this is a model change with an external basis rather than an internal refinement.

candidate_methods.method: Motif-granularity proposal operator with an offline corpus-mined substructure vocabulary
required_elements: A substructure vocabulary extracted during prepare from the permitted unlabeled corpus only, with substructures taken as single rings or ring systems and frequent multi-atom groups above one declared frequency threshold, following DST's atom-or-ring definition and frequency-threshold construction; no runtime retrieval, no finite-library screening and no corpus molecule entering a pool, a population or an evaluation.

Motif-level moves that attach, exchange or replace a whole ring system or functional group in one accepted operation, with explicit attachment-point resolution following the enumeration rule DST takes from JT-VAE (an atom may attach at any eligible ring atom; two rings join by a bond or by sharing two atoms and one bond; spiro-type products excluded), and the inherited valence, identity, duplicate and sulfur admission path applied to every product.

MoLeR's mixed granularity: the inherited seven atom- and bond-local operators and the connected-fragment crossover are retained as the fallback and the motif move is added with one declared probability, so the arm is a repertoire extension and not a replacement of measured-positive components.

The vocabulary must stay objective-blind: unlike GenMol's property-scored, dynamically updated fragment vocabulary, no accepted score level, task identity or oracle feedback may enter vocabulary construction or motif choice.

Pre-registered structural observables that distinguish this from the refuted refinement stage: the share of accepted products whose Murcko framework changes, the heavy-atom change distribution, the count of accepted moves installing a complete ring system, and the admission and selection rates of motif products against the single-atom path - the quantities h-ac59f26982d33138 shows the current repertoire cannot move.

candidate_methods.method: Archive-distance-dependent prior variance for the accepted-only similarity-kernel GP (non-stationary input-dependent signal amplitude)
required_elements: The signal variance becomes an explicit function of the input, following Heinonen's input-varying signal amplitude, rather than a globally fitted constant: the prior variance of a candidate increases with its distance from this session's own accepted archive under the similarity the selector already computes.

One bounded deterministic warp with one declared form and one declared scale, with no latent amplitude process, no Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and no auxiliary network, because 300 accepted observations in ten-member batches identify none of them.

The mean structure and every measured-positive consumer are preserved exactly: the kernel's similarity form, the adaptive normalization, the noise SD, the Cholesky jitter ladder and the sampled-residual correlated Thompson draw with its sequential masks and first-index ties.

The registered calibration reading precedes the endpoint: an oracle-free ablated-cluster split of the session's own accepted archive plus the archive-far to archive-near predictive SD ratio, which must rise above the inherited single GP's 1.7477 rather than fall as the refuted mixture's 1.3942 did.
The recorded negative control stands: a calibration improvement without a rise in realized incumbent-increment mass above the Anchor's 5.978073 refutes the premise and is reported as such.

candidate_methods.method: Mixture weight driven by the probability of containing the maximizer (deferred)
required_elements: Replace the adopted spatial weight proportional to membership mass over component predictive SD by a weight reflecting the probability that a component contains the maximizer, which Curate identifies as the leading untested suspect for the magnitude of the round-44 loss (the passive single GP's own top-ten candidates were marked down 0.048 to 0.236 score units in every non-degenerate session against a whole-pool shift of -0.075 to +0.020).

Deferred this round with a reason rather than scheduled: even a corrected weight cannot deliver archive-distance-growing uncertainty, because the recorded structural bound is the fixed per-component kernel, so this would diagnose the loss of a refuted construction instead of answering the open calibration question that position 2 addresses.

observed_bottleneck.summary: Window 3's first batch produced four complete, exactly-audited nodes and no matched gain: the best of them is the Anchor's own byte-identical reproduction at 0.000000, and the three that changed something lost (-0.136643 predictor replacement, -0.047213 retention replacement, -0.000562 eligibility release). Two hypothesis classes closed with receipts and one axis closed in both directions, and the campaign's own diagnoses now converge on one class it has never tested on this Anchor: the granularity of the proposal moves and the admission path those moves pass through. Three of four round-44 Analyze reports and all four molecular reviews name move granularity independently, the capability gap is a source-level property of the Anchor's own operator receipt, and round 44 removed the two competing explanations - the selection rule and the population. The second, cheaper half of the bottleneck is measurement: there is still no law-free reference drawn on this Anchor, so every panel in this window borrows a band from a different Parent, and the Anchor carries two fragile high cells that every stream-perturbing arm starts from a deficit on.

sources.applicability: This is the only source that states a complete, implementable recipe for the two parts our approach lists as the hard ones: an offline frequency-thresholded vocabulary and an explicit attachment-enumeration rule. Both are corpus-only and run in prepare, so they fit the frozen offline, task-agnostic profile. Nothing else is adopted: the differentiable scaffolding tree, the GNN knowledge network and the protocol of 10K-20K precomputed labels plus 5K online calls are incompatible with 300 accepted observations per task and with the rule that no corpus molecule may enter a pool or an evaluation, and its reported single- and multi-objective results are on different tasks and budgets and transfer no effect size.
sources.finding: Defines a substructure vocabulary where a substructure is either a single atom or a single ring, mined by decomposing a corpus (ZINC250k) and keeping substructures that occur more than 1000 times, which yields 82 substructures including frequent atoms and frequent rings such as benzene; edits a scaffolding tree with SHRINK, REPLACE and EXPAND at leaf nodes and EXPAND or nothing elsewhere; and assembles a tree into molecules by enumerating chemically valid attachments after JT-VAE, where an atom may connect to any ring atom and two rings join either by a bond or by sharing two atoms and one bond, with spiro and phenalene-like products unsupported.
sources.title: Differentiable Scaffolding Tree for Molecule Optimization (DST)

sources.applicability: Supplies the principle our structural limitation names - a move whose unit is a whole ring system or group, with attachment resolution as an explicit step rather than an afterthought - and it is the recorded root cause of why the round-43 refinement stage could only re-decorate (the winning edit was a single-atom change in 9,830 of 12,181 replacements and no refined output assembled a new ring system). The hierarchical encoder-decoder itself is not adopted; we add one operator to an existing graph-evolution loop.
sources.finding: Builds molecules from larger, more flexible motifs instead of atoms or small substructures: the decoder adds one motif at a time and interleaves motif selection with resolving that motif's attachments, because atom-by-atom generators degrade on larger molecules.
sources.title: Hierarchical Generation of Molecular Graphs using Structural Motifs (HierVAE)

sources.applicability: Gives the exact shape this arm needs: mixed granularity, with the inherited single-atom and bond operators retained as the fallback and the motif move conditioned on an already admitted molecule. That matters here because both previous coarse-chemistry attempts on this lineage replaced the operator set and lost (-0.044214, -0.094793). Its pretrained model, its corpus and its sampling cost inside a per-slot budget are not adopted and its reported benchmark position is not campaign evidence.
sources.finding: Mixes atom-by-atom and motif-by-motif generation with motifs discovered from the training data, decomposes an input molecule into motifs and single atoms, conditions each decoder step only on the encoder output and the partial graph so generation can start from a fixed scaffold, and reports comparable results on unconstrained optimization with better results on scaffold-based tasks and an order of magnitude faster training and sampling.
sources.title: Learning to Extend Molecular Scaffolds with Structural Motifs (MoLeR)

sources.applicability: This is the only direct, matched-budget comparison I found between a fragment-level and an atom- or token-level edit inside one optimizer, and it points the same way as our own diagnosis. Its honest bound is that the margin is about +0.12 of sum AUC over 23 tasks, so it supports the direction of the operator change and supplies no transferable effect size for a three-seed, five-task, 300-call panel. Its pretrained discrete diffusion model, its SAFE sequence machinery and its property-scored dynamic vocabulary are not adopted: a property-scored vocabulary would read accepted score levels into the generator, which this profile forbids, so our vocabulary stays frequency-based and objective-blind.
sources.finding: Treats fragment remasking - replacing one fragment of a molecule and regenerating it - explicitly as the mutation operation of a genetic algorithm over a fragment vocabulary that is scored by the average property of the molecules containing each fragment, kept at the top 100 and dynamically updated. On the PMO benchmark it reports sum AUC top-10 of 18.362 against Mol GA 14.708 and Graph GA 13.751, and its own ablation gives attaching only 17.641, attaching plus token remasking 18.091 and attaching plus fragment remasking 18.208, with the stated reason that each token of a SAFE or SMILES sequence represents a single atom or bond.
sources.title: GenMol: A Drug Discovery Generalist with Discrete Diffusion

sources.applicability: A caution rather than a mechanism, and the reason both literature positions this round are registered as bounded repertoire or model changes with their own structural audits instead of expected wins: published rank does not survive a budget change, and our budget is 300 calls per task, thirty times smaller than the one in which these rankings were measured. It also records that assembly granularity is one of the few factors that does matter, which is why the operator-path experiment is worth its position.
sources.finding: Evaluates 25 molecular design algorithms on 23 single-objective tasks with a focus on sample efficiency and reports that most state-of-the-art methods fail to outperform their predecessors under a limited oracle budget allowing 10K queries, analysing the optimizer, the molecular assembly strategy and the oracle landscape as the factors that matter.
sources.title: Sample Efficiency Matters: A Benchmark for Practical Molecular Optimization (PMO)

sources.applicability: This is our recorded defect stated as a model property: the mechanism that makes predictive variance depend on where the input sits, rather than on how many predictive means the model has - which is exactly what the round-44 mixture failed to deliver (far/near SD ratio below the single GP in 435 of 435 batches, because fixed per-component amplitudes leave mean disagreement as the only new variance and that is largest near the archive). We adopt only the input-dependent signal-amplitude principle as one bounded deterministic warp of the archive distance the selector already computes. The Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and MAP inference of latent amplitude and lengthscale processes is explicitly not adopted: at 300 accepted observations in ten-member batches it is neither affordable nor identifiable, and the paper's regression experiments carry no effect size for this panel.
sources.finding: Makes the signal variance and the lengthscale explicit functions of the input, with separate Gaussian process priors on their logarithms to keep them positive, and infers them by Hamiltonian Monte Carlo with a gradient-ascent MAP alternative; the authors state it is the first model to combine heteroscedastic noise, a non-stationary lengthscale and an input-varying signal variance.
sources.title: Non-Stationary Gaussian Process Regression with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo

sources.applicability: Used as a reference that input-dependent kernel parameters are a known and separable design choice, not as an adoptable mechanism: training a network to set kernel parameters from 300 accepted labels per session is outside this profile and would confound the one quantity the position is built to move. It is cited to bound the claim that our warp is one point in a known design space rather than a novel model.
sources.finding: Reviews the non-stationary kernel literature and proposes a framework in which a deep neural network predicts the lengthscale and noise variance as functions of the test input, so the covariance structure itself is input-dependent rather than globally fitted.
sources.title: Deep Gaussian Covariance Network

sources.applicability: Carried forward from the frozen round-44 review as the basis of the route this round ends, and reported here only to record what the campaign now knows: the construction ran exactly on this Anchor (230 of 435 batches with two or more multi-member components, zero posterior fallbacks, 20 of 20 Gibbs sweeps per batch) and was refuted at its registered calibration-direction clause with a panel of -0.136643, and Curate recorded the structural reason why no bounded variant of fixed-kernel components can produce archive-distance-growing uncertainty. Its membership-mass weight rule remains the leading untested suspect for the magnitude of that loss and is listed below as a deliberately deferred method, not as a position.
sources.finding: Replaces a single Gaussian process by a Dirichlet-process mixture whose latent regimes are inferred online by collapsed Gibbs sampling with an adaptive concentration schedule, gives each regime its own hyperparameters, and splits acquisition uncertainty into intra-regime and inter-regime parts, reporting gains on synthetic tasks, molecular conformer optimization and virtual screening.
sources.title: Regime-Adaptive Bayesian Optimization via Dirichlet Process Mixtures of Gaussian Processes (RAMBO)

Research in Depth epoch 1 at suggestion batch ten, the protocol-issued complete Search panel: seeds 0/1/2, the five frozen independent tasks, 300 accepted observations per task including ten initial records, unchanged scoring, resources, timeouts and oracle budget.

Task-agnostic and offline: only this session's chronological accepted real observations and freshly generated de novo molecular graphs. No task identity, no absolute score level, no cross-task or cross-session state, no benchmark answer, no equivalent oracle, no finite-library screening or retrieval, no runtime network.

This is a GuacaMol-style benchmark panel, not a real biological problem: every molecular reading is a generator property and never a claim about a real target, and the objectives do not price chemical viability (h-0df1b8bbf732f363), so no viability argument is offered as a score mechanism.

Running it in the same batch is deliberate: both land at the same close, where Curate can read the ungated arms against an Anchor-local reference for the first time instead of a borrowed one.

r0045-02-ablation-L01.rationale: h-122694bed089edde records that nothing on this Anchor answers either question and that every round-44 reading borrowed: all four panels were compared with references drawn on the mask-free Parent n-1744a1494180 (ungated n-1c2f17550a3e at -0.009888 with half-width 0.040983, gated n-47993ce5d053 at -0.001735 and n-843b25e73dee at +0.007747), and each Analyze report flagged the same caveat. The cost of borrowing is now concrete rather than formal: four of this Anchor's nine remaining contribution gaps have losses that sit inside the borrowed band (optional continuation -0.030700, count multiplicity -0.038795, residual correlation -0.050545, connected-fragment crossover -0.043640; h-89a135599fc573a6), and the two arms this round that perturb the stream will be read against the same borrowed number unless this node exists. The second half is equally concrete: Curate recomputed every recorded replica of the campaign and found the Anchor's sitagliptin_mpo seed-0 cell (0.765861) is the highest of 220 recorded nodes on that task and its deco_hop seed-0 cell (0.856148) is the realization 35 of 35 ungated descendants of the previous Anchor failed to reproduce, preserved only by arms that do not perturb the pre-stall stream (h-bb8ae058145d3a26, h-3afdd155d964d354). One node settles both: the design is already validated twice on this lineage (n-1c2f17550a3e ungated, n-47993ce5d053 gated), it changes no law, and the measurement is informative whichever sign it takes.

sources.applicability: This is the only source that states a complete, implementable recipe for the two parts our approach lists as the hard ones: an offline frequency-thresholded vocabulary and an explicit attachment-enumeration rule. Both are corpus-only and run in prepare, so they fit the frozen offline, task-agnostic profile. Nothing else is adopted: the differentiable scaffolding tree, the GNN knowledge network and the protocol of 10K-20K precomputed labels plus 5K online calls are incompatible with 300 accepted observations per task and with the rule that no corpus molecule may enter a pool or an evaluation, and its reported single- and multi-objective results are on different tasks and budgets and transfer no effect size.
sources.finding: Defines a substructure vocabulary where a substructure is either a single atom or a single ring, mined by decomposing a corpus (ZINC250k) and keeping substructures that occur more than 1000 times, which yields 82 substructures including frequent atoms and frequent rings such as benzene; edits a scaffolding tree with SHRINK, REPLACE and EXPAND at leaf nodes and EXPAND or nothing elsewhere; and assembles a tree into molecules by enumerating chemically valid attachments after JT-VAE, where an atom may connect to any ring atom and two rings join either by a bond or by sharing two atoms and one bond, with spiro and phenalene-like products unsupported.
sources.title: Differentiable Scaffolding Tree for Molecule Optimization (DST)

sources.applicability: Supplies the principle our structural limitation names - a move whose unit is a whole ring system or group, with attachment resolution as an explicit step rather than an afterthought - and it is the recorded root cause of why the round-43 refinement stage could only re-decorate (the winning edit was a single-atom change in 9,830 of 12,181 replacements and no refined output assembled a new ring system). The hierarchical encoder-decoder itself is not adopted; we add one operator to an existing graph-evolution loop.
sources.finding: Builds molecules from larger, more flexible motifs instead of atoms or small substructures: the decoder adds one motif at a time and interleaves motif selection with resolving that motif's attachments, because atom-by-atom generators degrade on larger molecules.
sources.title: Hierarchical Generation of Molecular Graphs using Structural Motifs (HierVAE)

sources.applicability: Gives the exact shape this arm needs: mixed granularity, with the inherited single-atom and bond operators retained as the fallback and the motif move conditioned on an already admitted molecule. That matters here because both previous coarse-chemistry attempts on this lineage replaced the operator set and lost (-0.044214, -0.094793). Its pretrained model, its corpus and its sampling cost inside a per-slot budget are not adopted and its reported benchmark position is not campaign evidence.
sources.finding: Mixes atom-by-atom and motif-by-motif generation with motifs discovered from the training data, decomposes an input molecule into motifs and single atoms, conditions each decoder step only on the encoder output and the partial graph so generation can start from a fixed scaffold, and reports comparable results on unconstrained optimization with better results on scaffold-based tasks and an order of magnitude faster training and sampling.
sources.title: Learning to Extend Molecular Scaffolds with Structural Motifs (MoLeR)

sources.applicability: This is the only direct, matched-budget comparison I found between a fragment-level and an atom- or token-level edit inside one optimizer, and it points the same way as our own diagnosis. Its honest bound is that the margin is about +0.12 of sum AUC over 23 tasks, so it supports the direction of the operator change and supplies no transferable effect size for a three-seed, five-task, 300-call panel. Its pretrained discrete diffusion model, its SAFE sequence machinery and its property-scored dynamic vocabulary are not adopted: a property-scored vocabulary would read accepted score levels into the generator, which this profile forbids, so our vocabulary stays frequency-based and objective-blind.
sources.finding: Treats fragment remasking - replacing one fragment of a molecule and regenerating it - explicitly as the mutation operation of a genetic algorithm over a fragment vocabulary that is scored by the average property of the molecules containing each fragment, kept at the top 100 and dynamically updated. On the PMO benchmark it reports sum AUC top-10 of 18.362 against Mol GA 14.708 and Graph GA 13.751, and its own ablation gives attaching only 17.641, attaching plus token remasking 18.091 and attaching plus fragment remasking 18.208, with the stated reason that each token of a SAFE or SMILES sequence represents a single atom or bond.
sources.title: GenMol: A Drug Discovery Generalist with Discrete Diffusion

sources.applicability: A caution rather than a mechanism, and the reason both literature positions this round are registered as bounded repertoire or model changes with their own structural audits instead of expected wins: published rank does not survive a budget change, and our budget is 300 calls per task, thirty times smaller than the one in which these rankings were measured. It also records that assembly granularity is one of the few factors that does matter, which is why the operator-path experiment is worth its position.
sources.finding: Evaluates 25 molecular design algorithms on 23 single-objective tasks with a focus on sample efficiency and reports that most state-of-the-art methods fail to outperform their predecessors under a limited oracle budget allowing 10K queries, analysing the optimizer, the molecular assembly strategy and the oracle landscape as the factors that matter.
sources.title: Sample Efficiency Matters: A Benchmark for Practical Molecular Optimization (PMO)

sources.applicability: This is our recorded defect stated as a model property: the mechanism that makes predictive variance depend on where the input sits, rather than on how many predictive means the model has - which is exactly what the round-44 mixture failed to deliver (far/near SD ratio below the single GP in 435 of 435 batches, because fixed per-component amplitudes leave mean disagreement as the only new variance and that is largest near the archive). We adopt only the input-dependent signal-amplitude principle as one bounded deterministic warp of the archive distance the selector already computes. The Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and MAP inference of latent amplitude and lengthscale processes is explicitly not adopted: at 300 accepted observations in ten-member batches it is neither affordable nor identifiable, and the paper's regression experiments carry no effect size for this panel.
sources.finding: Makes the signal variance and the lengthscale explicit functions of the input, with separate Gaussian process priors on their logarithms to keep them positive, and infers them by Hamiltonian Monte Carlo with a gradient-ascent MAP alternative; the authors state it is the first model to combine heteroscedastic noise, a non-stationary lengthscale and an input-varying signal variance.
sources.title: Non-Stationary Gaussian Process Regression with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo

sources.applicability: Used as a reference that input-dependent kernel parameters are a known and separable design choice, not as an adoptable mechanism: training a network to set kernel parameters from 300 accepted labels per session is outside this profile and would confound the one quantity the position is built to move. It is cited to bound the claim that our warp is one point in a known design space rather than a novel model.
sources.finding: Reviews the non-stationary kernel literature and proposes a framework in which a deep neural network predicts the lengthscale and noise variance as functions of the test input, so the covariance structure itself is input-dependent rather than globally fitted.
sources.title: Deep Gaussian Covariance Network

sources.applicability: Carried forward from the frozen round-44 review as the basis of the route this round ends, and reported here only to record what the campaign now knows: the construction ran exactly on this Anchor (230 of 435 batches with two or more multi-member components, zero posterior fallbacks, 20 of 20 Gibbs sweeps per batch) and was refuted at its registered calibration-direction clause with a panel of -0.136643, and Curate recorded the structural reason why no bounded variant of fixed-kernel components can produce archive-distance-growing uncertainty. Its membership-mass weight rule remains the leading untested suspect for the magnitude of that loss and is listed below as a deliberately deferred method, not as a position.
sources.finding: Replaces a single Gaussian process by a Dirichlet-process mixture whose latent regimes are inferred online by collapsed Gibbs sampling with an adaptive concentration schedule, gives each regime its own hyperparameters, and splits acquisition uncertainty into intra-regime and inter-regime parts, reporting gains on synthetic tasks, molecular conformer optimization and virtual screening.
sources.title: Regime-Adaptive Bayesian Optimization via Dirichlet Process Mixtures of Gaussian Processes (RAMBO)

conditions: Code Parent is the formal Anchor n-61b9b3bfb40d (stall-conditioned top-forty eligibility over the inherited correlated Thompson allocation: K=3 consecutive non-improving announced batches, M=40 of the unchanged 160-member pool, full mask restored on the first improving batch); its own receipts and its ten-hunk diff must be re-read before the intent is bound.

Research in Depth epoch 1 at suggestion batch ten, the protocol-issued complete Search panel: seeds 0/1/2, the five frozen independent tasks, 300 accepted observations per task including ten initial records, unchanged scoring, resources, timeouts and oracle budget.

Task-agnostic and offline: only this session's chronological accepted real observations and freshly generated de novo molecular graphs. No task identity, no absolute score level, no cross-task or cross-session state, no benchmark answer, no equivalent oracle, no finite-library screening or retrieval, no runtime network.

This is a GuacaMol-style benchmark panel, not a real biological problem: every molecular reading is a generator property and never a claim about a real target, and the objectives do not price chemical viability (h-0df1b8bbf732f363), so no viability argument is offered as a score mechanism.

The Anchor's stall-time eligibility mask, its K=3 counter, the sulfur gate (m-93cd9a000278), the identity admission path (m-213e85380e04) and both duplicate scopes stay exactly as inherited unless this position names them; in-regime figures are mask-restricted (88 of 435 announced batches in 13 of 15 sessions) and are reported separately, never summed with a mask-free figure.

Reading rule: the only law-free references available today were all drawn on the mask-free Parent n-1744a1494180 (ungated n-1c2f17550a3e at -0.009888 with half-width 0.040983 and median_2 band [-0.007767, +0.006695]; gated n-47993ce5d053 at -0.001735 and n-843b25e73dee at +0.007747), so any band comparison carries that borrowed caveat until portfolio position 3 lands; the Anchor's two fragile high cells (deco_hop seed 0 at 0.856148, sitagliptin_mpo seed 0 at 0.765861, the highest such cell among 220 recorded replicas) are reported and never excluded.

Exactly two objective-blind structural rules are added to the shared pool-admission path, applied identically to every origin: a heavy-atom size floor and a refusal of a ring closure that draws a bond between two atoms already in the same perceived aromatic ring. The inherited valence check, canonical novelty, the stable-identity admission (m-213e85380e04), the sulfur envelope gate (m-93cd9a000278) and both duplicate scopes stay exactly as inherited, and the bounded generation-retry and fallback paths absorb the extra rejections.

The valence-context rejection list over nitrogen-halogen, nitrogen-oxygen, peroxide and oxygen-halogen bonds is deliberately out of scope for this position: Curate measured those motifs inside the Anchor's own leading deciles (N-halogenated aromatic nitrogen alone covers 71.3 per cent of one top decile; 888 of 4,350 proposals carry a nitrogen-halogen bond), so removing them is a different and far riskier experiment that would confound this one. It stays a named successor, not a silent extension.

One bound configuration: one size floor value and one ring-closure predicate, with no sweep. The floor is declared before execution and justified from the Anchor's own counts, not tuned against any panel.

Read the admission audit before the endpoint: rejections per rule per session, the share of the Anchor's own 4,350 proposals each rule would have removed (98 proposals of six or fewer heavy atoms, arriving as late as evaluation 298 of 300; aromatic four-membered transannular rings in 85 of 870 and 59 of 870 proposals on two objectives), and the resulting change in admitted-pool composition. A rule that rejects nothing is a dormancy result like n-cf8d309c06de and is reported as such.

This is an intervention on the shared admission path and not a free correction: it changes what every origin can reach the top with, so a negative panel is a real answer about this benchmark's scoring surface and not an implementation fault.
r0045-03-improve-L01.objective: Add exactly two objective-blind structural rules to the shared pool-admission path that every origin passes through - a declared heavy-atom size floor, and a refusal of a ring closure that bonds two atoms already in the same perceived aromatic ring - leaving the inherited valence check, canonical novelty, stable-identity admission, the sulfur envelope gate and both duplicate scopes exactly as inherited, and measure whether removing the two measured degenerate output channels changes what the same 300-call budget buys.
r0045-03-improve-L01.parallel_rationale: This position changes only the shared admission predicate and leaves the operator repertoire, the predictor and every allocation law byte-identical, so it is disjoint from positions 1, 2 and 3 and carries its own registered audit (rejections per rule and admitted-pool composition). It is deliberately paired with position 1 in the same batch because the open question h-d233fe5f2a50dbee is a comparison between the admission path and the operator path, and the two readings are only comparable when both are drawn on the same Parent, profile and close.
r0045-03-improve-L01.question: Does the shared admission path bound this lineage, in the specific sense that refusing sub-molecular fragments and transannular aromatic ring closures changes the composition of the pool the allocator prices and the realized incumbent increments it buys?
r0045-03-improve-L01.rationale: h-0df1b8bbf732f363 measures the limitation on the Anchor itself through its byte-identical reproduction n-cf8d309c06de: admission tests valence, canonical novelty and one narrow inherited sulfur rule and nothing else, 98 of 4,350 proposals have six or fewer heavy atoms and arrive as late as evaluation 298 of 300, and on two objectives 85 of 870 and 59 of 870 proposals contain a ring of four or fewer atoms every atom of which is aromatic - a bond drawn through the interior of a benzene ring. Curate names a size floor and a ring-closure rule as objective-blind, cheap and still unmeasured on this Anchor, and h-d233fe5f2a50dbee states that the open comparison between the admission or operator vocabulary and the predictor or allocation rule needs one experiment on the admission or operator path to settle - this position supplies the admission half while position 1 supplies the operator half. There is also a direct internal reason to expect the size floor to matter, from the Anchor's own winning mechanism: its measured gain came from excluding the low-mean tail during stalls, and in the Parent's in-regime picks all 22 one-to-four heavy-atom picks were ranked 40 or worse while the Anchor's restricted regime bought none of them (0 of 880 in-regime picks ranked 40 or worse, 0 picks with six or fewer heavy atoms, in-regime increments 0.476561 to 0.547037). A floor in admission does that globally and without a trigger, in the 347 of 435 batches the mask never touches. The honest risk is registered: because the objectives do not price chemical viability, score here can ride on chemistry a chemist would reject, so a negative panel is a real answer about the scoring surface and is reported as such.

candidate_methods.method: Motif-granularity proposal operator with an offline corpus-mined substructure vocabulary
required_elements: A substructure vocabulary extracted during prepare from the permitted unlabeled corpus only, with substructures taken as single rings or ring systems and frequent multi-atom groups above one declared frequency threshold, following DST's atom-or-ring definition and frequency-threshold construction; no runtime retrieval, no finite-library screening and no corpus molecule entering a pool, a population or an evaluation.

Motif-level moves that attach, exchange or replace a whole ring system or functional group in one accepted operation, with explicit attachment-point resolution following the enumeration rule DST takes from JT-VAE (an atom may attach at any eligible ring atom; two rings join by a bond or by sharing two atoms and one bond; spiro-type products excluded), and the inherited valence, identity, duplicate and sulfur admission path applied to every product.

MoLeR's mixed granularity: the inherited seven atom- and bond-local operators and the connected-fragment crossover are retained as the fallback and the motif move is added with one declared probability, so the arm is a repertoire extension and not a replacement of measured-positive components.

The vocabulary must stay objective-blind: unlike GenMol's property-scored, dynamically updated fragment vocabulary, no accepted score level, task identity or oracle feedback may enter vocabulary construction or motif choice.

Pre-registered structural observables that distinguish this from the refuted refinement stage: the share of accepted products whose Murcko framework changes, the heavy-atom change distribution, the count of accepted moves installing a complete ring system, and the admission and selection rates of motif products against the single-atom path - the quantities h-ac59f26982d33138 shows the current repertoire cannot move.

candidate_methods.method: Archive-distance-dependent prior variance for the accepted-only similarity-kernel GP (non-stationary input-dependent signal amplitude)
required_elements: The signal variance becomes an explicit function of the input, following Heinonen's input-varying signal amplitude, rather than a globally fitted constant: the prior variance of a candidate increases with its distance from this session's own accepted archive under the similarity the selector already computes.

One bounded deterministic warp with one declared form and one declared scale, with no latent amplitude process, no Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and no auxiliary network, because 300 accepted observations in ten-member batches identify none of them.

The mean structure and every measured-positive consumer are preserved exactly: the kernel's similarity form, the adaptive normalization, the noise SD, the Cholesky jitter ladder and the sampled-residual correlated Thompson draw with its sequential masks and first-index ties.

The registered calibration reading precedes the endpoint: an oracle-free ablated-cluster split of the session's own accepted archive plus the archive-far to archive-near predictive SD ratio, which must rise above the inherited single GP's 1.7477 rather than fall as the refuted mixture's 1.3942 did.
The recorded negative control stands: a calibration improvement without a rise in realized incumbent-increment mass above the Anchor's 5.978073 refutes the premise and is reported as such.

candidate_methods.method: Mixture weight driven by the probability of containing the maximizer (deferred)
required_elements: Replace the adopted spatial weight proportional to membership mass over component predictive SD by a weight reflecting the probability that a component contains the maximizer, which Curate identifies as the leading untested suspect for the magnitude of the round-44 loss (the passive single GP's own top-ten candidates were marked down 0.048 to 0.236 score units in every non-degenerate session against a whole-pool shift of -0.075 to +0.020).

Deferred this round with a reason rather than scheduled: even a corrected weight cannot deliver archive-distance-growing uncertainty, because the recorded structural bound is the fixed per-component kernel, so this would diagnose the loss of a refuted construction instead of answering the open calibration question that position 2 addresses.

sources.applicability: This is our recorded defect stated as a model property: the mechanism that makes predictive variance depend on where the input sits, rather than on how many predictive means the model has - which is exactly what the round-44 mixture failed to deliver (far/near SD ratio below the single GP in 435 of 435 batches, because fixed per-component amplitudes leave mean disagreement as the only new variance and that is largest near the archive). We adopt only the input-dependent signal-amplitude principle as one bounded deterministic warp of the archive distance the selector already computes. The Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and MAP inference of latent amplitude and lengthscale processes is explicitly not adopted: at 300 accepted observations in ten-member batches it is neither affordable nor identifiable, and the paper's regression experiments carry no effect size for this panel.
sources.finding: Makes the signal variance and the lengthscale explicit functions of the input, with separate Gaussian process priors on their logarithms to keep them positive, and infers them by Hamiltonian Monte Carlo with a gradient-ascent MAP alternative; the authors state it is the first model to combine heteroscedastic noise, a non-stationary lengthscale and an input-varying signal variance.
sources.title: Non-Stationary Gaussian Process Regression with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo

sources.applicability: Used as a reference that input-dependent kernel parameters are a known and separable design choice, not as an adoptable mechanism: training a network to set kernel parameters from 300 accepted labels per session is outside this profile and would confound the one quantity the position is built to move. It is cited to bound the claim that our warp is one point in a known design space rather than a novel model.
sources.finding: Reviews the non-stationary kernel literature and proposes a framework in which a deep neural network predicts the lengthscale and noise variance as functions of the test input, so the covariance structure itself is input-dependent rather than globally fitted.
sources.title: Deep Gaussian Covariance Network

sources.applicability: Carried forward from the frozen round-44 review as the basis of the route this round ends, and reported here only to record what the campaign now knows: the construction ran exactly on this Anchor (230 of 435 batches with two or more multi-member components, zero posterior fallbacks, 20 of 20 Gibbs sweeps per batch) and was refuted at its registered calibration-direction clause with a panel of -0.136643, and Curate recorded the structural reason why no bounded variant of fixed-kernel components can produce archive-distance-growing uncertainty. Its membership-mass weight rule remains the leading untested suspect for the magnitude of that loss and is listed below as a deliberately deferred method, not as a position.
sources.finding: Replaces a single Gaussian process by a Dirichlet-process mixture whose latent regimes are inferred online by collapsed Gibbs sampling with an adaptive concentration schedule, gives each regime its own hyperparameters, and splits acquisition uncertainty into intra-regime and inter-regime parts, reporting gains on synthetic tasks, molecular conformer optimization and virtual screening.
sources.title: Regime-Adaptive Bayesian Optimization via Dirichlet Process Mixtures of Gaussian Processes (RAMBO)

literature_basis.method: Improvement-priced batch allocation: expected improvement over the session incumbent with Kriging-Believer batch construction

r0046-00-improve-L01.objective: Price candidates by the improvement they could deliver instead of by a sampled tail draw. Replace the inherited sequentially masked correlated-Thompson maxima over the 160-member fresh pool with one greedy expected-improvement rule on the same posterior: each of the ten positions takes the eligible pool member maximizing EI = (mu - y*)Phi(z) + sigma phi(z), z = (mu - y*)/sigma, with y* the session's own best accepted score, and after each pick the inherited pool covariance conditions the remaining members on that pick's predictive mean (Kriging Believer), so the correlation stays load-bearing and the batch cannot fill with ten near-identical members. The predictive SD both terms read is the one declared session-calibrated scale of condition 7, because an improvement criterion over a predictor whose own standardized errors run at 40.72 near its archive collapses to posterior-mean-greedy allocation, which this lineage already measured at -0.116317. Nothing else changes: same pool, same generator, same admission, same mask, same seeds and budget.
r0046-00-improve-L01.parallel_rationale: The four positions are one designed set on one Parent, profile and panel, not four independent guesses at the same mechanism. Positions 1, 2 and 3 are a graded triple through the single stage three independent round-45 arms named as the recurring limitation: position 3 removes the sampled draw entirely and gives the greedy end of the pricing stack on this Anchor (previously measured only on another Parent at -0.116317), position 2 keeps the inherited draw and corrects only the dispersion it reads, and position 1 is the joint arm that needs both an honest scale and an incumbent-referenced criterion to be well posed at all. Run in the same batch they attribute each other: the joint arm's reading is bounded above by the greedy control and below by the calibration-only control, which no sequential order of two rounds would give at the same path realization. Position 4 is on a disjoint axis - how many candidates the unchanged rule ranks per selection - and shares no changed law with the other three, so it cannot confound them and it keeps a conservative evidence-backed attempt in the round while the pricing question is open.
r0046-00-improve-L01.question: Does ranking the fresh pool by the magnitude of expected improvement over the session's own incumbent, on a predictive scale corrected from the predictor's own residuals, convert the supply this Anchor already produces into realized incumbent increments - or is the sampled correlated draw load-bearing in a way no improvement criterion reproduces?
r0046-00-improve-L01.rationale: This is the one remedy the campaign's own aggregated diagnosis names and has never run (h-260aad06d6d222ff, h-7aa9957c7639acc1). Three independent round-45 arms, each built to test something else, measured the same obstruction on the pricing side: n-814ee0b4f000 put coarse chemistry into 0.2997 of the pool and the surrogate gave it no uncertainty premium (SD ratio 1.005, mean-rank percentile 0.56 against 0.36 for one-atom neighbours, units of nine or more heavy atoms 0.3274 of supply and 0.1032 of purchases); n-907d480bc1fe made the far field comparable in 435 of 435 batches and its extra purchases converted at 0.000232 of mass per evaluation against 0.001752 for the picks both rules agreed on; n-19063a19f7ec freed the fragment channel's oracle calls and the re-funded picks bought exactly the same 32 incumbent improvements. The Anchor's own receipts say the same thing from the positive side: its only measured gain restricts eligibility to the top forty posterior means during stalls, where 0 of 880 in-regime picks are rank 40 or worse against 997 of 3,470 out of regime, and n-5911390da209 showed that releasing the restriction buys candidates at ranks 49 to 149 of which none beat the incumbent at announcement. An improvement criterion is the always-on, graded form of exactly that: it declines a low-mean wide-interval candidate on its expected gain rather than on a crude rank cut, and unlike the refuted distance gate it changes what is done with a far candidate rather than how far it looks.

candidate_methods.method: Improvement-priced batch allocation: expected improvement over the session incumbent with Kriging-Believer batch construction
required_elements: The closed-form criterion over an existing Gaussian posterior: EI = (mu - y*)Phi(z) + sigma phi(z) with z = (mu - y*)/sigma, referenced to the best value observed so far rather than to any absolute level
An incumbent reference that is the session's own best accepted score, which is what makes a wide interval with a low mean lose a position instead of winning it on a tail draw

Kriging-Believer sequential batch construction: impute each already placed pick's own predictive value as a fictitious observation and recondition the remaining candidates through the existing covariance, so one criterion fills a batch of ten without ten near-identical picks
A predictive dispersion the criterion can be read on at all, which the same review's prior-width source names as a measured defect of this architecture class

candidate_methods.method: Session-calibrated predictive scale: prior-width correction and post-hoc recalibration of the dispersion the acquisition reads
required_elements: The diagnosis that a GP prior scale inherited from poor early data is too small, with the fix stated as declaring the scale rather than fitting it on that data
Post-hoc correction of an existing probabilistic regressor's dispersion from its own prediction-outcome pairs, leaving the model and its mean untouched
A bounded, declared estimator with a clip so an early session cannot produce a degenerate scale, and a reported clipping rate
The confirmation half of the same source, already satisfied here: count rather than binary Morgan fingerprints under the Tanimoto kernel, which is why no fingerprint change is proposed
The identical construction is reused as the declared second half of position 1, where an improvement criterion is not well posed without it

candidate_methods.method: Acquisition-maximization breadth: more candidates ranked per selection

A cost accounting that keeps the enlarged per-selection search inside the frozen budget, which here is the task and node timeout rather than the paper's batch-size-one schedule

candidate_methods.method: Knowledge-gradient pricing for correlated normal beliefs (value of information)
required_elements: Exact computation of the expected increase in the maximum posterior mean over a finite set of alternatives under a correlated normal prior, which the Anchor's 160-member pool and explicit cross-candidate covariance already provide
The correlated-belief structure that lets one measurement re-price many candidates, which is what distinguishes it from a candidate's own improvement
A decision-value objective, which is the element that does not match a final-Top-1 endpoint and is why this method is deferred rather than scheduled

candidate_methods.method: Conformal-corrected acquisition under a misspecified surrogate
required_elements: Conformal prediction sets that retain coverage under misspecification, used inside the acquisition so queries are steered to regions where the model's predictions are reliably valid
A calibration split of the observed data, which at 300 chronological accepted observations would have to come out of the same session archive the surrogate is trained on
A per-candidate interval construction rather than a single dispersion scale, which is the named successor if the scalar correction in position 2 proves too coarse

required_elements: A mean-variance objective with the input-dependent observation variance modelled alongside the mean
An aleatoric risk to price, that is repeated noisy outcomes at the same input, which these five deterministic benchmark objectives do not have

observed_bottleneck.summary: Candidate pricing and ranking, not proposal capability and not admission. On this Anchor, three independent round-45 arms built to test three different hypotheses each measured the same obstruction: the inherited correlated-Thompson rule over an accepted-only count-Morgan Tanimoto posterior converts neither coarse multi-atom products nor archive-far products into realized incumbent increments, and supplying more of either, or recalibrating the far-field uncertainty it reads, does not change that. Four disjoint stages (proposal supply, admission, survivor retention, predictor geometry) are now refuted on this Anchor with no positive result, and the one measured positive in the lineage's history is a crude special case of pricing by posterior mean: restricting eligibility to the top forty posterior means during stalls. No node of this lineage has ever run an acquisition that weighs expected improvement against risk, and the dispersion any such rule would read is itself measured wrong by more than an order of magnitude near the predictor's own archive.
