nodes.hypothesis: Extend the Parent's existing atom-change menu with single-center tetrahedral-carbon configuration assignment or inversion, preserving the molecular composition and connectivity while allowing canonically distinct stereochemical neighbors to enter the unchanged novelty, tabu and accepted-score walk.
nodes.finding:
All 24 configuration-only edits reached evaluation as distinct molecular identities while preserving composition and connectivity. Each assigned one previously unspecified carbon center; both relative orientations were sampled, but no assigned-center inversion was selected. Nine of these neighbors became the next current molecule with exactly the same score as their source. Assignments also survived many subsequent structural edits: 488 of 4,350 emitted neighbors contained an assigned carbon center, compared with none for the parent. Across 32 actually evaluated pairs sharing the same graph but differing in the extent of stereochemical assignment, every pair received equal scalar feedback. The complete three-seed mean nevertheless fell from 0.520918 to 0.511159, a paired change of -0.009759, exceeding the allowed 0.002 loss. Seed changes were +0.013487, +0.001052 and -0.043817; the main losses were in DRD2 and sitagliptin, while median improved slightly and the other two task means were unchanged. The proposal mechanism activated, but this panel does not support its score usefulness.

The missing configuration channel was a real generator limitation: it can now supply fresh evaluated identities without breaking the repaired identity join or changing graph chemistry. Its immediate effect here was neutral movement through differently annotated states. Because the inherited local motifs omit stereochemistry, all nine selected assignment moves advanced memory age without installing new inverse restrictions. Such moves can alter later search even when their own scores tie; later endpoint differences therefore do not demonstrate a preference for either configuration. The equal scores establish a limitation for the sampled unspecified-to-assigned comparisons only. No opposite fully assigned pair was evaluated, so the response to genuine configuration inversion remains open. The molecular assessment also shows that stereochemical labels leave the pre-existing aromatic, reactive-heteroatom and densely bridged sulfur-rich chemistry largely intact. Partial assignments neither resolve all centers nor establish accessible three-dimensional geometry or synthetic plausibility. The experiment narrows the next scientific question to whether configuration coverage can have useful measured consequences under this feedback and walk, rather than whether the generator can emit it.

nodes.hypothesis: Publish a validation-selected exponential moving average of unlabeled recurrent training weights, with decay 0.999 and the Parent raw training trajectory and raw-NLL stopping rule preserved.
nodes.finding:
The averaged weights were distinct from the raw weights throughout validation, and all 6,633 logged coordinate updates matched the registered recurrence. The raw training losses and final raw checkpoint identities remained exactly equal to the Parent. All three preparations completed 29,742 updates and selected the final averaged state by ordinary holdout loss. Mean selected token loss fell from 0.564577 to 0.559834, improving in every seed. Averaging initially lagged the raw model, but its loss stayed lower at every validation from step 5,000 onward in all three seeds.

The final unscored diagnostic also improved in every seed. Across three 4,096-sample panels per model, valid terminated yield increased from 90.41% to 91.85%, giving 177 more valid strings. Each individual panel had no canonical duplicates or missing EOS, so its valid and canonical-unique yields were equal. The gains were 2.34, 1.54 and 0.44 percentage points across seeds. This pure-prior gain did not carry through to higher adapted-policy validity: across the same 12,000 online draws, validity was 70.06% versus Parent 70.34%, with first-batch validity 90.92% versus 91.17% and later-batch validity 67.74% versus 68.03%.

All fifteen tasks completed. Three-seed mean final Top-1 rose from 0.520669 to 0.527370; paired gains were 0.000602, 0.004046 and 0.015453. The improvement was concentrated in sitagliptin, while deco-hop and median scores fell in every seed and zaleplon was mixed. Recorded mean preparation time was 238.0 seconds versus 259.5 seconds, with identical training horizons; these total timings do not isolate the extra averaging and diagnostic cost.

This provides evidence that averaging the same unlabeled weight trajectory can produce a better reusable prior without changing training examples, gradient updates or the online algorithm. Exact raw checkpoint identities and matching raw loss histories rule out altered raw training as the explanation. The final pure-prior comparison was excluded from checkpoint selection, so its consistent yield improvement adds evidence beyond the heldout criterion that selected the average. The early lag also limits the result: the benefit appears after substantial training, and is not evidence that averaged weights are preferable throughout learning.

Better pure-prior likelihood and parseable yield were insufficient to improve validity after task adaptation or provide broad task gains. The chemistry explains why the score increase deserves a narrower interpretation: ordinary aryl/carbonyl and amine families coexist with N-fluorinated motifs, unusual hydrogen-bearing sulfur, azide/acyl-halide assemblies and contracted rings. Favorable scores do not establish those connections as necessary or synthetically credible. Explicit stereochemical configurations remain absent. The remaining question is how much of the improved reusable prior can survive accepted-score adaptation while retaining credible functional-group attachment and useful core coverage; this experiment demonstrates the averaging effect, but does not resolve that downstream limitation.

nodes.hypothesis: At every inherited refit, select the Morgan environment radius of the inherited dot-product count Tanimoto covariance from the menu 1, 2 or 3 over the same chirality-aware 2048-bin folded count vocabulary by the maximum exact log marginal likelihood of the inherited standardized accepted targets under observation noise SD 0.05 and the inherited jitter ladder, preferring the inherited radius 2 on an exact tie or a failed factorization, and use that single selected radius coherently for the training, cross, pool and probe features, the posterior mean and the correlated residual covariance of that batch.
nodes.finding:
The selection ran on every one of the 435 model refits, and an independent recomputation reproduced every choice. It was far from a no-op: the inherited radius 2 won only 67 refits, against 146 for radius 1 and 222 for radius 3. Each task settled into its own pattern, closely matching what the Parent's own data would have preferred. median_2 always chose radius 1 and sitagliptin_mpo always chose radius 3; zaleplon_mpo chose radius 3 in all but one refit. drd2_docking started at radius 3 and moved to radius 2 as the archive grew, and deco_hop depended on the seed. Most choices were decisive (median margin 23 nats). The exception is the very first refit on the ten fixed starting molecules, decided by under 1 nat, which already sent every run off the Parent's path at the first batch. Everything outside the radius behaved identically. Batch sizes, pools, fallbacks, the sulfur gate and random draws were unchanged, and the first-batch candidate pools and random numbers were identical to the Parent's. Compared with the inherited radius-2 model scored on exactly the same molecules and states, the chosen model was slightly better calibrated: squared error on the scored molecules was 0.00845 against 0.00849. It ranked them slightly worse within a batch: rank correlation 0.539 against 0.548. The split follows the radius. Where radius 1 was chosen, ranking improved (median_2 0.80 vs 0.77; deco_hop 0.53 vs 0.51). Where radius 3 was chosen, it worsened (zaleplon_mpo 0.42 vs 0.47; sitagliptin_mpo 0.41 vs 0.43; drd2_docking 0.53 vs 0.56), and the spread of predicted means across the candidate pool shrank to about 0.86 of the radius-2 spread. The complete matched mean fell from 0.5965 to 0.5565, a change of -0.040 against the required +0.002. Seeds moved by -0.089, +0.021 and -0.052, and only 6 of 15 task-seed cells improved. Three cells carry the entire loss: deco_hop seed 0 (-0.221) and sitagliptin_mpo seeds 0 and 2 (-0.217, -0.169). The deco_hop cell is the Parent's rare late breakthrough to 0.856, which the Child, like every recent Child, never reached; it was actually ahead of the Parent at evaluations 200 and 250 before plateauing at 0.635. In the two sitagliptin_mpo cells the Child fell behind early (best 0.28 vs 0.51 and 0.29 vs 0.39 at evaluation 100) and never caught up. median_2, the task the brief singled out, improved modestly: mean 0.2317 vs 0.2227, with one cell at 0.2418, above every round-28 sibling cell. The other twelve cells net to roughly zero.

Selecting a hyperparameter by marginal likelihood has now twice been exactly activated, slightly improved calibration, weakened within-batch ranking and lost endpoint score. Here the selected quantity was the fingerprint radius; in the earlier test it was the observation noise. In this lineage, a better marginal-likelihood fit of the accepted archive is not a guide to better candidate ranking. The decomposition shows why. Radius 3 wins on the data-fit term, not on model complexity. With amplitude fixed at 1 and noise fixed at 0.05, the model cannot otherwise explain near-identical molecules with very different scores. A larger radius makes neighbours look less alike and absorbs the clash. So the radius ends up acting as a stand-in for missing roughness or noise freedom, and the result is a flatter posterior mean that discriminates less among candidates. The molecular review fits this. On the two tasks with the largest losses, the Child's molecules drifted from what the Parent kept: on deco_hop it hung chains on a frozen core where the Parent made a ring-level change, and on sitagliptin_mpo it built dienol and thioketone chemistry where the Parent kept an intact N-aryl ring. Radius 1, by contrast, sharpened ranking where it was chosen, and its median_2 cell at 0.2418 is the first to clear the band that all 24 round-28 sibling cells sat in. That suggests a narrower follow-up: allow only the finer radius, or fit amplitude and noise jointly so the radius stops doing their job, or select by chronological ranking quality rather than likelihood. It also rules out simply turning up locality as a general fix. Still open: whether the radius-1 benefit survives on its own; whether the radius-3 harm is causal or partly path noise, since every run diverges from the first batch; and whether preferences at the edge of the menu point to radius 0 or 4. The deco_hop seed-0 cell should be read as a rare event when comparing against this Parent.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove active off-diagonal sibling-kernel influence only when parent_id != 0. For deeper occurrence i, active D_i=N_i, S_i=W_i, B_i=N_i*M_i when N_i>0 (zero otherwise), P_i=O_i, shared_Q_i=W_i/N_i when N_i>0, and Qbest_i=M_i when N_i>0. If N_i=0 retain the inherited neutral exploitation default. Keep unvisited priority D_i+P_i==0, exploration beta*sqrt(2*log(max(2,N_parent+O_parent))/(D_i+P_i)), and earliest-occurrence ties. The virtual-root rows keep the complete original count-Tanimoto weighted peak rule including initial-forest competition. Stored route N/W/Q/M/O, maximum receipt identity, returned-receipt lists, raw-count widening, direct-frontier purchase and accepted-incumbent fresh-root lifecycle remain inherited. This is one conditional removal of deeper shared value and completed/pending density together; it does not separately identify those mediators.
nodes.finding:
The removal worked: all 26,480 deeper selection rows used only their own completed and pending evidence, with no formula or accounting errors and unchanged root and restart laws. It changed 2,938 of 4,105 deeper decisions; 2,471 of 4,350 accepted optimizer outcomes passed through changed choices, with exposure in every task/seed cell. Across the complete three-seed panel, mean score fell from 0.499496 to 0.447190, a paired loss of 0.052307. All three seed macros fell; seven task/seed endpoints improved and eight worsened. The largest consistent loss was on drd2_docking, whose task mean fell by 0.258604. Incumbent improvements became more frequent, from 148 to 192, but their total gain fell from 4.3651 to 3.5805; late-half gain also fell, from 1.3675 to 1.0134. That loss meets the preregistered criterion for positive conditional contribution of retained deeper sharing. The separate formal Anchor mean remains 0.607030.

Fresh-root feedback does not make deeper sharing redundant under these conditions. Removing its combined value and visitation-density influence saves many internal failed attempts and produces more frequent small improvements, yet loses enough larger improvements to lower every seed macro. This distinguishes successful removal from score success: the mechanism is confirmed, the working non-inferiority expectation is contradicted, and the signed contribution finding favors the presence of deeper sharing on this specific host. It does not identify whether shared best returns or exploration density supplies that benefit, and it says nothing separately about root sharing or whether the broader tree approach should end.

The search still reaches broad scaffold diversity: distinct typed scaffolds increase from 1,704 to 1,829. However, within-announcement similarity rises from 0.492 to 0.566, and the late-half value reaches 0.580. There is no evidence of global scaffold collapse; the limiting behavior is conversion of plentiful graph variants into large useful gains. Tiny fragments decrease, but oversized products and oxygen–oxygen linkages increase. The molecular assessment finds inconsistent preservation of favorable polar-group and ring relationships, including less conventional arrangements among the poorer docking leaders. A graph proposal method that can vary topology and linkers while preserving those relationships could address this limitation. These chemistry associations do not establish the cause of the removal loss or guarantee that such a method would improve scores. Parent logs lack separate proposal and diagnostic clocks, so the runtime change cannot be assigned to the selector alone.

nodes.hypothesis: Coalesce each corpus-observed complete bracket-atom expression into one reversible SMILES token, with inherited Cl/Br-and-character fallback for unseen bracket expressions, so prior learning and its shared sequence interface model an atom together with its explicit hydrogen and charge state.
nodes.finding:
The new representation was used and learned in all three seeds. Every one of the 1,272,851 eligible corpus strings round-trips exactly, and the original training/holdout membership is preserved. Each holdout contains 1,013 complete bracket targets; their average negative log likelihood falls from about 5.08–5.14 before training to 2.07–2.27 after training. On identical holdout molecules, the learned prior also assigns better normalized likelihood to bracket-bearing sequences than the Parent in every seed. Prior freezing, fresh objective state and all online replay/update methods remain intact. Across the search panel, the raw invalid-string fraction falls from 9.568% to 8.573%, and both implementations complete every required batch. That local improvement does not yield the expected score gain: the macro mean is 0.506571 versus 0.507554, a paired change of -0.000983 rather than the registered increase of at least 0.002. Seed changes are -0.022179, +0.002069 and +0.017160. Gains in three task means are offset mainly by a 0.058039 decline in the sitagliptin mean, present in all three seeds. The smaller observed score SD, 0.004690 versus 0.011518, is descriptive evidence from this panel, not a reliability guarantee.

Learning coherent atom-state units is supported, but better likelihood on those units does not ensure that objective-driven generation retains or exploits more of them. Accepted original strings containing bracket atoms actually fall from 1,269 to 835 out of 4,350 proposals; charged forms also become less common. The output still reaches recognizable medicinal scaffold families, while the Molecular assessment finds excessive low-scoring growth, reactive outliers and unspecified configurations. The experiment therefore narrows the unresolved issue to how a learned representation interacts with the existing search dynamics and chemical coverage, rather than a failure to encode or learn the registered units. The reduction in aggregate invalid strings does not identify bracket syntax as the Parent error source because rejected strings were not saved. No stereochemical supervision exists in this corpus, and none is created by the representation. The panel varies both preparation and search by seed, so it cannot isolate which stage caused the mixed task effects.

nodes.hypothesis: Candidate-set breadth per selection under the unchanged masked correlated-Thompson allocation: the fresh per-batch field that the fitted posterior ranks doubles from 16 to 32 admitted de novo offspring per announced batch member (160 to 320 at batch ten), so each of the ten sequentially masked joint-draw maxima is taken over twice as many freshly generated candidates drawn from the same proposal distribution through the same admission path. Nothing about pricing changes: the posterior and its count-Morgan generalized-Tanimoto kernel, its adaptive normalization, its observation-noise term and its Cholesky jitter ladder, the single (10, pool) standard-normal array and its consumption order, the sampled residual scale, the cross-candidate correlation, the per-pick mask update and the tie rule, the stall counter K=3 and the eligible-set size M=40, the sulfur gate, canonical identity admission, both duplicate scopes, the seven operator families at unchanged weights, crossover at 0.45 with its finishing edit, the ordinary continuation law, greedy-64 retention and quantile breeding all stay exactly as inherited. The path of effect has two legs, reported separately. Out of the stall regime, which is 347 of the Anchor's 435 announced batches, the order statistics of the ranked field rise, so the same rule is offered a better maximum. Inside the stall regime the unchanged forty-member bar now admits the best forty of 320 rather than of 160, so the eligible set is drawn from the top eighth instead of the top quarter at an unchanged M - the same sharpening direction that produced this Parent's own +0.010577, applied at a finer grain without touching M, K or the ordering rule.
nodes.finding:
The field was built exactly as registered: 320 admitted candidates in all 435 announced batches, never truncated, never falling back, ten unique molecules bought per batch, at an admission cost of 1.12 construction attempts per member against the Anchor's 1.09, and the whole run cost 2.29 times the Anchor's non-oracle work while using at most 4.8 per cent of a task timeout and 1.4 per cent of the node timeout. The supply leg did what it promised. In the posterior's own standardized units the field's best member rose from +1.741 to +1.796, its tenth-best from +1.256 to +1.401, and its fortieth-best - the eligibility bar - from +0.726 to +1.017. The sharper-bar leg also did what it promised, inside the stall regime only (85 restricted batches here, 88 on the Anchor, never summed with mask-free figures). The unchanged forty-member bar cut at the top eighth instead of the top quarter, verified member by member: effective mask size 40 and the eligible set equal to an independently recomputed top forty of the 320-member mean ordering in 85 of 85 restricted batches. Every one of the 850 in-regime purchases came from the top 12.5 per cent of its own field, where only 76 per cent of the Anchor's 880 did; in-regime best-so-far gain per restricted batch rose from 0.006216 to 0.006472, stall-breaking batches from 25 of 88 to 28 of 85, and in-regime incumbent improvements from 31 to 34. In-regime realized score was mixed: the mean fell from 0.412585 to 0.401378 while the median rose from 0.354215 to 0.371777. The conversion leg, the pre-registered discriminator, failed, and failed with precisely the signature the fourfold precedent left at twice this dose. Out of the stall regime, across 3,500 picks against the Anchor's 3,470, the selected member's standardized enrichment fell from +1.022 to +0.999 while the field's own ceiling was rising; the selected-to-field posterior-SD ratio rose from 0.899 to 0.949; disagreement with the posterior-mean argmax rose from 87.1 to 90.1 per cent; purchases from the top SD decile rose from 198 to 289; purchases below their own field's mean posterior rose from 8.3 to 10.7 per cent; and one-to-four-atom fragment purchases rose from 88 to 114. The precedent's corresponding movements were enrichment +1.054 to +1.043, SD ratio 0.849 to 0.897 and disagreement 86.5 to 92.8 per cent. Every direction matches. Realized incumbent-increment mass did not rise: 5.516733 over 254 improvements against 5.978073 over 253, a 7.7 per cent deficit split between the first session third (-0.252) and the last (-0.263), with the largest single increment falling from 0.4620 to 0.2969 and the median increment from 0.00850 to 0.00599 - while parent-beating stayed flat at 658 of 4,350 against 634 and the improvement count was unchanged at 254 against 253, so the arm bought as many wins, of smaller size. The complete matched fifteen-cell panel came in at 0.576274 against the Anchor's 0.607030, a paired delta of -0.030756 over seeds 0/1/2 (-0.077390 / +0.001818 / -0.016696), missing the registered +0.002 criterion. Because both arms start from identical initial records, that panel delta is arithmetically the increment-mass deficit divided by fifteen; it is the same measurement, not a second one. By task: zaleplon_mpo +0.0366, drd2_docking +0.0105, median_2 +0.0090, deco_hop -0.0926, sitagliptin_mpo -0.1173. The two registered fragile high cells account for the entire panel: deco_hop seed 0 fell 0.856148 to 0.621477 and sitagliptin_mpo seed 0 fell 0.765861 to 0.534179, together -0.031090 of panel against a total of -0.030756, leaving the other thirteen cells at a net +0.000334. The panel sits inside this Anchor's own law-free band [-0.055482, +0.014579], so it is reported as one realization of a changed random path rather than as a demonstrated loss; median_2, the unprotected task, improved on two of three seeds and its seed-1 cell (+0.0196) sits just above that task's own law-free band.

The round's supply-side control has returned its answer, and it is a clean negative: candidate supply is not what this allocator lacks. Doubling the field raised every order statistic the rule could have exploited - the bar member moved nearly three tenths of a standard deviation - and the rule converted none of it into better purchases or more realized gain. The pricing diagnosis therefore stands alone, and the round's pricing arms can be read against a field whose breadth is demonstrably not binding. What the evidence now adds beyond 'it did not help' is where the obstruction sits. It is not the surrogate's mean ranking: the rank agreement between the prospective posterior mean of each purchased molecule and its realized oracle score is 0.82 here against 0.81 on the Anchor (0.64 to 0.97 across tasks), so the model orders what it buys about as well as it ever did. It is the coupling between field size and the sampled-residual draw. A correlated Thompson maximum over a larger field has more chances to land on a member whose uncertainty the model cannot constrain, and that is exactly what the receipts show: with twice the field, the rule bought higher-variance candidates (SD ratio 0.899 to 0.949), disagreed with its own mean more often (87 to 90 per cent) and dropped below its own field's mean posterior more often (8.3 to 10.7 per cent). The one place conversion did work is the one place the rule is not allowed to roam: the stall-time top-forty bar, where a sharper cut at an unchanged M bought a 4 per cent higher gain per restricted batch and broke more stalls. The two losing objectives failed in two different ways, and both are the same rule reacting to width. On deco_hop the selector ran to residual extremes - its selected-to-field SD ratio there exceeded one (1.036 against the Anchor's 0.910), enrichment fell 0.148, and its top decile collapsed to 6 Murcko scaffolds against the Anchor's 12 with 55 of 87 members sharing one identical score. On sitagliptin_mpo it did the opposite: enrichment actually rose 0.162 and 76 per cent of picks came from the top 5 per cent of their field, but this is the objective where the surrogate's ranking is weakest (0.64), and exploiting a weak ranking harder locked the session onto one fluorine-on-nitrogen xanthine series - 11 elite scaffolds against 21, basic amines falling from 219 of 870 to 44 and from 45 of the top 87 to 1. A wider field amplifies whichever way the model is wrong. The structural conversion gap is the sharpest single number here: the enlarged field supplied 84 per cent more distinct Murcko scaffolds per batch (171.6 of 320 against 93.2 of 160), and the purchases captured 9 per cent more (128 against 118 distinct scaffolds per 290-molecule session, 39 against 36 in the final third). The chemistry report's reading holds against the receipts - the extra width went into ring geometry rather than functionality, with rings per admitted member rising 4.05 to 4.38 - though the heavy-atom drift from 29.4 to 31.8 must not be charged to the field size, since this Anchor's own law-free re-draw already reaches 31.7 by stream divergence alone. Method diagnosis. The limitation this node exposes is the ranking rule, not the surrogate and not the proposal operator. What is indicated is an acquisition whose variance exposure does not grow with the size of the set it ranks - an improvement- or optimistic-bound criterion with a calibrated dispersion, with sequential re-conditioning of the batch after each pick rather than ten masked maxima of a single joint draw - and, for the diversity half, a batch-selection scheme that prices skeleton-level redundancy explicitly rather than hoping a wider field delivers it. Both are classes of method, not settings; no value of this constant reaches them. What remains open: this prices one width point on one host, and the stall-bar result raises a question this node cannot answer - the only conversion that worked came from a mean-rank bar, so whether a top-mean eligibility bar held as a share of the field, or applied outside the stall regime, would convert breadth is untested and is a different intervention. The width route itself should stop here: with 40, 120, 160 and 640 measured on earlier Parents and 320 measured on this one, the axis has no monotone benefit anywhere in the lineage, and this node now supplies the reason.

nodes.hypothesis: Among exact accepted-score batch maxima, select the neighbor with greatest multiset-Jaccard distance between its inherited radius-one motif occurrence counts and the current source's counts, then use canonical lexical order for any remaining tie.
nodes.finding:
Twenty choices among equally best accepted molecules changed the next walk state, and all 20 increased exact motif distance from the current molecule without giving up the accepted maximum score. Eighteen occurred at the same score as the source, one during an improving move and one during a worsening move. Nineteen choices had actual continuations; one was terminal. The rule encountered 40 exact maximum ties, compared with 26 in the parent, while preserving canonical fallback and the original feedback, archive and memory rules. Plateau episodes contained 60 equal-score moves, each visiting a distinct motif profile within its episode, compared with 49 such moves in the parent. Coverage per move was unchanged, and the longest plateau grew from six moves to nine. The three-seed macro mean fell from 0.521759 to 0.519947, a paired loss of 0.001812 against the required gain of 0.002. One seed improved slightly and two declined. Only deco_hop endpoints changed; the other four task endpoints were identical in every seed.

The experiment rules out failure to exercise the selector: it changed real, scored next states and was followed by 600 later accepted proposals after removing overlap between the recorded histories. It also shows why larger local structural steps are insufficient evidence of more useful exploration. The extra plateau profiles came with extra plateau moves, and longer equal-score episodes still appeared. Twenty later archive gains occurred in the affected continuations, compared with 26 in the corresponding recorded parent histories, but the overlapping paths prevent assigning a causal gain to each tie choice. The rule sometimes chose smaller molecules and sometimes larger ones. The molecular assessment finds that some equally scored differences introduce reactive attachments or unusual sulfur connectivity, while conventional ring and carbonyl families remain available. Greater distance between local motif counts therefore supplies neither compactness nor chemical plausibility. The direct selection mechanism is confirmed; its proposed overall score benefit is refuted on this panel. What remains open is whether a distance that distinguishes useful structural alternatives from score-insensitive local decoration can improve later search; this experiment does not settle that broader question.

nodes.hypothesis: A corpus-trained autoregressive SMILES policy is adapted independently in each objective by Augmented Hill-Climb on only the current scored batch elites, fitting policy log likelihood toward frozen-prior log likelihood plus scaled observed reward, and proposes new molecules by direct token sampling from the updated policy.
nodes.finding:
Macro mean 0.4766 on the single screening seed, with per-task finals of 0.6029 on deco_hop, 0.99999961 on drd2_docking, 0.1844 on median_2, 0.1428 on sitagliptin_mpo and 0.4532 on zaleplon_mpo. That drd2_docking figure is effectively a saturated objective and the highest single-task result among the three roots examined here; the sitagliptin_mpo figure is the lowest. All observables behaved as intended and the falsifier was not triggered. The corpus prior learned well - token-normalized next-token loss fell from 4.5609 to 0.5625 on a fixed 4096-sequence holdout over 29742 steps on 1268755 sequences - and was verifiably frozen thereafter, with the prior checkpoint hash and zero prior-parameter changes recorded across all 5 initializations and all 150 updates. The update mechanism did what it claims: mean elite squared error fell from 201.89 to 110.54, decreasing in 148 of 150 updates, and mean elite sequence log-likelihood rose by +2.321 while non-elite log-likelihood fell by -1.052, confirming the update is genuinely selective rather than raising everything. All 750 training members were verified to be the current batch's top-scoring half, with zero historical replay anywhere. Generation stayed healthy: 10492 of 11632 sampled sequences were RDKit-valid, a rate of 0.902, and all 145 rounds filled a batch of exactly ten valid novel molecules with zero rejections at the evaluator.

The campaign now has a sharp picture of when elite likelihood sharpening pays. Among the thirteen Discovery roots on this seed, spanning 0.2331 to 0.5103, this sits fifth at 0.4766, but the aggregate hides the real signal: this method produced both the strongest single-objective result in this group and the weakest. Where a learnable structural motif exists and is reachable from the corpus prior, sharpening onto it is extremely effective - one objective is essentially solved. Where the reward distribution collapses, it has nothing to work with: on the weakest objective the median score across the entire run was exactly zero, its mean elite squared error was 4.94 against 735 on the objective that saturated, and the only two updates in the whole node that increased loss were both from that run. An elite half selected from ten molecules that all score zero is an arbitrary five, and the policy then drifts back to generic prior chemistry. That is a concrete, actionable characterisation of the method's failure mode and a strong argument that any Development on this lineage should target the low-signal regime - a reward transform, a ranking that survives ties, or the historical replay the root deliberately declined - rather than the update rule itself. A second caution: elite likelihood rose in only 111 of 150 individual updates even though the aggregate is clearly positive, so single updates are noisy and the mechanism works on average rather than reliably. Still open: one seed, no paired comparison, no anchor decision, and no evidence on whether the drd2_docking saturation reflects a genuinely easy objective or a policy exploiting it.

nodes.hypothesis: Law-free, ungated path divergence in the allocator stream of the stall-masked Anchor. In every announced batch, immediately before the inherited allocation consumes its own standard-normal array, draw exactly two standard-normal arrays of the inherited allocation shape (announced batch size by pool size, float64) from the posterior selector's own seeded torch generator and discard them; the unchanged allocation then consumes the next unused block of the same i.i.d. stream, and every later batch of that session reads the stream from wherever this schedule has left it. Nothing reads the discarded values and no law changes: the posterior fit over accepted scores, its fitted covariance, the jitter ladder and both Cholesky factorizations, the predictive mean and standard deviation, the K=3 non-improving counter and the M=40 top-posterior-mean eligibility mask with its restoration on the first improving batch, the sulfur gate, canonical identity admission, both duplicate scopes, retention, breeding, the seven operator families at unchanged weights and connected-fragment crossover at 0.45 with its finishing edit are all exactly as inherited, and the inherited allocation still consumes exactly one array of exactly that shape per batch. The only difference from the Anchor is which pseudo-random words the unchanged laws consume, and the departure enters the allocator stream rather than the breeding stream perturbed by n-515ab49db6e0 and n-7e8300237702. The count of two is the declared means of realizing a second, different path in the same channel and exposure class as this round's one-array ungated reference, not a parameter under study: the two panels are read only as two points of one departure distribution, and a favourable or unfavourable realization is a measurement of departure, never a gain, a loss or a candidate improvement.
nodes.finding:
The registered departure happened exactly as declared and the panel moved far more than any effect the campaign is trying to read. Every one of the 435 announced batches carries its discard receipt with two declared and two realized arrays of the inherited allocation shape, 58 per session and 870 in total, identically in the 360 unrestricted and the 75 restricted batches, so the schedule is genuinely ungated. The unchanged allocation still bought exactly ten molecules per batch from a 160-member field in all 435 batches, with no fallback anywhere. At each session's first batch the inherited state is the Anchor's: the training set, the fitted scale, the 160 pool molecules with their posterior means and standard deviations, both Cholesky factorizations and all 160 pooled breeding records match field for field, and only the ten standard-normal rows differ - which is the whole intervention. The path then departs at the earliest possible point in every single session: the first purchase of the first batch differs in all fifteen, and the first diverging evaluation is number 10, the first molecule the allocator ever buys. No inherited law moved: an independent recount of the non-improving counter agrees with the log in 435 of 435 batches, every restricted batch offered 40 minus position with not one of 750 in-regime picks outside the top forty by posterior mean, and every unrestricted batch offered 160 minus position with nothing excluded. The score consequence: 0.535228 / 0.556573 / 0.399780 against the Anchor's 0.649701 / 0.585234 / 0.586156 on the matched seeds, paired deltas -0.114473 / -0.028660 / -0.186376, panel mean -0.109836, with ten of fifteen cells down. Combined with this round's one-array companion at -0.042098, the registered two-point rule returns an ungated allocator-channel departure width of W = 0.067738 on this host, band [-0.111836, -0.040098]. That is 7.1 times the 0.009482 the same rule returned in this channel on the mask-free Parent, 2.7 times the gated allocator half-width of 0.024878 measured by the sibling arm, and 6.4 times the Anchor's entire +0.010577 gain over its own Parent. This panel's own fifteen-cell dispersion gives s = 0.236478 and a half-width of 0.122117; with the single collapsed drd2_docking seed-2 cell set aside - reported, never excluded - the fourteen-cell figures are mean -0.054974, s = 0.107709 and half-width 0.057573, close to the two-point width. By task the panel means moved +0.016916 on zaleplon_mpo, +0.000824 on median_2, -0.100669 on deco_hop, -0.163389 on sitagliptin_mpo and -0.302864 on drd2_docking, so three of the four protected task means are beyond their registered 0.03 / 0.02 / 0.02 margins and zaleplon_mpo improved. Two pre-registered cells carry almost the whole seed-0 result: the Anchor's fragile deco_hop seed 0 fell 0.856148 to 0.619312 and its fragile sitagliptin_mpo seed 0 fell 0.765861 to 0.429847, together -0.114570 of the -0.114473 seed-0 macro delta, which means the rest of that seed's panel netted +0.000097. Realized stall exposure on the departed path was 75 of 435 batches in 14 of 15 sessions over 34 episodes with a deepest run of 8, against the Anchor's 88 of 435 in 13 of 15 over 29 episodes with a deepest run of 17; in-regime increment mass fell 0.547037 to 0.254651 while mask-free mass fell 5.431036 to 4.075874. All seven registered falsifier cases pass, and none of them is a refuting clause: every one is an implementation-validity check, and the registered object explicitly declares that a high or low panel falsifies nothing.

The campaign now has the number it has been missing, and it closes the band-estimator question it registered. Neither estimator in use describes the across-realization spread on the Anchor that actually carries the arms. The Parent-hosted two-point width of 0.009482 understates it 7.1-fold and must stop being borrowed; the gated allocator half-width of 0.024878 understates it 2.7-fold, which is unsurprising because a gated reference only perturbs restricted batches. Only the ungated same-channel, same-host pair may be combined, and the two points it gives are 0.067738 apart. Against that scale the Anchor's +0.010577 stall-time eligibility gain is not a resolvable quantity: it is 0.16 of the width, and both law-free realizations in its own channel and exposure class moved the panel by more than its whole margin while changing no rule at all. Its margin is also structurally the kind of thing this width destroys - it lived in two sitagliptin_mpo cells, and a pure path change took 0.336014 and 0.139516 out of those same cells. Of the component effects earlier rounds measured on this Anchor, the structural admission floor at -0.043178 (0.64 of W) and the guarded-draw arm at -0.060755 (0.90 of W) are not separable from path realization at all; distance amplification at -0.081702 (1.21 of W) sits inside the interval the two realizations bracket; and only removing the sampled dispersion entirely at -0.126894 (1.87 of W) clears the width - and even that is only 1.16 times what this single law-free realization produced by itself. The practical consequence is that every effect this Anchor has priced below about 0.07 from one panel is uncalibrated, and the campaign's 0.002 minimum effect is two orders of magnitude below its own instrument noise on this host.

The drd2_docking seed-2 cell settles what kind of object that width is. It is a legitimate realization of the registered departure, not a technical failure and not an evaluation-condition event: it started from the Anchor's own initial pool bit for bit, spent all 300 oracle calls, accepted 290 proposals with validity 1.0 and zero invalid and zero duplicate attempts, finished ok well inside its timeout with a responsive oracle returning 290 distinct finite scores, emitted all 29 discard receipts and all 290 selections with no fallback, and conformed to every inherited law including the top-forty rule. It finished at 0.0956 where this objective reaches 0.97-1.00 in every other session of the lineage, including this node's own seeds 0 and 1 at 0.9678 and 0.9817. So the registered band must carry it, and carrying it is the finding: a single fifteen-cell panel on this host can lose 0.878 on one cell, 0.0586 of a panel mean, from nothing but which pseudo-random words the allocation consumed. The departure distribution is not a narrow bell around zero that a half-width summarizes - it is bimodal on at least one objective, because the chemistry says so. The bound Molecular report traces the mode: drd2_docking's initial pool is led by a sulfonyl-capped prolinamide with no protonatable centre, worth almost nothing to the objective, and escaping it needs a specific three-edit sequence - delete the acid, delete the sulfonyl cap, insert a free amine, one step of which jumped 0.3394 to 0.6467 in a sibling seed. Seeds 0 and 1 made those edits; seed 2 made none of them, kept the intact sulfonylprolinamide in 180 of 290 proposals through evaluation 246, grew to a mean 67.7 heavy atoms where every top molecule on this objective is 27-32, and scored 0 of 290 above 0.1. Whether a session escapes the trap is decided by which pool member the first batches happen to elaborate. That is why a mean-and-half-width band misdescribes this host, and why no single-realization arm here - run or planned - can be read at the 0.01-0.07 scale: each one carries this tail, and the tail is a reachability event rather than measurement noise.

The method diagnosis follows from the same receipts, and it points away from the allocator. Three limitations are measured. First, the proposal operator set has no inverse move: its seven families replace, append, delete and insert single atoms and open, close or change bonds, so there is no graph-level removal of a capping acyl or sulfonyl group and no downhill size move, which is precisely why a capped lead stays capped and molecules grow monotonically; in the collapsed session this also produced 182 unparseable proposals and 67 sulfur-gate rejections against the Anchor's 0 and 31 on the same cell. Second, one lineage monopolises the budget once it dominates, with no second structurally distinct lineage kept alive and no cap on how much of a batch may descend from one ancestor. Third, the surrogate's own within-batch ordering is only weakly informative and is weakest exactly where the Anchor's reflex concentrates the buy: the Spearman correlation between posterior mean and realized score across purchased molecules is 0.534 over the 360 unrestricted batches but 0.345 over the 75 restricted ones, reproducing the Anchor's own 0.547 and 0.392. Fourth, and most pointed, the stall reflex that exists to break exactly this kind of plateau was disarmed by its own trigger: because the counter resets on any strict improvement of the incumbent, 12 of this panel's 30 terminated restriction episodes were ended by improvements below 0.002 and 5 by improvements below 0.0001, and in the collapsed drd2 seed-2 session all four episodes were ended by improvements of 1.6e-5 to 5.8e-5, against the Anchor's single episode in that cell ended by 0.0104. The kinds of method that could remove these are a size-symmetric, group-level proposal operator family including uncapping, fragment deletion and ring contraction; a multi-lineage or niching population scheme with a per-ancestor share cap on each batch; a progress-magnitude or progress-rate stall criterion instead of a strict inequality on the incumbent; and a ranking-based surrogate or acquisition - pairwise or listwise - rather than a mean-and-residual GP whose ordering degrades inside the restricted regime. These are mechanism classes, not parameter values, and none of them is a tweak to the discard schedule, which this node's conditions forbid sweeping.

The median_2 tension resolves into two different levels of description, both correct, and the pair says something a planner should keep. The Molecular report reads median_2 at the fragment-combination level, and there this node reproduces the Anchor's answer: all three sessions end on an N-methyl diketopiperazine fused to an indane-like bicycle and attached to an ethoxy-aryl group, built from the same two recurring fragment classes, at 0.2243 / 0.2299 / 0.2347 against the Anchor's 0.2228 / 0.2213 / 0.2424. The gated sibling's Analyze reads it at the Murcko-scaffold-identity level, and there nothing is shared. This node reproduces that independently: the top-25 Murcko scaffold sets share zero scaffolds with the Anchor's on all three seeds, and only 4, 5 and 1 of 290 optimizer-proposed molecules per session are even the same string, yet the cells land within 0.0016, 0.0086 and 0.0077 - and the gated sibling's cells landed within 0.0162 on the same objective. What the pair establishes is that median_2 is a broad degenerate plateau: a large family of distinct ring systems assembled from the same two fragment classes all cap out near 0.22-0.24 inside a 300-call budget, so the ceiling is set by what the generator can combine, not by which scaffold it finds. The planning consequences are specific. median_2 is the one cell family that is nearly immune to the allocator path at the score level while being completely reorganised at the scaffold level, which makes it the right place to read small allocator effects and the wrong place to read scaffold novelty; and a method that wants to move median_2 has to change the fragment vocabulary or the crossover's reachable set, because redirecting the search within the existing one demonstrably arrives at the same number by a different route. Two realizations support no significance statement, this node changes no mechanism and prices no component, and the catalog's coverage obstacle on this Anchor's composition - eleven component identities still carrying needs_evidence and the composition identity still carrying an empty evidence list - is untouched by anything measured here.

nodes.hypothesis: Neutral path-divergence control at the shared K=3 stall trigger. In each announced batch allocated while the session's own consecutive non-improving announced-batch counter is at least 3, draw one standard-normal array of the inherited allocation shape (announced batch size by pool size, float64) from the posterior selector's own seeded generator and discard it immediately before the inherited correlated Thompson draw. That batch and every later allocation then consume the next unused blocks of the same i.i.d. stream. No law, probability, scale, threshold, pool size, operator or gate changes; only the realized random path departs from the Anchor at the trigger.
nodes.finding:
The control behaved exactly as registered, so its score is a valid reference. Thirteen of fifteen sessions reached the stall trigger, the same thirteen as the Anchor. The two deco_hop sessions on seeds 0 and 2 never stalled and reproduced the Anchor record for record, including its 0.856 deco_hop seed-0 endpoint. Over all 435 announced batches the logged stall counter matched a recomputation from the run's own scores. The extra random block was drawn and thrown away in exactly the 104 stalled batches (32 stall episodes, against the Anchor's 91 batches in 29) and in no other batch. Every session matched the Anchor in every scored molecule and every logged internal step up to its first stalled batch. At that batch, in all thirteen sessions, the candidate pool and its predicted means and uncertainties were identical to the Anchor's. The thrown-away block was bit-for-bit the block the Anchor had used, and replaying the Anchor's rule on it reproduced the Anchor's ten picks, while the run's own picks differed. From there the search left the Anchor's path. Every one of the 104 stalled batches picked differently from its same-state replay, with on average 6.3 of 10 molecules different. Only 83 of 2,337 molecules scored after divergence (3.6%) also appear in the Anchor's session, inside the 2.3 to 6.1% of the round-38 stall-gated arms. The selection rule itself did not move. The shift in where picks fell on the predicted-mean and uncertainty rankings gave test statistics of -1.45 and +1.24, far inside the 3.26 bound. Every pool held 160 candidates and no batch fell back to the backup route.

On the score panel the matched mean went from 0.596453 to 0.594718, a reference delta of -0.001735. Seed macros moved by -0.0127, -0.0006 and +0.0080. Under that small mean the individual cells moved a lot. On the down side, zaleplon seed 0 fell 0.034, sitagliptin seed 1 0.018, sitagliptin seed 0 0.013 and drd2 seed 0 0.010. On the up side, sitagliptin seed 2 rose 0.041, zaleplon seed 1 0.009, median_2 seed 1 0.005 and drd2 seed 2 0.004. Five cells rose, eight fell and the two never-stalled cells were exactly unchanged. The population SD of the fifteen cell deltas was 0.0154, and the thirteen cells the gate can reach average -0.0020. Dropping any single cell moves the reference anywhere from -0.0048 (without sitagliptin seed 2) to +0.0006 (without zaleplon seed 0). Re-drawing the exact same state at each session's first stalled batch gave a summed incumbent gain of 0.158, against the Anchor's 0.166. Both had nine offspring beating the best score held at announcement, with batch mean scores of 0.334 and 0.339. Across the whole run the gain proxies drifted slightly down although no rule changed. Positive gain over the best parent was 16.88 against 17.25, parent-beating offspring numbered 624 against 648, and mean offspring score was 0.3700 against 0.3720. Incumbent gain inside stalls was 0.579 over 104 stalled batches against 0.477 over 91. Both runs broke a stall in about 28% of stalled batches.

Under the interpretation rule fixed before the run, a reference delta within plus or minus 0.002 means the two round-38 stall-gated gains stand above a single path realization: +0.0076 for longer mutation walks during stalls and +0.0047 for a fourfold candidate pool during stalls. That is the registered answer. The run itself gives three reasons to hold it loosely.

First, the near-zero panel mean is a cancellation. Changing nothing but luck moved single cells by up to 0.04 and seed macros by -0.013 to +0.008. That seed-level spread of 0.021 is as wide as the whole span of the four round-38 panel deltas (0.022). Averaging three seeds narrows noise at the panel level, but one panel cannot show by how much. Leaving out one cell puts the reference anywhere between -0.005 and +0.001. One null panel is a single draw from the path-noise distribution, not its width, so the margin by which +0.0047 clears it is not a calibrated margin.

Second, the cell both gated gains lean on, sitagliptin seed 1, fell by 0.018 under pure re-drawing, while sitagliptin seed 2 rose by 0.041. A gain at sitagliptin seed 1 is therefore not an automatic by-product of leaving the Anchor's path at the trigger. Swings of a few hundredths in single cells, in either direction, are.

Third, proxies drift with no rule change. This control lost 24 parent-beating offspring and 0.37 of positive parent-gain mass, so proxy differences of that order between arms are within what a re-draw alone produces and cannot be read as mechanism.

The exact same-state first stalled batch is now calibrated as well. The Anchor's draw and this re-draw are two independent samples of the same rule on the same state, and they agree closely: 0.166 and 0.158, with nine offspring beating the best score in each. The first-batch increments of 0.126 to 0.166 in the longer-walk, crossover-off and wider-noise arms sit at this noise level. The fourfold-pool arm's 0.268, with 15 such offspring, stands apart from both draws. That is the clearest same-state sign that one round-38 change did something different at the moment it switched on.

The chemistry assessment is consistent with the size of those cell-level swings. In four of the five objectives the best molecules concentrate on one dominant scaffold, and late progress is largely halogen and substituent permutations on it. Which permutation a re-drawn path happens to reach can therefore decide a cell's endpoint by a few hundredths.

Still open: a reference that perturbs the breeding random stream rather than the allocator's, and repeated reference arms or more seeds to estimate the spread of the panel delta rather than one draw of it. This reference also does not calibrate Children that leave the Anchor from the first batch, such as the continuation removal (-0.031) or the always-on fourfold pool (-0.016). Those also give up the deco_hop seed-0 realization that a gated design never touches, so they would need an ungated neutral control. The route's review conditions end this arm with this one panel. The companion stall-time noise-contraction arm should be read against it, and recorded as unidentified if its delta falls inside this reference.

nodes.hypothesis: Reduce the scored CMA generation target to the smallest whole number of evaluator-announced batches containing at least two offspring, so accepted feedback updates the inherited Gaussian after each complete protocol batch whenever that batch already contains at least two members.
nodes.finding:
Every completed batch immediately updated the Gaussian, and the next batch used that updated distribution. For each of the five tasks, accepted offspring waited through zero further batch emissions before their update, versus a mean of 0.5 emissions among updated Parent offspring. The Parent also left 10 accepted offspring per task in an unfinished terminal generation; the Child left none. Feedback changed the distribution used for the next proposals after 28 of 28 nonterminal batches, up from 14 of 28. Each task completed 29 updates, including one terminal update with no later proposals. The frozen representation and update equations were preserved, and all rank, covariance, path, step-size and sampling checks passed. Nevertheless, the seed-0 mean of final best scores fell from 0.302617 to 0.280194, a change of −0.022423 rather than the predicted gain of at least 0.002. zaleplon_mpo fell from 0.443203 to 0.363235, deco_hop from 0.610746 to 0.603856, drd2_docking from 0.063511 to 0.029010, and median_2 from 0.208415 to 0.198819. sitagliptin_mpo improved from 0.187211 to 0.206051. Both runs used all 300 evaluations per task. Raw Gaussian decodes rose from 4,800 to 9,280 across the suite; recorded suite time rose from 43.68 to 97.64 seconds, including oracle and runtime variation.

Removing the measured feedback wait did not solve the score limitation in this replica. More updates also meant smaller selected populations: effective selection mass fell from 5.94 to 3.17, and average covariance movement per update decreased on every task. Thus update count is insufficient evidence of stronger or more useful adaptation. The docking trajectory makes the distinction concrete: 25 of its 29 generations contained tied scores, and one update had weighted score enrichment of only about 2.6 × 10⁻¹³ despite moving the Gaussian. The molecular assessment still finds oversized hydrocarbons, repeated imine or sulfur linkers, and elaborate carbonyl-bearing rings, with limited controlled variation of conventional scaffolds. Faster reaction to the available scores did not resolve those generator limitations. This supports investigating the representation and the informativeness of sampled regions alongside adaptation cadence. It does not establish which caused the score loss, whether the smaller selection mass increased harmful noise, or whether the result generalizes beyond the single paired seed.

nodes.hypothesis: Conditionally normalize the unchanged selected current-and-historical augmented likelihood targets by a single shared offset: for a_i = frozen_prior_log_likelihood_i + 60 * accepted_score_i, fit t_i = a_i - max(0, logsumexp_j(a_j)) over the actual selected training union, preserving equal row weights, pairwise target differences and every target when its joint probability mass is already at most one.
nodes.finding:
The intended target and learning changes occurred. Of 430 recorded updates, 232 needed normalization. All 232 removed excess joint target probability mass, eliminated all 1,252 individually positive log-probability targets, preserved the differences between selected targets within the registered tolerance, and changed the combined learning gradient. The other 198 updates retained their targets exactly and had identical projected-target and raw-target gradients. Among the 219 history-bearing positive-offset updates followed by a successful proposal batch, pooled projected mean squared error fell from 164.659 to 9.544 and decreased in every update. Current-example error fell from 311.898 to 13.978 and historical-example error from 17.421 to 5.110. Individual historical errors still worsened in 288 of 1,095 exposures. The raw-target error, measured at those same before/after policy states, rose from 263.347 to 286.769; the optimizer was fitting the changed objective.

Search reliability deteriorated despite those fitting gains. Thirteen of fifteen task replicas completed their 300 evaluations. Docking seeds 0 and 2 stopped at 260 and 140 evaluations because the policy could not refill a valid novel batch. In their final failed requests, 60,076 of 65,544 draws and 65,553 of 65,568 draws did not terminate. The child therefore has no complete three-seed macro mean. The sole complete seed scored 0.527720 versus its parent’s 0.514385, a paired gain of 0.013335. Among tasks completed in all three seeds, mean final-best score increased from 0.459183 to 0.471568 for zaleplon and from 0.601097 to 0.718554 for scaffold hopping, stayed at 0.218884 for median similarity, and fell from 0.288538 to 0.286001 for sitagliptin. These completed-task results cannot establish the proposed three-seed macro improvement.

Removing impossible selected-target demands is sufficient to change the learner, but insufficient to preserve useful generation. Across the same 415 successful suggestion positions, the child used 73,384 raw draws versus 35,144 for the parent. Its duplicate fraction fell from 38.92% to 10.33%, while its unterminated fraction rose from 0.003% to 44.21%; the two failed requests add a further 131,112 draws. Lower duplication therefore did not mean a more productive sampler. Both updates immediately before those failures reduced projected fitting error and had measurable gradient changes, so successful normalization and fitting do not rule out loss of sequence completion. The evidence identifies a failure in the resulting proposal distribution, but does not isolate which token changes caused it.

The condition itself has strong controls: all three median-similarity sessions and two sitagliptin sessions never needed normalization and reproduced their parent molecule-and-score trajectories exactly. Every trajectory that changed first diverged after a positive-offset update. In the useful history-bearing opportunities, the common shift reversed 722 selected rows from upward likelihood pressure to downward pressure, even though their relative target preferences were preserved. This narrows the unresolved question to what the shifted regression does to shared sequence-model support, including termination and molecules outside the fitted union. The supplied chemistry assessment finds recognizable compact aromatic and basic-amine families among the leaders alongside attachment drift, excessive chain or ring growth, and absent stereochemical specification. A necessary probability bound on selected strings does not resolve those chemical limitations. The completed-task gains justify studying the conditional target effect further only with generation reliability and useful chemical transfer measured alongside fitting.

nodes.hypothesis: During unlabeled prior training, mix each selected molecule's supplied SMILES with one cached, deterministic atom-rooted SMILES view whose canonical/isomeric molecular identity is verified, exposing the unchanged recurrent model to equivalent attachment contexts while keeping online learning and sampling unchanged.
nodes.finding:
Across three preparations, changed equivalent views appeared 10,938,511 times and contributed 553,572,420 target tokens to real training batches. Reconstructing all 3,629,346 cached row/view pairs and every training tensor receipt found no identity, token round-trip, length, or holdout-membership violation. The fixed panels contained 11,774 changed views. Their alternate NLL fell from 4.5739 to 0.7043 nats per alternate token. Under the same independent checkpoint comparison, alternate NLL improved from the parent's 1.6256 to 0.7043, while original-string NLL worsened from 0.5638 to 0.6004. The alternate-minus-original full-sequence NLL gap narrowed from 55.16 to 6.61 nats per changed molecule. Each preparation finished 29,742 training batches; mean preparation time rose from 243.5 to 902.0 seconds, with a 401.8 MiB temporary cache. On the same 14 completed tasks, raw validity fell from 90.24% to 86.55%, duplicates fell from 29.22% to 23.47%, and novel draws rose from 61.01% to 63.08%. Mean accepted scaffold counts stayed similar (218.4 to 217.2), while late scaffold concentration increased. The two completed paired seeds scored 0.51444 versus 0.51394, a mean change of +0.00050; their individual changes were -0.00199 and +0.00300. The third DRD2 run stopped at 170 evaluations because an emitted aromatic string changed canonical form when reparsed, activating the unchanged feedback-provenance guard. Its incomplete task leaves the three-seed macro score unavailable. All logged online updates preserve the frozen prior and original accepted replay strings.

Equivalent traversal exposure reached the training loss and transferred to held-out alternative strings. The smaller serialization preference is supported by improved alternate likelihood, while the loss on the supplied strings makes the tradeoff visible. This narrows the bottleneck: adding sequence contexts can improve traversal coverage without delivering reliable chemical search improvement. Lower duplicate rates did not translate into broader accepted scaffold coverage; invalid draws increased and late chemical families became more concentrated. The chemistry still favors conventional aromatic amine and carbonyl families, with unresolved attachment placement, extreme-size tails and reactive outliers. No missing stereochemical information was recovered. The available score changes are mixed and the completed-seed mean gain is below the registered 0.002 effect; the failed third task prevents the full intended score comparison. The specific canonicalization key mismatch identifies a separate robustness gap in the inherited feedback interface. Preparation stayed within the existing deadline and retained the same number of training batches, so lost training steps do not explain this outcome. Whether improved equivalent-string likelihood can preserve original-string quality and improve useful chemical coverage remains open.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove only immediate access of the newest nonempty accepted observe cohort to both breeding-parent consumers by using the original bounded greedy population from immediately before that cohort; release a cohort after the next real nonempty accepted cohort, while ordinary current survival and full accepted-archive GP learning remain immediate.
nodes.finding:
The delay operated in all fifteen task/seed runs. None of 110,134 parent draws used the newest accepted cohort, although 2,522 newly accepted molecules had positive support under the immediate current-population law. Later recursion remained active: 2,409 accepted offspring eventually bred, producing 4,031 accepted products with generated parents. All 435 full-archive predictor fits and all 435 fresh pools completed. Maturity did not guarantee use: 841 retained offspring never received positive support and another 56 supported offspring were never drawn. The final 150 offspring lacked a future maturation event; the preceding 150 matured only at terminal feedback and had no subsequent breeding opportunity.

Mean final Top-1 fell from 0.595670 to 0.543300, a paired change of -0.052370 against the registered 0.002 scale. Seed macro changes were -0.115073, -0.011259 and -0.030776. Ten task/seed endpoints declined and five improved: the exceptions were two zaleplon runs, two median-similarity runs and one decoration-hopping run. Docking and sitagliptin declined in every seed. Seed macro population SD decreased slightly, from 0.026593 to 0.024744.

Strict offspring-versus-best-parent wins increased from 629 to 877, but mean absolute offspring scores fell from 0.385256 to 0.321667 and mean best-generating-parent scores fell from 0.470456 to 0.384678. Incumbent advances fell from 258 to 219, with total increment magnitude decreasing from 5.807663 to 5.022119 across the fifteen searches.

Prompt reuse contributes beyond simply allowing accepted offspring to breed eventually, under this fixed optimizer, feedback cadence and evaluation budget. Full learning from new scores remained immediate, so withholding those labels from the predictor does not explain this contrast. The previous static-initial experiment established the value of recursive access overall; this result adds a narrower timing answer while preserving that earlier finding.

More local parent wins are compatible with worse search when breeding sources themselves have lower scores. Similar numbers of distinct reused offspring also conceal shallower scored ancestry: maximum depth fell from 23 to 14. These observations narrow the explanations, but do not establish that ancestry depth, source quality or molecular age caused the endpoint loss. Support, ranks, sampling probabilities, random consumption and subsequent adaptive histories all changed together.

The molecular assessment found rich ring systems, useful amine and carbonyl arrangements, and seed-dependent scaffold families in both runs, alongside recurring reactive heteroatom-halogen bonds, difficult ring geometries and unspecified stereochemistry. Chemically mixed alternatives and task-specific improvements remain visible. The timing contrast identifies no chemical mediator or general shortage of rings or functional groups. Whole-foundation value, interaction with the separate learner control, and reliability beyond these three matched seeds remain open.

nodes.hypothesis: Sever recursive accepted-offspring breeding feedback by fixing every breeding-parent draw and breeding-cohort availability check to an immutable copy of the ordinary initial usable score-ranked population, while preserving active posterior learning from all real accepted observations and the live survivor updates used for tracking and reporting.
nodes.finding:
Every one of 122,044 Child parent draws came from the unchanged initial cohort; no accepted offspring became a breeding parent. The Parent used accepted offspring in 105,073 of 110,295 draws. All fifteen task/seed sessions matched through their first complete batch, then diverged at the first parent, pool member and evaluated molecule of batch two. Generated offspring still entered the live survivors and the full score archive. All 435 accepted-label posterior fits and original sampled-maximum allocations remained active. All pools filled, all three seeds completed, and no natural fallback or exhaustion occurred.

Mean final Top-1 fell from 0.595670 to 0.335464, a paired change of -0.260206 against the registered 0.002 loss scale. Seed macro changes were -0.306557, -0.273839 and -0.200221. Every one of fifteen task-seed endpoints and all five task means declined. Population deviation across seed macros rose from 0.026593 to 0.047795. Local parent beats increased from 629 to 2,007 against the easier fixed initial comparators, while incumbent improvements fell from 258 to 84. Generation also encountered more duplicate proposals: 14,385 versus 6,358.

These complete, exposed results establish positive conditional contribution of recursive offspring-to-breeder feedback within the current optimizer, even while accepted-label posterior learning remains active. The initial cohort contains ten molecules, but only five have positive support under the inherited unexcluded quantile law. Fixing that breeder holds membership, ordering and cohort size together; this experiment cannot apportion their effects or isolate the survivor rule. It also leaves the broader whole-foundation question open. Separate component removals and shared-Parent siblings cannot be added into a joint value estimate.

The local success counts illustrate why ancestry and endpoint quality must be kept separate. Beating an initial molecule becomes more common, and prediction errors are smaller on the changed evaluated distribution, yet the search makes fewer incumbent gains and ends lower. Every Child endpoint still exceeds its initial best. The molecular assessment finds useful available amines, ring closures and scaffold rearrangements alongside recurring initial amide, nitrile/carbonyl and dione organizations. Some lower-scoring Child leaders have more familiar local chemistry than the higher-scoring Parent leaders. The deficit therefore does not establish an absence of chemical novelty, require reactive motifs, or identify a chemical mediator. Scored ancestry depth one also allows unscored multistep edits and crossover finishing.

The fixed neighborhoods remained productive enough to fill all full pools under inherited bounds, although they required more attempts. No rescue from live survivors was used. Exhaustion and recovery semantics passed source and synthetic checks but were not naturally exercised. Three matched Search seeds support this descriptive conditional result; they do not establish universal reliability or value for unobserved descendants.

nodes.hypothesis: Reserve each selected rollout along its prefix path and include completed plus pending counts in UCT's exploration term, while retaining accepted-only empirical reward means; release each reservation when the rollout is discarded or its observation resolves.
nodes.finding:
On the single paired screening seed, pending work changed 4,361 of 5,834 branch decisions with a choice between eligible children (74.75%). Of these changes, 3,961 came from altered UCT rankings among completed children; another 400 involved priority for children without completed observations. All 2,900 reservations resolved exactly once, without negative counts, leaks or changes to completed reward statistics. Mean concentration of evaluated rollout-start prefixes fell from 0.809379 to 0.117517 across 145 batches, and distinct prefixes per ten-molecule batch rose from 1.73 to 9.54. Single-prefix batches fell from 76 of 145 to zero, with lower concentration on all five objectives and every paired batch. Both runs delivered all 1,450 valid, unique optimizer proposals within the same oracle budget and retained identical frozen prior weights. The macro final Top-1 score nevertheless fell from 0.479189 to 0.473468, a decrease of 0.005720. Final scores rose for zaleplon_mpo (0.394920 to 0.409811), drd2_docking (0.977922 to 0.999998), and median_2 (0.179942 to 0.180094), while deco_hop fell from 0.606003 to 0.580076 and sitagliptin_mpo from 0.237157 to 0.197364. The proposed allocation mechanism is confirmed; its expected positive score effect was not observed.

Delayed-feedback concentration is controllable with the existing frozen generator and accepted-only reward estimates. The controlled replay establishes that outstanding work changes actual choices, and the emitted-molecule analysis establishes that the added branch coverage survives invalid, duplicate and surplus filtering. However, almost complete dispersion across ten starting prefixes did not produce a better overall best molecule within the screening budget. This leaves the useful balance between branch reuse and wider allocation open; the score losses do not establish that reservations are generally harmful. The molecular assessment found broadly diverse ring chemistry comparable to the Parent, with useful amine and heteroaromatic motifs already reachable but inconsistent control of their arrangement and whole-molecule growth. That narrows the unresolved problem to obtaining and refining useful chemical combinations: a larger count of distinct SMILES prefixes alone does not establish better chemical coverage. These structural observations suggest an explanation to investigate, not a demonstrated cause of the score decrease. One seed supports activation and a mixed score outcome, without establishing reproducibility or which degree of allocation spread would improve final Top-1.

nodes.hypothesis: At each existing-child selection, let C be exactly the eligible occurrence children the Parent supplies to _rows, including the fixed-root choices when parent_id=0. For canonical sibling count-Morgan vectors x_i, use K_ij=(x_i dot x_j)/(x_i dot x_i+x_j dot x_j-x_i dot x_j), with K_ii=1 and the inherited value 1 when the denominator is nonpositive. Use radius 2, 2048 bins and chirality exactly as inherited; include every eligible sibling with no bandwidth fitting, neighbor cutoff or descriptor filter. Compute D_i=sum_{j in C} K_ij*N_j, S_i=sum_{j in C} K_ij*W_j, and P_i=sum_{j in C} K_ij*O_j. Q_i^K=S_i/D_i if D_i>0, otherwise selection uses the neutral default 0.5. Pending counts never enter S_i or Q_i^K. Give unvisited priority exactly when D_i+P_i=0; otherwise index_i=Q_i^K+0.5*sqrt(2*log(max(2,N_parent+O_parent))/(D_i+P_i)). Preserve earliest occurrence ID ties. This changes the selection evidence unit from isolated branch returns to kernel-weighted sibling returns; the weights describe correlated support, not independent samples or an observed objective label on an unscored graph. Stored N,W,O and receipt IDs remain route-local, and widening still reads the original N+O.
nodes.finding:
All fifteen sessions completed, and the registered mechanism occurred. Completed sibling evidence entered 15,812 sparse decision rows and changed 3,610 of 5,754 choices below the virtual root. Of those changes, 3,545 had positive completed sibling support on the selected prefix and reached 2,737 real evaluated descendants. Exact route credit and pending separation were preserved. Whole-panel incumbent-increment mass rose from 1.4670 to 1.5468 over the same 4,350 evaluations; late-half mass rose from 0.5724 to 0.7353, although both panels had only 12 late improvements. The endpoint mean rose from 0.306290 to 0.311613, a paired gain of 0.005323. This exceeded the +0.002 mean threshold against the code Parent, but two of three seed macros and four of five task means fell. Zaleplon and sitagliptin regressions exceeded their task margins. Against the formal Anchor, the mean remained lower by 0.295417 and all five task-safety comparisons failed. These performance limitations do not negate the observed activation or trigger the registered routing/conversion falsifier.

The earlier lack of shared evidence is now ruled out as an implementation explanation: sibling sharing changed real deeper routes without inventing returns, and retained-prefix gain increased. The borrowed kernel estimator and completed-versus-pending separation both operated, but their molecular adaptation supplies no guarantee that structurally similar siblings have similar terminal returns. More effective density also did little to remove actual singleton feedback: 10,518 of 13,049 deeper occurrences still ended with one return, versus 10,584 in the Parent. Reuse became more repeated on fewer prefixes, and a single late docking return through changed deeper choices supplied 0.3766 improvement mass. The gain therefore demonstrates a real reachable improvement while leaving reliability across tasks and seeds unresolved. Root selection also changed in 4,271 of 4,350 decisions, so this experiment cannot assign the endpoint gain specifically to deeper sharing, or separate value smoothing from the shared exploration density. The search remains broadly exploratory rather than scaffold-collapsed: it generated 2,481 typed and 1,832 generic scaffold identities, while within-batch structural similarity fell on every task. Molecular assessment shows that useful organized ring and polar-group arrangements coexist with more tiny fragments (469 versus 350), persistent oversized assemblies (450 versus 472), reactive linkages and unspecified stereochemistry. Together with the largely singleton real visits, this points to a limitation in sustained, chemically coherent refinement rather than missing scaffold capacity. A search scheme that repeatedly develops observed promising descendants, or proposal operators that preserve useful local arrangements, is the kind of method change that could address that limitation; this panel does not establish which would work. The result supports this fixed sharing intervention on its registered activation and aggregate-conversion criteria, leaves the Parent verdict intact, and does not settle the broader tree-search approach or any unchanged component contribution.
