nodes.hypothesis: Evolve a task-local population of scored molecular graphs by sampling breeding parents across high-ranked score quantiles, generating de novo offspring with graph crossover and atom/bond mutation, and greedily retaining the highest-scoring observed survivors after each feedback batch.
nodes.finding:
Macro mean 0.4917 on the single screening seed, with per-task finals of 0.5989 on deco_hop, 0.9051 on drd2_docking, 0.2083 on median_2, 0.3315 on sitagliptin_mpo and 0.4145 on zaleplon_mpo. All four pre-registered observables moved in the intended direction and the falsifier was not triggered. Parent selection was strongly score-directed: across 2225 breeding selections the mean topness percentile was 0.883 against a uniform baseline of 0.5, an enrichment of +0.383, and all three declared quantile bands were used on every task. Both operator families produced offspring on every task, with crossover behind 0.439 and atom/bond mutation behind 0.743 of the 1450 emitted molecules; 74 outer retries were needed for 1524 attempts. Feedback demonstrably changed the search: 1025 offspring were admitted to the population immediately, 432 distinct admitted offspring were later chosen as parents 2084 times, and reuse began in batch 2 on every task. Final population best rose above initialization everywhere, most sharply on drd2_docking (0.0190 to 0.9051) and sitagliptin_mpo (0.0021 to 0.3315). The one weak number is local improvement: only 201 of 1450 offspring, or 13.9 percent, strictly beat their best breeding parent, and the mean child-minus-best-parent difference was -0.084.

The campaign now has a strong, cheap baseline. Against the thirteen Discovery roots on this seed, which span 0.2331 to 0.5103, this root sits third at 0.4917, within 0.019 of the best method in the round, and it did that with no pretraining, no corpus-trained generator, no surrogate and no learned policy. That reframes what the more elaborate lineages have to justify: any learned component now has to earn its place against direct selection on task-local scores, not against a naive baseline. The interesting tension is that activation was clean while efficiency was not. Roughly six in seven oracle calls went to molecules that did not beat the parent that made them, and the mean offspring was worse than its parent, so the strong result comes from occasionally getting lucky at scale rather than from reliably climbing. That is precisely the bottleneck a proposal-filtering mechanism would attack, and it is the most concrete Development target this root produces. What is still open: one seed only, so no reliability claim and no anchor decision; no paired comparison against any other algorithm; and the retry machinery was never stressed, since the longest rejection streak was two, so behaviour on an exhausted or hostile neighbourhood is untested.

nodes.hypothesis: Recover the recorded post-adaptation left-inverse crash by promoting the loaded task-local sequence flow and its continuous recurrent forward/inverse latent calculations from float32 to float64, with dtype-compatible probe assignment and unchanged strict token reconstruction checks.
nodes.finding:
On the screening seed, all five objectives complete 300 evaluations. The two sessions that previously stopped at 150 and 240 evaluations now finish, bringing the total from 1,290 to 1,500. All 300 reconstruction checks preserve the full padded token sequence and canonical molecule: 46,500 of 46,500 observation-check instances match exactly. At the former failure points, maximum continuous inverse error falls from 0.405526 to 0.000005301 on drd2_docking and from 0.404005 to 0.00000001510 on median_2. Preparation produces the identical checkpoint. All 150 online adaptations execute their original 24 steps, every GP fit uses freshly encoded observations, PMI still favors informative token blocks, and posterior uncertainty still affects selection. Every emitted batch contains ten valid novel molecules. The completed macro score is 0.419751565. All 1,290 shared trajectory records match the parent exactly, and the additional 210 evaluations produce no new task best. Because the parent lacks a complete macro score, these results establish numerical recovery without establishing a paired macro-score gain.

The result supports finite-precision recurrent inverse drift as a recoverable implementation bottleneck: strict equality survives without omitting padding, dropping observations, or skipping adaptation. It does not identify the original mismatched token positions, so a padding-only explanation remains unproven. Numerical recovery also leaves the main search-quality questions intact. Nominal 95% GP intervals cover only 466 of 1,450 outcomes (32.1%); coverage on the 1,240 shared predictions is unchanged at 444 outcomes, and only 22 of the 210 added predictions are covered. In addition, 97.6% of examined decodes reproduce their generating center. The molecular assessment finds the same narrow high-scoring families and recurring unusual charged heteroatoms and chain growth, with weak chemical plausibility. These findings make surrogate calibration and useful, chemically credible local variation worth probing independently. Recovery is demonstrated for this seed and checkpoint under the existing budget; continuous inverse error still reaches 0.004864 in one successful check, so exact reconstruction here does not establish stability for arbitrary future histories.

nodes.hypothesis: Law-free breeding-stream path divergence on the stall-masked Anchor. At the start of every announced batch, directly after the batch counter increments and before the inherited stall-state computation, the GP fit and the first breeding decision, draw exactly one value with random() from the Evolution's own seeded random.Random(seed) generator, which GraphOperators shares, and discard it. That generator drives quantile parent and rank sampling, the crossover-versus-mutation and finishing coins, walk length and every operator, site and element draw, so all later breeding decisions consume different pseudo-random words (Python's variable-word rejection sampling can absorb the offset inside one draw, which is why the identical discard on the mask-free Parent left the seed-1 sessions at batch 1 and the other ten at batch 2 or 3). No law changes: probabilities, operator menu and weights, continuation and escalation, crossover and finishing, the sulfur gate, identity admission, both duplicate scopes, greedy-64 retention, quantile breeding, the 160 pool target, the accepted-only count-Morgan GP, the K=3 / M=40 stall-time top-mean eligibility mask with its counter and restoration rule, and the correlated Thompson allocation with its separately seeded torch generator, whose standard-normal rows stay bitwise equal to the Anchor's. Because the Anchor's mask consumes no random numbers and acts only on restricted batches, the Child is exactly the earlier mask-free breeding re-draw plus this Anchor's mask: it retraces n-1c2f17550a3e record for record until each session's first restricted batch whose top-forty picks differ from that reference's, and is a new realization of the Anchor's own law thereafter. The claim is a measurement, not a gain: the complete matched panel delta against the Anchor is what law-free path departure costs on this Anchor, and its two fragile cells either survive the re-draw or do not.
nodes.finding:
The placebo ran exactly as registered. Every one of the 15 runs drew and threw away one breeding random number at the start of each of its 29 rounds (435 in total). The discard was always the round's first logged step, and the round-1 values were the predicted ones for each seed. No rule moved. The selector's own random numbers matched the Parent's bit for bit in all 4,350 picks, and every pool held 160 candidates. The stall counter, the top-forty restriction, the model fits, the sulfur gate, the duplicate checks and the operator, crossover and finishing rates all conformed to the inherited rules. The picks also sat at the same places in the predicted-score and uncertainty rankings as the Parent's: shift statistics +0.44 and -0.17 against a bound of 3.26.

Every forecast made before the run held exactly. Each run copied the earlier luck-only run (the same placebo on the previous Parent, which had no stall reflex) molecule for molecule. It did so until the first stalled round in which the top-forty restriction changed a pick, and then went its own way. The predicted split round, the predicted first different molecule and the predicted number of displaced picks matched in all 15 runs. That gives 2,197 of 4,500 scored molecules identical to the earlier run, as forecast. Against the Parent itself, every run left the Parent's path at the predicted point: evaluation 11 on seed 1 and evaluations 21-32 on seeds 0 and 2. Only 2.2% of the molecules scored after that point also appear in the Parent's same run. The stall restriction now fired in all 15 runs, including the two deco_hop runs that never stalled on the Parent, from round 9 and round 18. In total it restricted 87 rounds in 28 episodes, against the Parent's 88 rounds in 29 episodes, with 13 rounds at depth six or more against 19.

Scores: the panel mean was 0.586579 against the Parent's 0.607030, a reference delta of -0.020452. Seed macros moved -0.0614, +0.0011 and -0.0011; 8 cells rose and 7 fell, with a cell SD of 0.0678. The registered value R4 would take if the restriction were neutral on this path was -0.020465. Neither lucky cell reproduced. Deco_hop seed 0 ended at 0.6077 instead of 0.8561. This run was level with the Parent through evaluation 280 (0.6077 against 0.6096) and never made the Parent's single jump at evaluation 281. Sitagliptin seed 0 ended at 0.6702 instead of 0.7659. This run stood at 0.5019 at evaluation 153 and reached 0.6702 at evaluation 211. By evaluation 153 the Parent was already at 0.6484, and it climbed to 0.7235 by evaluation 280 and 0.7659 at evaluation 282. Those two cells cost -0.0229, more than the whole panel loss; the other 13 cells average +0.0029. The cells in task order (zaleplon, deco_hop, drd2, median_2, sitagliptin) are: seed 0 +0.0061, -0.2485, +0.0169, +0.0140, -0.0956; seed 1 +0.0103, -0.0100, -0.0087, +0.0011, +0.0129; seed 2 -0.0349, -0.0132, +0.0196, -0.0151, +0.0383. Two cells, drd2 seed 2 and sitagliptin seed 1, ended exactly at their pre-departure floors.

The pre-registered reading rule gives this Parent its own luck band: -0.020452 with half-width 0.035031. An ungated whole-run panel on this Parent now stands above path luck only above +0.014579, and below it only under -0.055482. The borrowed band was -0.050871 to +0.031095. For median_2 the band is -0.000011 with half-width 0.013750, i.e. -0.013760 to +0.013739; the borrowed one was -0.007767 to +0.006695. Among the protected tasks, deco_hop fell 0.0905 (0.6168 against 0.7074), far beyond its 0.02 margin, and all of that loss comes from seed 0. Drd2_docking (+0.0093), sitagliptin (-0.0148) and zaleplon (-0.0062) stayed inside their margins. Median_2 was unchanged at 0.228819 against 0.228830, with cells +0.0140, +0.0011 and -0.0151. Against the earlier luck-only run, which differs from this one only by the stall restriction, the panel moved +0.000013, with 3 cells up, 9 down and 3 identical.

Both of this Parent's high seed-0 cells belong to its particular path, not to its rules. A re-draw that changes no rule loses both, as every earlier arm that perturbed the pre-stall stream did. Any arm that leaves the Parent's early path therefore starts about 0.023 behind on the panel from those two cells alone, and departure by itself breaches the deco_hop must-preserve margin. The new band also moves the bar for gains. Its upper edge falls from +0.031 to +0.015, because this Parent's re-draw lands lower and its cells spread less. A median_2 task-mean change now needs to exceed about 0.014 either way to stand clear of path luck, nearly twice the borrowed width, because luck alone moved two median_2 cells by +0.014 and -0.015.

This reading and the borrowed one are two dependent views of one breeding re-draw, not two draws. They share 2,197 scored molecules and identical selector random numbers, so their widths must not be pooled into a variance estimate. One realization bounds the luck band; it does not estimate its distribution. The pairing with the earlier run differs only by the stall restriction and came out at almost exactly zero (+0.000013). So the restriction's +0.0106 gain on the Parent's own path did not appear on this one re-drawn path. That pairing is one coupled realization and prices nothing. Whether the restriction helps still needs trigger-matched evidence.

Method diagnosis, from this node's trajectories and the molecular report, in three parts. First, late search is decoration of an inherited core. Only 13.6% of the runs' total best-score gain came after evaluation 150, and the median late improvement was +0.002. In 6 of 15 runs more than half of the last 50 proposals share the scaffold of the run's best molecule. The molecular report describes one inherited aromatic core per run with substituents permuted on it. Second, the surrogate ranks well but its uncertainty is wrong in a task-dependent way. The eventual improvers sat at a median posterior-mean rank of 5 of 160, yet beat their predicted means by a median 1.4 posterior SDs, 69 of 255 by more than 3. Realized scores fell within one posterior SD for 96% of median_2 picks but only 20% of sitagliptin picks, and 334 of 870 sitagliptin picks landed more than 3 SDs below their mean. The Thompson draws therefore explore on a scale that is too wide on one task and far too narrow on another. Because the error runs in opposite directions, no single fixed noise or amplitude constant can correct it. A surrogate whose predictive uncertainty is calibrated online within each run could correct it, for example by fitting amplitude and noise or by using a heavy-tailed or recalibrated residual model. Third, there is an early path lottery. The two re-draws of deco_hop seed 0 share their first 92 molecules. Both began proposing molecules above 45 heavy atoms from evaluation 24. Their mean size passed 53 heavy atoms by evaluation 100, and their last 50 proposals averaged 68 and 79 heavy atoms of polyaromatic growth, with 103 and 269 invalid breeding attempts. The Parent's run stayed at 27-31 heavy atoms throughout. The cell's fate is set by a few early breeding draws. A proposal scheme with a size-aware acceptance envelope, or a search scheme that keeps several independent basins alive, would reduce that lottery.

By the route's own conditions no second draw or discard sweep follows, so this measurement route stops here. Still open: the band applies only to stream-perturbing whole-run arms, and mask-confined contrasts keep their trigger-matched references. This round's parallel arms are not in this brief, so reading them against the band is left to Curate.

nodes.hypothesis: Condition-scoped removal of the joint off-diagonal value and completed/pending-density consumer at parent_id == 0 AND episode > 0 after a successful fresh dual-root promotion. For each eligible root use its own N,W,M,O: D=N, S=W, B=N*M for N>0 else 0, P=O, Qbest=M for N>0 else absent, exploitation=M for N>0 else the inherited neutral default. Use the inherited beta*sqrt(2*log(max(2,N_parent+O_parent))/(N+O)) bonus when N+O>0, zero-started priority otherwise, and earliest-occurrence ties. The own N includes its one original cached context and actual episode returns; these contexts are not new oracle observations. Removing cross-origin borrowing should restore differences in actual root evidence, change competing root selections and their paid descendants, and improve current-origin and total full/late refinement. Value and density are removed together as one existing consumer; no separate mediator attribution is claimed.
nodes.finding:
The removal operated within its intended boundary. Own-root statistics differed from shared statistics in all 7,498 eligible rows, changed 374 of 3,749 root decisions in twelve of fifteen sessions, and reached 358 accepted descendants, including 228 late purchases. The initial forest, deeper sharing, two-root membership and exact receipt accounting passed reconstruction. Across all 4,350 paid optimizer observations, incumbent gain per purchase rose from 0.00093958 to 0.00105714. Over late ordinals 146–290 it rose from 0.00039798 to 0.00085398. Current origins producing any global improvement rose from 72/115 (62.61%) to 78/120 (65.00%), and their total gain increased from 1.64282 to 2.65066. All fifteen sessions completed. Mean final score rose from 0.480970 to 0.515062, a paired gain of 0.034092; all three seed means improved, while six task/seed endpoints improved, six fell and three stayed identical. The formal Anchor remains higher at 0.607030: the Child trails by 0.091968 and misses the separate Anchor +0.002 score target. Thus activation and the preregistered conversion prediction are confirmed, with the score-target falsifier separately triggered.

This isolates a conditional cost of statistical borrowing between the two promoted origins. At the registered descriptive 0.002 scale, removing that joint value-and-density consumer improves the complete mean, supporting negative contribution of the removed consumer in this composition. It does not establish that sharing is generally harmful, separate value from visit-density effects, or revise the earlier finding about adding a second origin. Nor is the result explained by giving the current origin more turns: every changed same-state decision selected the preceding origin, and current-origin purchases actually fell from 1,894 to 1,891 while preceding-origin purchases rose from 1,686 to 1,689. The current-origin benefit therefore reflects changed adaptive paths and returns, not a demonstrated matched-root causal mediator.

The aggregate gain is uneven. Two task/seed cells provide +0.51657 of endpoint-sum improvement; the remaining thirteen together lose 0.00518. Full incumbent gain is another expression of final endpoints, not independent evidence. Late gain also needs a timing qualification: one docking session supplies 62.67% of the net late-gain increase after reaching only 0.35094 at the midpoint versus the Parent’s 0.98189, then finishes slightly worse. Both registered rates improve, but this does not establish uniformly faster refinement.

The method still generates broad scaffold variation without consistently retaining productive molecular structure. Of 2,175 late purchases, 182 have fewer than six heavy atoms and 141 exceed fifty, compared with 170 and 141 in the Parent. The molecular assessment finds useful amine–aryl and carbonyl-containing arrangements among stronger products, alongside fragmentation, oversized graphs, unusual heteroatom bonds and unspecified stereochemistry. This supports a proposal-operator limitation: feedback-conditioned graph edits that preserve useful local arrangements and coherent molecular size are a missing capability to investigate. These records do not establish scaffold collapse or prove that a new operator will improve scores. The outcome settles the registered root-consumer contrast on this Search panel; separate mediators, wider transfer and the broader tree approach remain open.

The intervention reaches a modest typical redundancy opportunity, with a larger tail, and still permits related high-mean molecules to occupy the same batch. Even on identical pools, average count-fingerprint similarity increased slightly while posterior correlation decreased. Lower model correlation therefore cannot substitute for chemical diversity or score evidence. More parent-beating offspring and more incremental incumbent improvements also proved insufficient as proxies for the final endpoint.

The lower MSE describes a changed adaptive search stream; the fitted prediction model and its means remained unchanged on shared inputs. Mean conditioning supplied no new labels and did not repair the already poor uncertainty coverage. Whether real pending outcomes would support these zero-innovation constraints remains open, and unobserved counterfactual choices cannot answer it. The molecular assessment further limits the small core-coverage gain: smaller assemblies now contain many more small or tightly bridged rings, while reactive bonds and unspecified stereochemistry persist. Those output associations do not identify a chemical cause of the loss. The current exact-lock comparison supports a negative contribution from the whole fixed native-location recipe under this retained search composition; it cannot separate encoding, prior, preprocessing or hybrid-residual effects, diagnose the earlier projected recipe, or establish ranking-mediated causation. The intended count removal executed without an isolation or receipt-accounting mismatch. It increased the exploration bonus on all 6,348 rows with borrowed pending support and changed 630 of 3,743 promoted-root choices. Those changes reached 606 of 4,350 paid molecules, including 378 of 2,175 late purchases. Another origin’s unfinished reservations can suppress useful allocation even when the shared peak value and shared completed count are retained. nodes.hypothesis: Episode-bounded release of the stall-time eligibility restriction. A session-local counter of how many announced batches of the current stall episode have already been allocated with the restricted eligible set caps that restriction at five: a batch announced while the inherited consecutive non-improving counter stands at K=3 or more is restricted only while fewer than five restricted batches have been spent in this episode, and from the sixth such batch onward the inherited full 160-member availability mask is restored for every remaining batch of the episode. The inherited improving-batch reset clears both counters together, so the next episode re-arms the restriction from its own first batch and no new re-entry, escalation or hysteresis rule is introduced. The K=3 trigger, the M=40 (-posterior mean, pool index) top-mean ordering, the 160-member pool and target, the ten standard-normal rows and their shape, order and consumption count, the Cholesky jitter ladder, the residual scale, the per-pick mask update and the first-index tie rule are all exactly inherited, and a released batch runs the inherited unrestricted selection path unchanged.

In every restricted batch the eligible set was exactly the recomputed top forty of the posterior-mean ordering shrinking 40, 39, ... 31 across the ten picks; in every released batch it was the full field shrinking 160, ... 151 with nothing excluded; the logged episode counter matched an independent recount from the node's own accepted scores in all 435 batches, and the trigger, mask size, pool, draws and tie rules were untouched. Of the three cells named in advance only zaleplon_mpo seed 1 rose; zaleplon_mpo seed 0 fell 0.021514 and drd2_docking seed 2 fell 0.000091, so one of three rose and the three sum to -0.008430 where the registration required at least two rising and a positive sum. The complete matched fifteen-cell panel came to 0.606468 against the Anchor's 0.607030, a change of -0.000562 where the arm needed +0.002 and had a ceiling of +0.005298. Both of those are registered falsifier branches and both triggered, so the route is refuted as registered, with no sweep of the release length and no change of the trigger or mask size authorized. The panel number itself is not evidence of harm: it lands inside the two-point law-free band for stall-gated arms on this lineage, [-0.003735, +0.009747].

The forensics of the losing cell are the informative part. In zaleplon_mpo seed 0 the released batches lost nothing at all - they realized exactly the Anchor's own +0.010205, at the same batch, to the same incumbent 0.401968. The 0.021514 disappeared one batch later, in the first unrestricted batch after the episode, where the Anchor's breeding stream found a jump that the already-diverged stream of this node did not. The cell did not pay for the release; it paid for having a different random path after it.

The campaign can now close the exposure axis of this reflex. Both directions have been measured on the same Anchor and the same panel: holding the restriction longer lost (-0.007929, and -0.004655 again on the widened pool), and releasing it sooner moves the panel -0.000562, inside law-free path noise. The depth ledger that motivated this arm is real and reproduces exactly - the first five restricted batches of an episode realize 0.007630 of incumbent gain per batch and the batches beyond them 0.001082, a factor of seven - but it is now shown not to be causal. Releasing the mask raised the deep-tail rate to 0.003427 per batch, which is the predicted direction, and the three cells that held the Anchor's long episodes still did not recover. The correlation between stall depth and loss was a property of those particular paths, not of the unreleased mask. No further rule on when the stall-time eligibility set opens or closes is worth an experiment on this Anchor.

The pick-level attribution says why, and it is the result that transfers. The region the release exists to restore did not pay for itself: not one of the 17 newly eligible picks ranked fortieth or worse ever beat the incumbent, the best of them reached 94 percent of it, and as a group they scored a median 25 percent of the incumbent against 95 percent for the released picks that the mask would have allowed anyway. Every one of the three stall-breaking improvements in a released batch came from a pick at posterior-mean rank 0, 2, 23 or 26 - inside the top forty. So the surrogate's ranking was not wrong about its own pool; the mask was discarding candidates that really were worse, and widening eligibility during a stall buys lottery tickets at the cost of oracle calls (17 of 90 released calls went to molecules worth a quarter of the incumbent). A stall on this method is not an allocation failure inside a good pool. It is a pool with nothing better in it: six of the nine released batches had the entire 160-member field available and still failed to improve.

The molecular review independently locates the pool's limit, and it is the proposal operator, not the allocator. Once a scaffold is found the generator cannot leave it - in 7 of the 15 sessions ten or fewer Murcko scaffolds cover the top quintile of proposals, in two cells only four, and one cell produced 51 distinct scaffolds in 290 proposals - because every move is a single-atom substitution. The three cells this node changed changed decoration, not chemotype: the winner it found in zaleplon_mpo seed 1 is the same N-fluorinated brominated indole-carboxamide core as the Anchor's with different substituents, and that score plateau is reached by three distinct molecules differing only in which halogen sits where. Under those conditions the realized spread of a single cell dwarfs any eligibility rule: a reference arm that changes no law at all and only perturbs the allocator's discarded draws reaches 0.482817 in zaleplon_mpo seed 1, +0.044 over the Anchor, where this deliberate release reached +0.013176, and the same 0.482817 is reached independently by four different nodes. The eight profile-matched recordings of zaleplon_mpo seed 0 span 0.414 to 0.459, twice the movement this arm produced there.

What that makes worth trying is a change of proposal mechanism, not another selection or eligibility rule on the same pool. The method needs a scaffold-level move - core replacement or ring-system hop - and fragment-level insertion of whole substituents from a small library, so that a stall has somewhere to go, together with a novelty or diversity term in the acquisition rather than the accepted-only posterior mean, which by construction prices similarity to what has already scored. Two cheaper waste channels are measured and independent of this arm: roughly 2 percent of the oracle budget goes to proposals of six or fewer heavy atoms that return no information, and the highest-scoring region of three objectives is built on nitrogen-halogen bonds the objective does not price out, so an admission-path valence rule would change what the same budget can buy. This node also leaves a usable protocol lesson: because the restriction is state-conditioned, a bound on it reproduces twelve of fifteen cells exactly, which makes the arm's whole result a three-cell contrast - a clean design, and also a demonstration that three cells of this benchmark cannot resolve an effect of the size this mechanism family produces.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove active stable-canonical pool normalization and rejection after the inherited graph checker, routing its original checked molecular object and raw returned identity through existing novelty, pool, emission and pending interfaces while retaining the original stable-admission helper only as a passive comparator.
nodes.finding:
The removal had a real admission effect. Among 75,958 checked Child attempts, one candidate had an alternating identity string that the Parent rejected. The Child admitted its original checked graph and raw key into the final docking pool. The candidate itself was never selected, emitted or scored, and its two spellings were not shown to be graph-equivalent. Its admission substituted one pool member and shifted 104 shared positions. With the same recorded random-normal draws and unchanged marginal predictions for shared candidates, the final allocation evaluated seven different molecules. Four of those new alternatives remained in the final population; none improved the incumbent. Fourteen of fifteen complete task/seed trajectories were identical.

All fifteen task runs completed with valid unique batches, successful feedback joins and no external rejection or identity exception. Every paired final score and every best-so-far sequence stayed unchanged. Mean endpoint score was 0.595670 in both nodes, with seed population SD 0.026593; all three paired seed changes were exactly zero, within the registered 0.002 allowance. The active bypass was confirmed and the complete exposed comparison supports a conditional no-material-effect endpoint contribution for the admission component.

An unselected pool member can still change which other molecules receive evaluations. Here the pool substitution and index shift changed the correlated allocation, so equal endpoints do not mean identical search behavior. This supplies current downstream exposure that the older two unselected stable aliases lacked. The zero endpoint effect is nevertheless narrow: the sole opportunity occurred in the last batch, after the existing best score was already reached. The changed labels did not train another model or seed further breeding.

The experiment does not establish that an unstable key is safe to emit. That boundary was never naturally exercised, and the missing-provenance guard still raises in an explicitly synthetic control using real archived feedback. Nor does admission removal establish better chemistry: the altered final choices include both a high-scoring halogen-free amine and retained reactive substituents, while the broader ring-geometry and stereochemical limitations remain. Earlier identity exposure, actual selection of an unstable representation and other parser conventions remain open. The observed component result does not establish universal dispensability or effects of combining sibling changes.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove optional post-crossover finishing mutation by setting its existing probability from 0.35 to 0.0 while retaining exactly one original gate draw after every successful ordinary crossover, so its immediate product reaches the unchanged admission pipeline without a finishing call; retain ordinary single-parent continuation and every other active Parent rule.
nodes.finding:
Finishing was absent at all 35,049 successful crossover opportunities, with 12,346 retained gate draws below the old threshold. Of those exposed immediate products, 9,907 entered candidate pools and 515 reached real evaluation. All 501 nonterminal accepted products entered the next model fit; 297 later bred. Fourteen births were terminal, and 204 other accepted products had later opportunities but were never reused.

All fifteen task/seed comparisons completed. Mean final Top-1 fell from 0.595670 to 0.559427, a paired change of -0.036243 against the registered 0.002 loss threshold. Seed changes were -0.059007, +0.020922 and -0.070644; eight task/seed endpoints declined and seven improved. Decoration hopping and docking had the largest mean losses, while zaleplon and median-2 means improved. Seed population dispersion fell from 0.026593 to 0.021675 around the lower mean. Across all accepted offspring, strict parent wins rose from 629 to 689 and incumbent gains from 258 to 264, but absolute offspring and parent scores were lower and the average positive incumbent step fell from 0.022510 to 0.019939.

The complete exposed removal supports a positive contribution from optional finishing in this exact exchange-disabled search composition. Earlier whole-crossover and ordinary-continuation controls did not answer this boundary. Preserving immediate recombinants clearly delivered useful evaluated and breeding products, yet that delivery was insufficient to preserve final search quality. More local wins were measured against weaker generating parents; they cannot substitute for the endpoint comparison. The result remains conditional: the gain in one seed and seven task/seed cells rules out a uniform benefit claim.

The molecules also do not support a simple chemical-preservation explanation. Mean size and ring count increased, but distinct typed core count decreased from 1,851 to 1,749. Tiny fragments and cumulenes became less frequent, while reactive heteroatom-halogen bonds, difficult ring geometries and unspecified stereochemistry persisted alongside useful conventional alternatives. Those are observed changes, not identified causes of the endpoint loss. Observed wall time increased from about 579 to 2,868 seconds, largely alongside higher oracle time on changed molecules, so fewer finishing calls do not establish a compute saving. The separate roles of missing finishing products, altered admission and random streams, and later adaptive feedback remain unresolved. This finding closes the exact finishing contribution question under the tested conditions; it does not establish whole-foundation value or the pending ring-by-finishing interaction.

nodes.hypothesis: Replace the single fixed dot-product count-Tanimoto GP covariance with one per-fit exact-marginal-likelihood-selected convex blend K=(1-w)*T_DP+w*K_comp over the frozen grid w in {0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5} by squared lengthscale in {17/4, 17}, where K_comp is a Gaussian kernel on a fixed seventeen-feature archive-standardized whole-molecule composition/property vector and w=0 reproduces the inherited kernel exactly, then use that one selected kernel coherently in every training, cross, pool and probe Gram block for both the posterior mean and the correlated residual covariance.
nodes.finding:
The likelihood wanted the new whole-molecule view almost everywhere: 431 of 435 refits gave it positive weight, and 304 picked the largest weight on the grid (0.5). Only four early refits, with 20 to 30 molecules in the archive, kept the Parent's kernel. The preference grew as the archive grew and was strongest on sitagliptin and zaleplon. Every refit and every batch reproduced exactly when recomputed independently. Breeding and random draws were untouched: the first batch's candidate pool and random numbers match the Parent's in all 15 sessions.

On the molecules it actually tested, the blended model predicted better than the Parent's kernel would have from the same state. Error fell by about a quarter (0.0077 to 0.0058). Within-batch rank correlation rose from 0.43 to 0.54, and pairwise order accuracy from 0.67 to 0.71. Most of the gain came where the Parent's model was weakest: sitagliptin rank correlation went from about 0.18 to 0.48, and zaleplon from 0.43 to 0.59. deco_hop and median_2 barely moved, and median_2 error rose slightly in all three seeds. The improvement is about half the size the pre-registered replay suggested.

It also changed which molecules got tested. Against the Parent's kernel on the identical pool and draws, it swapped about half of each batch in 428 of 435 batches. It picked larger molecules in 14 of 15 sessions (+2.3 heavy atoms on average, +5 to +7 on deco_hop), and its batches were more self-similar in 14 of 15. The size pull comes from uncertainty, not from predicted score: the blend adds extra posterior spread to molecules at the edge of the archive's composition range, and that extra spread rises with molecule size in every session (rank correlation 0.31 to 0.65).

Scores: the complete matched mean was 0.5834 against the Parent's 0.5965, a change of -0.0131, well short of the +0.002 goal. Seed changes were -0.045, +0.008 and -0.002, and only 5 of 15 task/seed cells improved. deco_hop fell on all three seeds (task mean -0.096). That includes missing the Parent's late 0.856 breakthrough on seed 0, which by itself costs 0.016 of the mean; the other 14 cells net +0.003. On deco_hop the Child's tested molecules averaged roughly 48 heavy atoms against the Parent's 32, reaching 71 in the last third of one session, while the best deco_hop molecules have about 28; oracle time rose 7 to 36 fold. zaleplon (+0.014), sitagliptin (+0.012) and median_2 (+0.005) rose slightly, but the sign differed between seeds. drd2 finished level but progressed more slowly early (area under the curve -0.042). The Child produced more offspring that beat their own parents (860 against 648) and more new incumbents (325 against 255), yet final scores were not higher.

Fitting the weight, rather than forcing it as the earlier equal-weight atom-pair channel did, shows that the labels clearly prefer a whole-molecule composition and property view. It does make the surrogate better on objectives that depend on global properties. But this is the fourth time in this lineage that better ranking of the tested molecules has failed to produce better endpoints. Marginal likelihood selects a kernel that fits the archive, not one that searches well, and that gap is now a pattern rather than an anecdote.

The failure has a specific, traceable route. A stationary Gaussian kernel on archive-standardized descriptors gives every compositionally novel molecule fresh prior variance. Under Thompson sampling that variance becomes a novelty bonus that scales with size, and the generator can grow molecules cheaply by appending atoms. Where the score band is narrow (deco_hop sits in 0.5 to 0.62), variance dominates the draw. The search then drifts toward big, repetitive molecules that the molecular review shows are not where the score is. This rules out implementation error, grid failure or numerical fallback as explanations.

The weight sat at the 0.5 grid edge on three tasks. Larger weights are untested, but given this mechanism they would more likely amplify the drift than fix it. The more informative next step is to separate the two roles: use the composition channel for the posterior mean and keep the Parent's local kernel for the sampled uncertainty, or otherwise stop composition novelty from earning exploration credit.

Still open: whether the small zaleplon and sitagliptin gains are real, given mixed seed signs and only three seeds. Also open: how much of the deco_hop loss is the Parent's one lucky late breakthrough rather than the size drift. All three deco_hop seeds and their areas under the curve are lower, which suggests the drift matters, but the attribution is associative. Among the four same-round variants on this Parent, all lost, and this was the smallest loss; those are dependent comparisons, not a ranking of ideas.

nodes.hypothesis: Kernel-smoothed best-return exploitation. For each occurrence j, M_j is absent while N_j=0 and otherwise is max r(y) over exactly its completed accepted route receipts, including its own actual initial-root receipt. Preserve exact N_j, W_j, Q_j=W_j/N_j and O_j. At the existing sibling selector replace only mean exploitation S_i/D_i with Qbest_i=B_i/D_i, where B_i=sum_j K_ij*N_j*M_j for N_j>0, D_i=sum_j K_ij*N_j, S_i=sum_j K_ij*W_j and P_i=sum_j K_ij*O_j use the same eligible siblings and inherited count-Morgan generalized Tanimoto kernel. D_i=0 retains neutral 0.5. The exploration bonus, priority and ties remain identical. This makes previous high observed return influence route choice despite mean dilution; changed routes may receive further real feedback and improve the incumbent. Maxima and effective densities are predictive statistics, not unbiased expected values, independent evidence or invented ledger returns. A lucky historical maximum may instead concentrate repeated unproductive exploration.
nodes.finding:
The intended mechanism ran exactly. Across all fifteen matched Search cells, receipt and selector reconstruction found no discrepancies. Best-return exploitation changed 3,717 of 4,380 root choices (84.9%) and 3,305 of 7,311 deeper choices (45.2%); every cell was exposed. Those changed prefixes participated in 3,777 distinct accepted terminal evaluations and 33 incumbent improvements, contributing 1.44157 of the observed 1.77439 total gain. Root and deeper participation overlap on 1,912 terminals, so these are route associations, not separate gains or a causal mediation estimate. Global gain per optimizer evaluation increased from 0.000355590 to 0.000407906; late-half gain increased from 0.000338069 to 0.000493744. Improvement events rose from 41 to 51 overall and from 12 to 14 late. The final macro mean was 0.326785 versus the code Parent's 0.311613, a gain of 0.015171 that exceeds the frozen 0.002 minimum. Seed means were 0.385275, 0.292160 and 0.302920; their paired changes were +0.116426, -0.003835 and -0.067077. Nine task/seed endpoints improved, four declined and two tied; four task means improved while docking declined by 0.064687. Standard deviation was 0.041591 versus 0.042745. The receipt and selection falsifiers did not trigger, and the registered conversion falsifier did not trigger because both full-panel conditions improved. This does not attain the formal Anchor: every endpoint remains lower, the macro is 0.280246 below its 0.607030 mean, and the 0.609030 target remains unmet. Numerical task-safety margins were absent from the frozen request, so no safety pass/fail is asserted. All fifteen cells completed successfully.

Preserving observed branch peaks is an effective way to alter this selector, and the measured positive mean result narrows the earlier obstacle: averaging away high returns was consequential on this composition. It is not yet evidence of reliable progress across seeds. The seed-zero docking gain supplies 42.3% of all positive paired endpoint changes and exceeds the net panel gain; docking loses heavily in seed two. One terminal supplies 23.6% of all Child incumbent gain. Global gain mass telescopes to final endpoint minus initial incumbent, so its agreement with the macro is not independent confirmation. The trajectories show increased revisiting concentrated on fewer occurrences. Unique deeper prefixes selected after completed feedback fell from 2,330 to 1,971 overall and from 1,656 to 1,325 late, even as the total deeper choice count rose. Only 2,280 of 13,051 generated nonroot occurrences received more than one completed receipt, versus 2,440 of 13,049 in the Parent; 10,644 remain singletons. Thirteen supplied roots received no optimizer follow-up, compared with none in the Parent. Among 6,848 changed-choice/terminal pairs with an existing own maximum, only 366 later returns exceeded that maximum; these overlapping pairs must not be counted as independent evaluations. Remembering a peak therefore often directs more work without renewing the peak. Pending-dependent widening permissions also rose from 748 to 1,368 under the unchanged rule. A search scheme that explicitly balances repeat coverage and new expansion, or a branch-value estimator that distinguishes reproducible productive returns from isolated maxima, could address this limitation; their benefit and combination with best-return memory remain untested. The molecular report supports a proposal-quality limitation alongside this allocation pattern. Ring and scaffold diversity are available, but preservation of coherent useful architecture is inconsistent: nonempty scaffold coverage fell from 3,598 to 3,409 of 4,350 purchases, fragments below six heavy atoms rose from 469 to 609, and 401 oversized structures remained. Strong examples coexist with reactive motifs and unspecified stereochemistry. A scaffold-preserving graph proposal operator could address those observed failures; the current data do not establish a universal size cutoff or pharmacophore reward. The adopted top-return memory operated, but its molecular kernel replacement is a deliberate deviation from the published SameGame selector, so this result prices only that adaptation. It leaves transferable contribution, safety under the missing comparator, and the broader persistent-search approach open.

nodes.hypothesis: For successful FingerprintPosterior.select calls on actual code Parent n-cf8d309c06de, retain the original fitted full posterior covariance C, actual successful jitter j, actual Cholesky factor L, original score_scale s, predictive mean vector mu and original normal array Z. Preserve original P_ki=mu_i+s*(Z@L.T)_ki as passive values. Every unrestricted call continues to use P directly. Thus restricted residual allocation covariance is s^2*diag(diag(L@L.T)), with zero off-diagonals and the exact original jittered diagonal; nonzero residual influence and both mean consumers remain. Eligibility stays the exact original stable mean-ranked set, and ascending pool-index first-maximum ties and per-pick availability updates remain. The hypothesis is that removing dependence changes strict and sequential restricted choices and reaches actual purchased feedback while preserving those retained quantities. This is a conditional component removal within m-000000000007; it does not change fitted covariance, remove residuals or remove eligibility. Prior exposed removal losses motivate a conservative prediction of a conditional endpoint loss, independently of whether this removal activates.
nodes.finding:
The removal operated in 72 of 435 announcements and preserved the original predictive means, forty-candidate eligibility and marginal variances. It changed 218 of 720 restricted choices, changed 66 purchase sets and displaced 162 molecular identities; residual sampling still changed 586 restricted purchases relative to mean-only selection. Every one of the 4,350 purchases joined to actual feedback. Of the 218 changed purchases, 165 survived the batch and 57 later generated paid children; nine were censored by the final batch. The complete three-seed, five-task mean fell from 0.607030 to 0.598678, a paired loss of 0.008353. Seed macro changes were -0.006192, -0.019847 and +0.000981. Seven task/seed endpoints rose, five fell and three tied; the two unexposed cells reproduced their Parent trajectories. Full incumbent-gain mass fell from 5.978073 to 5.852783 despite improvement counts rising from 253 to 271. Late gain was almost unchanged, 1.022408 versus 1.020751 over 2,175 purchases. There was no execution failure and no registered falsifier triggered.

This answers the narrow conditional question: residual dependence still contributes after the mean-based top-forty screen and fine mean preference have already concentrated the field. At the registered 0.002 descriptive scale, the isolated removal loss supports retaining that correlation consumer on this composition. It does not establish a uniform task benefit, generalization beyond this Search panel, or attainment of the separate Anchor performance target. Later unrestricted allocations inherited the changed feedback and cannot serve as untreated controls. The method also produced more nonempty typed scaffolds (1,764 versus 1,667), lower within-batch similarity even after excluding tiny fragments (0.4635 versus 0.4780), more parent-beating purchases (660 versus 634), and lower purchased-stream mean-squared prediction error, yet less total incumbent gain. These observations rule out treating extra graph diversity, more small improvements or lower global prediction error as sufficient evidence of better endpoint search. The molecular assessment still finds local elaboration of related ring-rich families and uneven retention of functional-group alternatives; the largest losing cell expands unusual heteroatom decoration while losing an amine-bearing alternative present in its better Parent series. That is an association within divergent adaptive histories, not the demonstrated cause of the loss. A graph proposal or search scheme that preserves distinct functional-group alternatives, or a ranking model that better identifies substantial incumbent gains, is the kind of method change that could address this limitation; neither is tested here. Matched Parent Candidate timings, historical factor/RNG receipts and trusted comparative task-safety measurements remain missing. No broader mechanism claim, approach-ending decision or sibling-effect subtraction follows.

nodes.finding:
The removal ran as specified and lowered the complete mean from 0.595670 to 0.563677, a decrease of 0.031992 against the registered 0.002 scale. There were 2,851 actual self-pairs. They produced 359 immediate copies, 2,489 different graphs and three construction failures. Finishing changed 135 copies into different final identities; 224 remained rejected copies. The self channel reached 2,454 fresh pool entries and 155 real evaluations, including 27 parent wins and 14 incumbent advances. All fifteen matched task/seed runs completed with the full budget. Mean final Top-1 fell from 0.596453 to 0.468270, a paired loss of 0.128183. At each session's first restricted batch the state was identical to the Parent's - same pool molecules, same predicted means and uncertainties, same ten standard-normal rows, same scaling and the same matrix factorizations - so the exchange there is a clean same-state contrast, and it reproduced the preregistered replay forecast exactly: 46 of 130 picks changed, the molecules the restriction dropped realized 0.3055 on average against 0.3573 for the picks it kept, six of the dropped picks were tiny fragments and exactly one dropped pick was an incumbent improvement (median_2 seed 0, rank 58, score 0.1817). The molecules swapped in scored 0.4344 on average, and four of them were incumbent improvements. Over all 88 restricted batches the full-field rule replayed on the same draws would have taken 215 different molecules, of mean rank 79.8.

Inside the regime the realized magnitudes rose on every registered measure: summed best-so-far increments in restricted batches 0.547037 against 0.476561, positive gain over the generating parent 1.678700 against 1.643581, incumbent improvements 31 against 28, mean restricted-batch offspring score 0.412585 against 0.404629 and median 0.354215 against 0.346718. Gain attributable to restricted-batch offspring and their descendants rose from 0.935477 to 1.142388, and increments after the first stall from 1.039352 to 1.198010, so there is no sign of the later-batch loss that the sibling residual-contraction arm showed. Whole-run positive parent-gain mass fell slightly, 16.891241 against 17.251535, the same size of drift the round-39 neutral path reference produced with no rule change at all.

On the endpoint panel the complete matched fifteen cells rose from 0.596453 to 0.607030, a paired mean delta of +0.010577 that clears the registered +0.002 bar, with all three seed macros up (+0.006603, +0.022061, +0.003067) and the seed-macro population SD slightly tighter than the Parent's (0.0302 against 0.0340). The thirteen cells the gate can reach average +0.012204. The cell pattern is split: six cells up, six down, three exactly equal. By task the gain is sitagliptin_mpo (+0.0720 mean) with median_2 (+0.0061) and deco_hop (+0.0004) slightly up, against zaleplon_mpo (-0.0192) and drd2_docking (-0.0064). The margin is concentrated: dropping sitagliptin seed 1 (+0.1445) alone leaves +0.0010, and dropping both sitagliptin seed 1 and seed 0 (+0.0716) leaves -0.0038.

The campaign now has a clean, exactly-audited answer to the question it asked: on this Anchor the low-mean tail of a stalled candidate field is not where the stalled budget has to be spent. Removing the bottom three quarters of the posterior-mean ordering during stalls cost nothing measurable inside the regime and raised every realized in-regime magnitude, while the same-state exchange at the first restricted batch shows directly what was traded: molecules averaging 0.31 for molecules averaging 0.43, six tiny fragments removed, one genuine incumbent improvement sacrificed for four new ones. That is the mirror image of the round-38 arm that widened stalled sampling toward uncertainty and was refuted on these same pools, and it is the first evidence on this Parent that candidate eligibility - not candidate supply, not model content, not the sampling law - is a live control surface during stalls.

What the result does not establish is that the panel gain is the mechanism's. Every endpoint difference arises after divergence in a single adaptive realization, and this round's neutral path reference, which changes no law at the same trigger, moved the panel -0.0017 while swinging single cells from -0.034 to +0.041, including +0.041 on a sitagliptin cell. The +0.0106 here lies outside that reference, and unlike the reference it is positive on all three seeds, which is the strongest discriminator available; but it rests on two sitagliptin cells, and sitagliptin is precisely where pure re-drawing was already shown to swing by that much. The honest reading is that activation and direct behaviour are established, in-regime benefit is established on the registered magnitudes, and endpoint attribution is not identified by one panel.

The run also exposes the cost of refusing the source method's release rule. The restriction has no expansion and no restart: it simply holds until a batch improves. In the three cells with a long restricted episode - zaleplon seed 1 restricted from batch 13 to the end of budget (17 consecutive batches, more than half the session's evaluations), zaleplon seed 0 for 8 and drd2 seed 2 for 9 - all three lost ground (-0.0353, -0.0359, -0.0083), while every gaining cell kept its longest restricted episode at five batches or fewer. Thirteen cells and one realization cannot make that causal, but it is the one structured pattern in the cell signs, and it points at a specific, testable next step that is not an M sweep: a release or escalation rule for long stalls, which is exactly the TuRBO element this adaptation declined. It also sharpens the known boundary - holding the eligible set at the top quarter for seventeen straight batches is the regime that approaches the already measured mean-only allocation, which costs 0.116 on this Parent.

Two further things are now narrowed. First, the registered channel judgment survived its own trap: this is not a favourable composition proxy with flat realized gain, which the campaign had recorded as a refutation pattern - the composition moved and the realized increments moved with it. Second, the chemistry says why single cells can decide a panel. The molecular review of this node finds late progress dominated by halogen and substituent permutations on one scaffold per objective, with questionable groups - N-halogen bonds in 888 of 4,350 proposals, nitroso and aminal centres, unassigned stereocentres - all of which the Parent shows too, so the restriction changed which permutation was reached, not the quality of chemistry the lineage proposes. Still open: whether the gain survives a second realization, whether a release rule removes the long-stall losses, and whether this channel can be read jointly with the stall-only pool-breadth gain rather than summed with it.

nodes.hypothesis: Select fresh molecular graph edits with a single epsilon-greedy continuation-value network, advance persistent finite-horizon episodes through every matched accepted successor, and learn from accepted transitions using undiscounted episode-best improvement rewards and double-Q Bellman backups through a lagged target network.

One screening seed, macro mean 0.406692671573943, eighth among the campaign's thirteen Discovery roots on a spread running 0.2331 to 0.5103. Per objective the means were 0.7536466193285815 on the docking task, 0.6145349727054742 on the decoration-hop task, 0.33218372414937963 on the zaleplon task, 0.19512536527753646 on the median task and 0.13797267640874414 on the sitagliptin task. Every registered observable moved as intended. The graph sampler filled all 1450 acting neighbourhoods with 40 valid novel candidates each and all 20215 replay continuation neighbourhoods with eight, emitting exactly 29 batches of ten unique molecules per objective with zero invalid, duplicate or rejected proposals; an independent re-execution of 17026 distinct edit receipts reproduced every one. The temporal machinery worked: 250 episode starts, 1200 multistep continuations, and 800 accepted transitions that strictly lowered the score yet still advanced their lane, of which 666 went on to be the source of a later edit. Reward telescoping held to a maximum residual of 5.551115123125783e-17 with gamma exactly one. Of 22900 replay targets, 2685 were horizon terminals equal to reward and all 20215 nonterminal continuation terms were nonzero, mean 0.013847408184662015, so the targets genuinely differed from reward-only regression. Learning registered: mean paired Huber loss fell from 6.10635587187527e-05 to 5.3964929417511364e-05 and mean absolute temporal-difference error from 0.004401601105964189 to 0.004148056249060887, decreasing on every objective, with 1242 of 1450 individual steps improving. The learned values then drove behaviour: 1095 exploitation choices against 355 random ones, every neighbourhood showing nonconstant values, and a fixed sixteen-candidate diagnostic probe changing its preferred molecule 30 times over training. The counterweight is the sparsity of signal: 1179 of 1450 accepted transitions carried zero reward, only 271 were positive, and 2880 of the sampled continuations were predicted negative even though a true remaining episode-best gain can never be below zero.

The campaign now has a clean answer to a question it could not previously separate: correct temporal-credit machinery is not by itself worth a score. Every part of the Bellman construction was audited and held, including the exact double-Q target, the detached lagged network, reward telescoping, and the use of updated weights in subsequent decisions, and the result still lands in the lower half of the roots and below the frozen-latent swarm root that carries no learning at all. Two mechanisms explain that. The learning signal is thin, because four fifths of transitions carry zero reward under a running-best definition, so most gradient comes from the zero mass and the mean continuation term of 0.014 sits at the same scale as the residual error the network still has, which is also why nearly three thousand continuation values came out negative when the true quantity cannot be. And the search collapses: the molecules produced show that exploitation, once it finds a good core, spends its remaining budget swapping single atoms on that core, which is precisely the behaviour a value function would need a long-horizon reason to escape. For method choice this argues that direct graph editing is the right way to stay in makeable chemistry, but that pairing it with a value-learning controller adds machinery whose payoff is not visible at this feedback scale; the effort is better spent on the exploration and diversity side than on the credit-assignment side. Still open: this is a single seed with no parent and no paired comparison, so the ranking is indicative; the 216 recovered-loss links and 123 later episode-best gains after temporary losses are descriptive and do not isolate learned lookahead from ordinary hill-climbing; and whether episode-consistent randomised exploration would change the picture was deliberately left untested here.

nodes.hypothesis: Replace the pricing rule of the posterior allocation stage, and nothing else. At each announced batch the ten oracle calls are no longer the sequentially masked maxima of one correlated posterior draw over the fresh pool; each position instead takes the eligible pool member with the largest expected improvement over the session's own best accepted score y*, EI(i) = (mu_i - y*) Phi(z_i) + sigma_i phi(z_i) with z_i = (mu_i - y*)/sigma_i, evaluated in the numerically stable equivalent form sigma_i h(z_i), h(z) = z Phi(z) + phi(z), floored at zero, with the inherited first-index rule breaking exact ties. Two declared parts make that one rule complete. (1) The dispersion the criterion reads is the inherited predictive SD multiplied by one session-level scalar c computed from the predictor's own one-step-ahead records: over the most recent 100 accepted candidates' (predicted mean, predicted SD, observed score) triples, c = median(|mu - y| / sigma) / 0.6745 clipped to [1.0, 10.0], and c = 1.0 while fewer than 20 records exist; the scalar is fixed for the batch, is computed before the batch is priced, and multiplies every pool member's SD identically. The predictive mean, the kernel, the fingerprint, the normalization, the observation-noise SD, the jitter ladder and the covariance itself are untouched. (2) The batch of ten is built by Kriging Believer: after each pick j the inherited pool covariance S is conditioned on j's own predictive mean as a fictitious observation, S <- S - S[:,j] S[j,:] / (S[j,j] + s^2) with s the inherited observation-noise SD, which leaves every remaining mean unchanged and shrinks the SD of every candidate correlated with j; the remaining eligible members are then re-priced with the same criterion and the same scalar c before the next position is filled. The eligible set, the pool, the posterior, the stall-time top-forty mask with K=3 and M=40, admission, breeding, retention and every probability stay exactly as inherited, and the ten standard-normal rows are still drawn, factored and consumed in the same order so the stream position stays comparable - they now route no choice and feed only the passive receipt that replays what the inherited rule would have bought on the identical pool.
nodes.finding:
The rule ran exactly as registered on all three seeds and neither pre-registered degeneracy fired. Every one of the 4,350 oracle calls was the expected-improvement argmax over its own eligible, conditioned field; the sampled normal block was still drawn at shape (10,160) and routed nothing; the session scale was reproduced from the node's own prediction-outcome records in all 435 batches; and Kriging-Believer conditioning fired at all 3,915 steps with strictly positive shrink and provably unmoved means. Agreement with an in-run replay of the inherited sampled rule was 0.129 of first picks and 0.388 of all picks (the "nothing changed" degeneracy needed 0.95), and agreement with the posterior-mean argmax was 0.317 of first picks (the "greedy allocation" degeneracy needed 0.95), so this is a genuine graded trade-off, read almost entirely in its dispersion regime: only 289 of 61,800 eligible member-evaluations had a posterior mean above the session incumbent, with z deciles from -3.27 to -0.74.

What the method bought moved a long way. Purchases at posterior-mean rank forty or worse fell on the well-scaled objectives (median_2 from 140/117/84 to 42/37/33 and deco_hop from 125/106/91 to 31/30/34 per seed) and rose where the calibration found a badly scaled predictor (sitagliptin_mpo from 20/17/17 to 96/75/87), the heterogeneity the intent registered in advance; in-regime the mask still forbids them (0 of 650 picks, as on the Anchor's 0 of 880). The calibrated scale behaved as predicted in kind though smaller in size: pinned at 1.0 on median_2 and deco_hop, 1.13-1.24 on zaleplon_mpo, 1.0-2.42 median on drd2_docking, 3.29-3.74 on sitagliptin_mpo, with the upper clip of 10.0 reached in one batch.

The two registered downstream predictions failed. Realized incumbent-increment mass fell to 5.178750 from the Anchor's 5.978073 - more improvements (315 against 253) but much smaller ones (median increment 0.00332 against 0.00850, largest single increment 0.2227 against 0.4620), with the first-third share falling from 0.625 to 0.513; the separately reported in-regime stratum fell likewise (0.2407 over 650 picks against 0.5470 over 880). And the Kriging-Believer step did not buy decorrelation: within-batch mean similarity beat the unconditioned top ten in only 208 of 435 batches (maximum similarity in 137), the two sets were identical in 154 batches, and with molecules below twelve heavy atoms excluded the conditioned and unconditioned batches are indistinguishable (for example 0.7876 against 0.7901) while being more redundant than the inherited rule's replay in 10 of 15 cells. The 414 picks the conditioning moved in were smaller than the 414 it displaced (mean 30.7 against 33.9 heavy atoms, 45 against 17 below twelve heavy atoms).

Scores: the panel fell 0.053288 against the code Parent on three matched seeds (0.553742 against 0.607030), inside this Anchor's law-free band [-0.055482, +0.014579] by 0.0022 and therefore not separable from path luck on the panel figure alone. By task mean: zaleplon_mpo +0.018459, median_2 +0.001920, drd2_docking -0.007491, deco_hop -0.100239, sitagliptin_mpo -0.179090. Read against this Anchor's law-free re-draw instead of the Anchor itself, which removes the known fragility of the two high seed-0 cells, the picture is sharper and more specific: deco_hop seed 0 is -0.0073 (its -0.2557 against the Anchor is almost entirely that cell's known path fragility), while sitagliptin_mpo is -0.2162 / -0.0604 / -0.2162 and drd2_docking seed 2 is -0.0618, and zaleplon_mpo gains on all three seeds (+0.0058 / +0.0118 / +0.0563). The six cells where the calibrated scale stayed pinned at 1.0 all land within 0.025 of the law-free re-draw; the three cells with mean scale 3.7-4.1 are the three largest losses. drd2_docking reached 0.99999 on seeds 0 and 1 (the Anchor reaches it only on seed 1, at its last call), so that cell is capped: it can contribute at most +0.0198 and +0.0000007 while the fragile high cells cost -0.2557 and -0.3118, and on seed 1 the ceiling was hit at evaluation 232, leaving 68 calls in that session that could not pay.

Improvement pricing is now measured on this Anchor in its graded form, and it does not convert. The decisive measurement is not the panel - which is inside the law-free band and says little - but the registered endpoint and the pick-level audit: the rule bought different molecules, as intended, and realized 0.799 less incumbent-increment mass doing it. The campaign can stop treating "the allocator prices candidates by one sampled tail realization" as the binding defect: replacing that price with a closed-form expectation, on an honestly estimated dispersion, with a batch rule that keeps the covariance load-bearing, made the conversion worse, not better.

The receipts say why, and the reason generalizes beyond this configuration. On this posterior essentially nothing ever has a predicted mean above the session incumbent (289 of 61,800 member-evaluations), so expected improvement is read almost entirely as a price on dispersion - and on this generator dispersion is highest exactly where conversion is zero. Purchases whose nearest archive neighbour is below 0.3 similarity rose from 93 to 210 of 4,350 and produced, in both this node and the Anchor, exactly zero incumbent mass; everything below 0.6 similarity (9.0% of this node's budget against the Anchor's 3.6%) returned 0.2% of the mass. Purchases below twelve heavy atoms rose from 124 to 360 and returned zero mass in both nodes; purchases above fifty heavy atoms rose from 44 to 456. Where the calibration told the truth most loudly - sitagliptin_mpo, scale 3.3-3.7 - the inflated dispersion drove the rank-forty-or-worse share from about 18 of 290 to about 86 of 290 per cell and cost about 0.16 per cell even against the law-free re-draw. The honest scale is not the bug; it is the messenger, and multiplying a miscalibrated SD by its own measured error factor buys worse candidates because the SD's ordering, not its magnitude, is what is wrong.

The molecular report explains what those dispersed purchases actually were: the apparent batch spread is size degradation, not scaffold diversity - single- and two-atom species such as F, S and Cl inside purchased batches, 63% of batches on one objective containing a sub-fragment - while the top families are one scaffold permuted by halogen swaps, with N-Cl/N-F and enol O-F bonds load-bearing in the best molecules, no CF3 anywhere in 870 proposals on four objectives, and no written stereochemistry at all. The Kriging-Believer step, asked to decorrelate, reached for exactly those smaller members, because the kernel it conditions through treats a fragment as maximally distinct. So the measured answer to "can within-batch conditioning buy diversity here" is: not through this covariance, and any future attempt must act on a structural representation restricted to drug-sized members.

Method diagnosis. Both this node and its Parent spend more than half their calls on molecules at least 0.9 similar to something already scored (2,256 and 2,414 of 4,350), and that band carries 48% and 68% of all realized gain; the surrogate's within-batch rank agreement with realized scores is only 0.25-0.80 and is lowest on the cells that lost most. This is sustained local refinement of a few inherited scaffolds with a predictor whose ordering is informative only inside that neighbourhood, and the realized gain profile confirms it: this node made 62 more improvements than the Anchor but its largest single step was half the Anchor's, so the deterministic price trades the sampled rule's occasional large jump for many small ones. No reweighting of (mean, SD, covariance) can fix that, because all three come from the same model whose uncertainty carries no information off the archive - which is also why the round-45 distance-gate arm's extra far purchases converted at 0.000232 and why this arm's converted at zero. What would address it is a different model class rather than a different acquisition: a surrogate or ranking model whose uncertainty is structurally local (or a learned preference model trained to order candidates within the local neighbourhood, where the gains actually occur), together with a proposal operator that can replace a substituent at constant heavy-atom count and a hard floor that forbids spending a purchase slot on a one- or two-atom species.

What this rules out and what remains. The intent forbids, and the evidence does not motivate, any sweep of the window length, the clip bounds, the incumbent reference, the conditioning noise or the batch rule: the failure is not in the parameters of the price. The route "price this posterior better" should stop at this node. Three things remain open and are already bound or cheap to settle: this round's calibration-only arm and its greedy ablation on the same Anchor and panel will decompose which of the three bound parts (criterion, scale, batch rule) carries the loss, and the ordering now visible - the sampled rule at 0, this joint rule at -0.053, posterior-mean-only allocation at -0.116 and this round's companion greedy ablation at -0.127 - already says the dispersion term is load-bearing but that pricing it in closed form is worse than sampling it, which makes a stochastic-tie-break or mixture rule the one untested point on this axis; whether the gain on zaleplon_mpo (+0.0246 against the law-free re-draw on all three seeds, its scale a mild 1.13-1.24) is a real conditional positive for mild dispersion correction is worth one targeted reading rather than a general recipe; and the sitagliptin_mpo and drd2_docking seed-2 losses are beyond path and are the cells a successor must defend.

nodes.hypothesis: Within each inherited score quantile, sample accepted breeding parents with probability inversely proportional to the number of eligible survivors sharing their Murcko core, so every represented core has equal conditional mass.
nodes.finding:
The allocation change executed correctly in all three replicas. Of 111,246 parent draws, 86,634 had unequal core multiplicities; every logged probability vector and inverse-CDF choice matched the intended rule. On the same eligible states and logged uniform variates, 36,398 selected parent ranks and 29,554 selected cores differed from the passive uniform comparator. Mean represented cores used per breeding batch rose from 12.98 to 14.60, and mean concentration of breeding uses fell from 0.299 to 0.189, measured as the sum of squared core-use shares. Coverage rose in 10 of 15 task/seed sessions; the effect was not universal. All accepted-state, survivor and pending-provenance checks passed, and both panels completed all 4,500 oracle evaluations.

Strict best-parent beats increased from 565/4,350 (12.99%) to 600/4,350 (13.79%), and mean child-minus-best-parent score improved from -0.100493 to -0.093989. Incumbent improvements were nearly unchanged, at 216 versus 218. Mean final-best score across tasks and seeds fell from 0.544374 to 0.524118, a paired change of -0.020256. Seed changes were -0.052822, -0.023812 and +0.015865; all five task means declined. Thus the intended allocation mechanism is confirmed, while the intended score increase was not observed.

Equalizing core probability can reduce repeated use of abundant families without improving the best molecules found. The clearest coverage expansions were in decoration hopping and DRD2, yet their parent-beating counts and final-score means fell. Zaleplon breeding became more concentrated despite correct balancing within each selected band, showing that changing the conditional draw does not guarantee broader realized coverage once the evolving survivor population is considered.

The modest parent-beating gain also uses a weaker reference: mean best-generating-parent score fell from 0.419645 to 0.395720, while mean evaluated-offspring score fell from 0.319152 to 0.301731. This relative yield gain therefore does not establish stronger offspring production. The number of admitted offspring later reused for breeding stayed almost unchanged, at 2,163 versus 2,167, and incumbent gains did not increase. The evidence narrows the problem to allocating toward productive surviving families rather than simply reducing their multiplicity imbalance; discarded or ineligible cores still receive no opportunity. The molecular assessment also shows that broader structural coverage continues to include repeated heterocycle growth, tiny fragments, reactive nitrogen-halogen/peroxide groups and strained fused rings. Murcko-core coverage alone does not resolve those quality limitations. Passive comparisons supply probabilities and parent identities, with no scores for alternate offspring or an alternate search trajectory.
