nodes.hypothesis: At existing-child choices with parent_id != 0 only, remove off-diagonal sibling pending density from the exploration consumer. For each eligible sibling j retain D_j=sum_k K_jk*N_k, B_j=sum_{k:N_k>0} K_jk*N_k*M_k and P_j=sum_k K_jk*O_k, but set active started_j=D_j+O_j in place of D_j+P_j. Exploitation remains B_j/D_j when D_j>0, else the inherited neutral 0.5. The exploration bonus is the inherited beta*sqrt(2*log(max(2,N_parent+O_parent))/started_j) when started_j>0; priority is started_j==0. This removes borrowed unresolved work while retaining actual own pending discouragement and all shared completed/value evidence. At identical exposed states the denominator cannot increase, so the bonus cannot decrease where both are defined, and a zero-start priority can be restored. The hypothesis is that this changes deeper choices and reaches actual paid paths without altering retained consumers or accounting. Whether the altered paths preserve or improve score is a separate measured conditional contribution question.
nodes.finding:
The intended numerical and path changes occurred: 24,287 of 31,123 deeper candidate rows changed, 1,637 of 4,655 deeper choices changed, and 1,557 of 4,350 purchased molecules lay on a changed path. Every task/seed was exposed, and the audit found no change to the retained value, completed-count, root, widening or accounting laws. The complete paired mean fell from 0.499496 to 0.458310, a loss of 0.041186. Nine task/seed endpoints improved and six worsened; seed-level mean differences were −0.076412, +0.008704 and −0.055850. Full-run strict improvements rose from 148 to 183, but total incumbent gain fell from 4.365063 to 3.747273 on the same 4,350-purchase denominator. Late gain rose from 1.367463 to 2.120851 over 2,175 purchases, with 42 versus 68 strict improvements. Thus direct activation succeeded while the explicitly registered score-preservation falsifier triggered. The formal Anchor mean was 0.607030, leaving a separate deficit of 0.148720 and its +0.002 performance goal unmet.

This isolated comparison supports a positive conditional endpoint contribution from discouraging deeper choices using unresolved work on similar siblings, while shared completed support and shared peak values remain present. It does not establish that every such discouragement helps: removal produced more improvements and more late gain, but smaller total progress. Large losses on two DRD2 seeds and one sitagliptin seed outweigh the smaller gains elsewhere; later recovery is therefore insufficient evidence of final-search success. The result refutes the registered non-inferiority prediction for this removal, while confirming its direct operation. It leaves other ways to use pending information, other retained compositions and the wider approach open. The trajectories also narrow the method diagnosis. Deeper occurrence revisits fell from 5,320 to 2,970, yet fragment-excluded within-session similarity increased from 0.211 to 0.229 and molecules above fifty heavy atoms increased from 301 to 557. Tiny products fell from 425 to 318, and distinct scaffold counts changed only modestly. This is neither evidence that more revisiting caused the loss nor a clean global scaffold-collapse result. Together with the Molecular report’s unstable bonding contexts and unexpressed stereochemistry, it points to a graph-proposal limitation: preserving a coherent core, useful size and chemical state while making structural changes remains unreliable. A proposal operator or search scheme that preserves those features could address that limitation; these observations do not identify a beneficial cutoff, prove chemical quality or mediate the score difference. Oracle time rose from 500.05 to 1160.91 seconds on the realized streams; matching historical Candidate clocks and precise late timing are unavailable, so a paired computational-efficiency conclusion remains open. No technical execution failure occurred, and the evidence is sufficient for this finite conditional contrast, not independent replication or broad generalization.

nodes.hypothesis: Maintain independent task-local molecular graph walks, generate de novo atom or bond edits from each current working state, accept nondecreasing observed scores and accept decreases with probability exp((new_score-current_score)/T), and cool T as accepted feedback accumulates while preserving a separate best-observed archive.
nodes.finding:
This is the weakest of the thirteen roots at 0.233. It reached 0.558 on deco_hop and 0.382 on zaleplon_mpo but collapsed to 0.045 on drd2_docking and 0.014 on sitagliptin_mpo, where the median score across all 290 proposals was zero. Every mechanism check was exact: the recomputed cooling schedule agreed with all 145 proposal temperatures and all 1,450 stored proposal temperatures, the Metropolis decision reproduced 1,450 times out of 1,450 including the logged uniform variates, 557 downhill moves were accepted and 546 of them were genuinely reused as the source of a later proposal, and the best archive matched an independent cumulative maximum at all 1,600 checkpoints.

This node isolates the round's most important lesson. The search algorithm is provably correct and the search still failed, so what separates the field is not the optimizer but the proposal distribution it draws from. Aromatic content here is 50 to 67 percent against 87 to 100 percent for every root above 0.4, and the graph edits repeatedly produce aromatic phosphorus rings and hypervalent centres that are not real chemistry. Any future work on this lineage belongs in the edit operator set, not in the acceptance rule or the cooling schedule. One seed only, and its deco_hop result shows the walk does work where the initial molecules are already close.

nodes.hypothesis: Combine the exact optional two-cut ring-segment crossover of n-870ed6964d46 with removal of post-crossover finishing on code Parent n-62daf219c70a: set only post_crossover_mutation_probability from 0.35 to 0.0 while retaining its existing random draw after every successful ordinary or ring-mode crossover.
nodes.finding:
All 35,061 successful crossovers retained their original gate draw and skipped finishing; 12,487 draws fell below the former 35% threshold. Ring mode made 5,283 valid two-attachment products. All 169 evaluated noncopy descendants retained the new typed cycle and both selected component patterns, versus 167 of 179 and 151 of 179 in the ring-only treatment. The evaluated noncopy count nevertheless fell from 179 to 169. All 161 nonterminal ring births entered the next model fit, 103 later bred, 41 beat their best parent and 12 improved the incumbent. Eight terminal births were censored; nine task/seed cells evaluated no ring descendant.

The complete four-condition comparison gives a mean interaction of +0.047285, with seed interactions -0.004750, +0.009258 and +0.137346 (population SD 0.063939). Removing finishing improves the ring-only mean by +0.011042, while removing it without ring mode lowers the mean by -0.036243. This is a heterogeneous interaction: ten task/seed interactions are positive, three negative and two unchanged. The joint mean remains 0.561665 versus the Anchor’s 0.595670, a loss of -0.034004 against the required +0.002 gain. Six endpoints improve and nine decline; seed macro changes are -0.078161, +0.010125 and -0.033978. Seed population SD falls from 0.026593 to 0.010338 around the lower mean.

Finishing is a real conditional boundary for this exact construction: the four matched conditions show that its total effect changes when ring mode is present. Correct construction, intact evaluated rings and later breeding rule out a globally broken delivery mechanism, but they do not restore the required endpoint performance. The apparent benefit is concentrated in seed 2, especially docking, and the ring-without-finishing contrast itself is negative in two of three seed macros. Those shared controls are dependent evidence, so the positive mean interaction does not establish a reliable general benefit or independent component replication.

Structural preservation alone is insufficient as an explanation. All three median-2 endpoints improve despite no evaluated ring-mode descendant, and one zaleplon gain occurs with no selected ring construction at all. Eligible mode draws, unselected pool competitors and changed adaptive histories can still change those searches. The joint run produces more local best-parent wins overall (768 versus 629), but mean generating-parent score falls from 0.470456 to 0.403872, mean offspring score from 0.385256 to 0.341961, and the average positive incumbent step from 0.022510 to 0.017312. That separates frequent small local gains from stronger final search.

The chemistry further limits the claim. Ring-rich aromatic and nitrogen/carbonyl families coexist with reactive attachments, difficult bridges or small-ring unsaturation and unresolved stereochemistry. Distinct typed and generic cores fall even as ring-only graph diversity rises; nearby high-scoring conventional examples show that the questionable attachments are not universally needed. Preserving a typed cycle therefore proves neither useful geometry nor feasible synthesis. The present evidence answers the fixed joint contribution question and rejects its separate performance prediction. Which preserved products, lost finishing products, random-stream changes or later feedback paths explain the interaction remains open; no unselected alternative received a score, and no chemical mediation claim follows.

nodes.hypothesis: Modify only the allocation residual output law on sulfur-gated Parent n-1744a1494180: retain the exact original dot-product count-Tanimoto raw mean mu_DP and replace its standardized latent conditional residual covariance C_DP with C_E from the fixed kernel K_E=exp(T_DP-1). Actual draws are mu_DP[None,:] + score_scale * (Z @ chol(C_E + active_jitter*I).T), using the one original batch-by-pool standard-normal array Z and inherited sequential masks/first-index ties. Active marginal SD is score_scale*sqrt(clamp_min(diag(C_E),0)); original means and truthful exponential SDs reach emission and next-fit probe diagnostics. This is one hybrid Gaussian allocation law replacing residual variance and dependence together, not a correlation-only change or the posterior of a single GP kernel.
nodes.finding:
All 15 task/seed runs completed with 300 observations each. Across 435 decision pools, the residual covariance and sample values changed while the original predictive mean stayed intact; 318 selected sets and 326 orders changed, with 626 strict original-law disagreements under the actual masks. All 4,350 offspring joined real prelabel predictions, feedback and accepted archives; 4,200 later reached another fit/probe and 150 final-batch observations were censored. Original-mean ranking/MSE on those same labels remained unchanged. On their different actual streams, Child pair accuracy was 0.69951 versus Parent 0.70955, mean batch Spearman 0.50187 versus 0.52551, and MSE 0.009780 versus 0.011213. The passive exponential mean scored better on the Child labeled stream (accuracy 0.70623, MSE 0.008191); it supplied no active means or extra rewards. Parent beats rose from 648 to 659, sequential incumbent events from 255 to 262, and new productive typed/generic cores from 262/163 to 294/197. But absolute offspring means fell from 0.372050 to 0.370888, best generating-parent means from 0.455304 to 0.445316, and summed incumbent gain from 5.819415 to 5.373764. Productive-source descendant edges fell from 485 to 477 and their average score from 0.360034 to 0.348999. Final macro score was 0.566743 versus 0.596453: paired gain -0.029710 against the required +0.002. Seven task/seed endpoints improved and eight worsened. Seed gains were -0.083275, +0.020415 and -0.026271; Child population dispersion was 0.011974 versus 0.033970. All positive/adverse endpoints and AUC results are retained.

The residual substitution was exposed strongly enough to test the route: its loss cannot be explained by an unchanged allocator, an incorrect mean path, missing feedback or a timeout. This narrows the uncertainty: more local wins and genuinely new productive cores can arise from lower-quality sources and still yield smaller total progress and worse endpoints. Later use did not repair that problem. All 2,519 positively supported Child sources were distinguished from 1,681 nonterminal sources without support; 52 supported sources were never drawn, and the 150 terminal records had no later opportunity. These are opportunity and use observations, not independent ancestral credit. The molecular assessment finds diverse ring-rich families rather than global scaffold collapse, but sulfur-halogen incidence fell from 93 to 8 while nitrogen-halogen incidence rose from 786 to 938, oxygen-halogen from 217 to 262 and carbon allenes from 11 to 148. Questionable attachments, difficult closures and unspecified stereochemistry persist among high scores. Those associations help explain why novelty and a narrow sulfur admission gate cannot certify chemical quality; they do not prove chemical mediation of the endpoint loss. The exact residual route ends under its registered rule. The passive exponential-mean diagnostic does not license choosing a post-result hybrid. The old full exponential experiment used an ungated Parent, so this test and its complementary sibling do not establish a current-Parent factorial interaction, component additivity or transfer. Current Parent composition remains awaiting catalog review, and broader foundation, constituent, joint-interaction, chemical-mediation, partial-lineage-composition and full-history gaps remain open.

nodes.hypothesis: Replace only the shared bounded GraphOperators.mutate neighborhood with a STONED-inspired randomized-serialization single-token SELFIES operation: one fresh session-RNG atom permutation of the current input graph, identity-preserving isomeric Kekule SMILES, strict SELFIES 2.2.0 encoding under its default semantic constraints, then a uniform insertion/deletion/replacement at a uniform eligible token position, using the complete sorted default semantic robust alphabet and excluding same-token replacement. Decode the edited string exactly once and use the exact inherited checked_molecule/max_atoms result. Representation failures and invalid/empty/oversize products spend one of the existing twelve internal attempts; valid graph no-ops remain valid returns and final novelty/admission decides them. All ordinary requested calls, higher-floor escalation, optional crossover finishing, original crossover construction, scored-parent references, sulfur/identity gates, archive/survival and count-GP allocation remain intact. The hypothesized path is changed graph reachability to larger absolute useful accepted gains and productive core descendants, potentially raising the complete endpoint mean.
nodes.finding:
The grammar executed and delivered changed molecules through both ordinary mutation and crossover finishing: 2,888 accepted offspring contained a successful SELFIES call, and 2,866 had an effective graph change. All 15 sessions completed their 300 observations, and every admitted pool and final suggestion remained compliant. New typed cores rose from 1,820 to 2,422, but strict wins over the original scored parents fell from 648 to 487. The sum of positive parent margins fell from 17.251535 to 10.324590, and total sequential incumbent gain fell from 5.819415 to 3.906773. Productive new typed cores had a larger unique accepted-descendant union, yet those descendants added less incumbent gain: 3.438632 versus 4.900088. The complete endpoint mean fell from 0.596453 to 0.468944, a paired loss of 0.127509. All three seed macros and 13 of 15 task endpoints declined, contradicting the required +0.002 gain. The two improving endpoints remain in the result.

Broader graph reachability and real breeding reuse did not produce stronger useful alternatives in this setting. A single token could remove more than one hundred atoms; ordinary-call Morgan similarity fell from 0.703 to 0.472. The original predictor remained prospective and mathematically unchanged, and its MSE on accepted labels and within-batch ordering improved while absolute molecular utility fell. Correct construction and predictor fidelity are established; the adverse contrast therefore concerns the new neighborhood and its ensuing adaptive history. The Molecular assessment suggests disrupted functional-group relationships, large repeated assemblies and electronically incomplete charged or radical-bearing output as plausible explanations. Conventional high scoring families also survive, so these chemistry observations do not identify a single cause or justify a blanket chemical rule. More cores and descendants are insufficient evidence of productive exploration. The fixed recipe now has a complete exposed negative answer; the separate effects of serialization, token operations and ensuing chemistry remain unresolved, and no transfer or tuning result follows.

nodes.hypothesis: Session-calibrated robust predictive scale on the dispersion the allocation rule reads. At each announced batch the selector forms one scalar from the inherited posterior's own one-step-ahead records for this session's accepted candidates - for each accepted molecule, the predictive mean and the unscaled predictive SD logged in the batch it was selected, against its observed score - by taking the median absolute standardized residual over the most recent 100 such records, dividing by 0.6745 to convert it to a Gaussian-equivalent dispersion, and clipping the result to [1.0, 10.0]; fewer than 20 records leaves the scalar at exactly 1.0. Every pool member's predictive SD is multiplied by that one scalar before the acquisition reads it, which in this correlated Thompson rule means the sampled residual term is multiplied by the scalar while the predictive mean is added unchanged. The scalar is global over the pool and is always computed from the inherited unscaled SD, never from an already corrected one, so it measures the inherited predictor and cannot close a feedback loop on itself. The predictive mean, the kernel, the normalization and its 0.001 floor, the 0.05 noise SD, the Cholesky jitter ladder, the cross-candidate covariance and its factor, the ten standard-normal rows and their consumption order, the stall-time eligibility mask and its K=3 counter, the per-pick mask update and the first-index tie rule are all exactly as inherited, and a scalar of exactly 1.0 takes the inherited arithmetic path unchanged.
nodes.finding:
The correction fired and every pre-registered intermediate number landed where it was forecast. The per-batch scalar was reproducible to float equality from the session's own accepted prediction-outcome records in all 435 announcements, with zero records excluded anywhere: exactly 1.0 at 195 announcements (forecast 202), above 1.0 at 240 (forecast 233), at or above 2 at 124 (forecast 126), median 1.1323 (forecast 1.1296). The heavy upper tail did not materialise - at or above 5 at only 7 announcements against a forecast 52, the upper clip of 10 never reached, realised maximum 9.3626, mean 1.7702 against a forecast 2.2171 - because the widened rule buys candidates the predictor is less wrong about, so the miscalibration it measures on its own picks shrinks as it acts. Exposure was exactly as heterogeneous as registered without any task identity being read: median_2 stayed at exactly 1.0 in all 87 of its announcements, deco_hop ran 1.0-1.47, zaleplon_mpo 1.0-1.95, drd2_docking 1.0-3.87 and sitagliptin_mpo up to 9.36. The dispersion it was meant to fix did fall toward one: pooled median absolute standardised residual 0.6685 to 0.4844 (Gaussian-equivalent 0.9911 to 0.7181; the Anchor's own records sit at 0.7156 and 1.0609), sitagliptin_mpo 2.2931 to 0.6578, drd2_docking 0.8916 to 0.5478, zaleplon_mpo 0.8204 to 0.6598, deco_hop 0.5013 to 0.4774, median_2 untouched at 0.2573; on the 2,400 picks made in widened batches, 1.1050 to 0.5852 with mean square 14.91 to 1.67. As registered, the asymmetric lower tail survived: sitagliptin_mpo mean square moved only 136.73 to 111.28, against a forecast 143.5 to 110.8. The allocation moved exactly where the scalar moved and nowhere else. The unit-scale replay on identical pools returned ten of ten picks in 195 of 195 exactly-one batches and fewer than ten in 218 of 240 widened batches (mean ordered overlap 5.08, 953 picks displaced and 953 swapped in). Purchases at posterior-mean rank 40 or worse rose to 48.03 per cent in widened unrestricted batches against 41.21 per cent in exactly-one batches of the same runs and 28.73 per cent on the Anchor, mean posterior-SD rank fell 84.40 to 67.23, and archive-far purchases (kernel similarity below 0.5) rose from 3.39 to 12.47 per cent. The mask-restricted stratum kept 0 of 830 picks at rank 40 or worse, as it must. Everything else held: every pool 160 members, a (10, 160) normal array per batch at unchanged consumption, the logged scaled SD equal to the inherited SD times the logged scalar in 435 of 435 pools with zero relative error, the jitter ladder at 1e-8 with no failed fit and no fallback anywhere, the mask size rule and the K=3 counter agreeing with an independent recount in 435 of 435 batches, and the far-to-near predictive SD ratio at 1.7343 in the cells that reproduce the Anchor against the inherited 1.7477. Five of fifteen sessions came out bit-identical to the Anchor for all 300 evaluations - median_2 on all three seeds, deco_hop seed 0 as forecast, and deco_hop seed 1, whose single widened batch happened to pick the same ten molecules - and the first two announcements of all fifteen sessions reproduced the Anchor evaluation for evaluation. What the honest width bought was worse chemistry. Within the same batches, on the same pools and the same draws, the picks the inherited rule would have made average 26.40 heavy atoms and the picks that replaced them 21.79, with 142 of the 953 swapped-in picks at five heavy atoms or fewer against none of the 953 displaced; at each session's first diverging batch, where the pool is still the Anchor's own, displaced picks average 29.35 heavy atoms and their replacements 19.24. Those replacements scored 0.1886 on average against 0.3839 for the picks both rules agreed on in the same widened batches (drd2_docking 0.333 against 0.635, sitagliptin_mpo 0.086 against 0.154), and they converted at 0.001608 of incumbent increment per evaluation against 0.002245 for the agreed picks, about 0.72 times the rate. Whole-run realised increment mass fell to 5.450779 over 229 improvements from the Anchor's 5.978073 over 253, parent-beating offspring fell from 14.57 to 13.79 per cent and the mean accepted score from 0.3782 to 0.3353. The panel came out 0.571877 against 0.607030, a paired delta of -0.035153 with all three seeds down (-0.062302, -0.022834, -0.020323). That figure sits inside this Anchor's own law-free band [-0.055482, +0.014579], so the panel mean alone cannot separate this arm from path luck; the cell level can, because the loss is concentrated where the intervention is: sitagliptin_mpo fell on all three seeds (-0.289855, -0.153239, -0.085629) while the law-free re-draw moved that same cell -0.095612, +0.012912, +0.038270, and the four protected median_2 and deco_hop seed-0 cells are exactly zero because they never left scalar 1.0.

The question the ticket asked is answered in the first of its two registered directions: the inherited near-archive over-confidence of this predictor is load-bearing. Giving the correlated Thompson rule a dispersion that matches its own measured errors does change what it buys - in the registered direction, measured inside the same batches on the same draws - and what it buys is worse. That ends the scale hypothesis on this Anchor, with no sweep of the statistic, the window, the clip bounds or the form, which is exactly what the intent pre-registered a loss to mean. It also settles the older ambiguity: the round-16 scaled-residual arm and the two constant-amplitude arms all lost, and it was never clear whether their estimators or the idea itself were at fault; a median-based, one-sided, exactly reproducible estimator that leaves four cells byte-identical loses too, so the object, not the estimator, is what the method cannot absorb. The mechanism of the loss is the useful part, and it is specific to how uncertainty and chemistry line up in this representation. Under an accepted-only count-Morgan generalized-Tanimoto GP, predictive SD is largest exactly where kernel similarity to the archive is smallest, and in a graph generator the members furthest from the archive are not novel scaffolds but degenerate fragments - a bare halogen, a two-atom molecule. So widening the sampled residual does not buy exploration, it buys mass loss: the swapped-in picks are five heavy atoms smaller on average, one in seven of them is a five-atom-or-smaller fragment, and the molecular reading of the same cells shows the widened sessions shrinking (26.8 to 20.8 mean heavy atoms on the worst cell, one- and two-atom proposals still being made after evaluation 200 at 21 of 790 picks in widened batches against 3 of 710 in unit batches) while the unchanged cells carry the cleanest chemistry in the run. Dispersion in this method cannot distinguish novelty from degeneracy, so any method that spends variance through this surrogate will spend it on fragments. A second finding worth carrying: on-policy calibration improved while the score fell. The Child's own raw residuals are better behaved than the Anchor's (pooled median absolute 0.6685 against 0.7156, sitagliptin_mpo 2.2931 against 3.3339), and the multiplier's realised tail collapsed against its offline forecast, because an allocation that buys high-variance candidates makes its own predictions look honest. Calibration measured on a policy's own purchases is therefore not a proxy for allocation quality in this campaign, and no future arm should treat a falling standardised residual as evidence of progress. On the method itself, the trajectories say the limit is not the width of the uncertainty but the shape of the search. Purchases stay on top of the archive - 76.8 per cent of all 4,350 picks sit at kernel similarity 0.8 or above to the accepted set, and mean similarity rises from 0.794 in the first half of a session to 0.856 in the second - so the late search is sustained local refinement of a handful of inherited scaffolds, which the molecular report sees as best-of-cell clusters that differ only in which halogen occupies which position. The one exploration lever this method has is the sampled residual, and this node has now measured that the lever is confounded with molecular size, so turning it harder is not available. The miscalibration that remains is also the wrong kind for a width fix: on sitagliptin_mpo the residuals are asymmetric, with a third of picks more than three SDs below prediction and mean square still 111 after correction, which is a bias in the predictive mean, not a width defect. What could remove the limitation is a different class of component, not a different constant: a criterion that prices improvement over the session's incumbent rather than a raw sampled value, so that a high-variance near-floor fragment is never competitive; a surrogate or ranking model whose uncertainty is conditioned on something other than kernel distance, so that distance-from-archive stops being a synonym for smallness; or a proposal operator set with fragment-level moves and a size floor, so that the variance the search does spend lands on different chemistry rather than on fewer atoms. The first of those is already bound this round as a separate position, and this node is its attribution control: the identical scale construction costs 0.527 of increment mass on its own, so any gain that arm shows is attributable to the improvement-priced criterion and not to the scale underneath it. What stays open is whether the same correction behaves differently under a criterion that cannot be fooled by a fragment, and whether the near-archive mean bias - the part a robust scale deliberately ignores - is itself worth a separate intervention. Two borrowed elements were on trial here and both behaved: the published post-hoc recalibration of a probabilistic regressor's dispersion from its own prediction-outcome pairs ran exactly as borrowed, reproducible at every announcement, and the published diagnosis that a Tanimoto-kernel Gaussian process of this architecture class is under-dispersed was confirmed on this Anchor's own records before anything changed. What did not transfer is the inference that fixing it helps, and the deviations say how far that counterexample reaches: a single bulk scalar replaces a fitted quantile map, the clip is one-sided so contraction was never tested, and the correction sits under a correlated ten-position batch draw rather than the single-point acquisition the sources studied. The campaign can record that an honest dispersion is not a benefit in this architecture at this budget, not that calibration is worthless. As a continuation this position also did what it promised: it differs from the round-16 scaled-residual arm in estimator, in being unable to contract, and in protecting the four cells where that arm's largest losses fell, and all three held - so the repeated loss is attributable to the object rather than to the estimator, and the registered rule that a loss ends the scale hypothesis on this Anchor with no sweep applies. The route stops; the remaining iteration worth having is not another scale but a criterion or surrogate class that changes what high variance can buy.

nodes.hypothesis: Replace the source of the per-candidate dispersion that the inherited correlated Thompson allocation reads, holding its pool-mean magnitude fixed. At each announced batch, after the inherited posterior is fitted, eight bootstrap resamples with replacement at full size are drawn from the session's own chronological accepted records and the same accepted-only count-Morgan generalized-Tanimoto GP is refitted on each, with the inherited 0.05 observation-noise SD, the inherited adaptive mean and population-SD normalization with its 0.001 floor and the inherited float64 Cholesky jitter ladder. For each of the 160 pool members the ensemble dispersion sigma_ens(x) is the root mean square of the eight member predictive means about their own ensemble mean (divisor eight); it is rescaled by the single pool-level constant (pool mean of the inherited predictive SD) / (pool mean of sigma_ens) to give sigma_tilde, whose pool mean equals the inherited pool-mean predictive SD exactly. The allocator residual becomes diag(sigma_tilde) times the Cholesky factor of the inherited correlation matrix - the inherited pool covariance divided by its own marginal SDs - times the inherited standard-normal row, so the cross-candidate correlation pattern, the single (10, 160) array, its generator, its order and its consumption count are unchanged, and substituting the inherited predictive SD for sigma_tilde reproduces the Parent's own sampled function values. Fewer than twenty accepted records in the session, or a pool-mean sigma_ens below 1e-12, leaves the inherited residual expression in place and is reported. The predictive mean, the kernel and its vocabulary, the normalization, the noise SD, the jitter ladder, the sequentially masked sampled-maxima rule with its first-index tie, the stall-time eligibility mask with K=3 and M=40, pool_multiplier 16, admission, retention and breeding are exactly as inherited.
nodes.finding:
The construction ran in every announced batch of a complete fifteen-cell panel and did what it was built to do. The dispersion the allocator reads stopped being an archive-distance statistic: its per-pool rank correlation with nearest-neighbour archive distance is +0.2335 in the median session against the Anchor's own +0.9397 recomputed in the same audit (420 pools: mean +0.2317, median +0.2736, range -0.4482 to +0.8185, against the Anchor's mean +0.9401, median +0.9409, range +0.8526 to +0.9962), and not one of the 420 pools lands within 0.05 of the Anchor's value. The magnitude confound that sank the round-46 correction was removed by construction: the pool mean of the rescaled dispersion equals the inherited pool-mean predictive SD to a maximum relative error of 4.4e-16 over all 420 non-guard batches, with the realized rescaling constant ranging 0.67 to 12.43 (median 2.27). The guard fired in exactly the fifteen first batches, where fewer than twenty records exist, and those fifteen batches are byte-identical to the Anchor's in pool, posterior mean, predictive SD, drawn normals, sampled function values and all ten picks; there were no floor hits and no member refit failures in 420 ensembles. The new statistic routed real purchases. Against an in-node replay of the inherited predictive SD over the same drawn normals, the same correlation factor and the same eligible set, the ten purchases overlap 4.62 of 10 on average, never all ten in any of the 420 non-guard batches, and 2260 of 4350 evaluations are candidates the inherited statistic would not have bought. Purchases from the top decile of the dispersion actually read rose to 1291 of 4350 against the Anchor's 199, and those picks are no longer dead weight: they converted at 0.001833 of incumbent-increment mass per evaluation, where the Anchor's top-predictive-SD-decile picks converted at 0.000025. The posterior-mean rank profile stayed close to the Anchor's (926 of 3110 non-guard out-of-regime purchases at rank 40 or worse, 29.77 per cent, against 908 of 3320, 27.35 per cent; the matched in-node counterfactual on identical pools would have been 1011, 32.51 per cent), and in-regime it is 0 of 1090 by the retained eligibility bar, as designed. What the purchases bought is the result that matters. Degenerate small molecules fell as predicted: evaluations below six heavy atoms 91 to 64, and the top dispersion decile is 7.1 per cent sub-six-atom members against 30.8 per cent for the inherited SD on the same pools. But the other degenerate end took their place: evaluations above fifty heavy atoms rose 44 to 296, mean size 28.50 to 33.16, the top decile went from 2.9 to 10.6 per cent oversize, distinct Murcko scaffolds per session fell 117.5 to 95.1 and fragment-excluded within-batch similarity rose 0.311 to 0.325. Realized incumbent-increment mass fell 5.978073 to 5.066743 over the same 4350-evaluation denominator, and the split is informative: the purchases the new statistic uniquely routed converted at 0.000482 per evaluation against 0.001904 for the purchases both statistics agreed on. The endpoint is a loss. The complete paired panel is 0.546275 against the Anchor's 0.607030, delta -0.060755 (seeds -0.141024 / -0.010163 / -0.031079), against a registered non-inferiority margin of +0.002, and it sits 0.005273 below the lower edge of this Anchor's own law-free band [-0.055482, +0.014579]. Three of fifteen cells are positive. Two of the four protected task means breach their margins (deco_hop -0.091415 and sitagliptin_mpo -0.158841 against 0.02 each), drd2_docking -0.024418 holds inside its 0.03 and zaleplon_mpo -0.017554 inside its 0.02 with 0.002446 of headroom; median_2 -0.011549 stays inside its registered band. The two cells the reading rule registered as fragile, deco_hop seed 0 and sitagliptin_mpo seed 0, carry 70.6 per cent of the cell-delta sum; they are reported and not excluded, and the remaining thirteen cells average -0.020631, which is almost exactly the law-free re-draw's own -0.020452.

The campaign's leading structural story survives this test, but in a weaker and more useful form. It held that predictive uncertainty under this count-Morgan covariance is a proxy for molecular degeneracy, so any rule that rewards uncertainty is arbitraged by degenerate molecules. This node removed the premise and kept the conclusion: the dispersion is now almost uncorrelated with archive distance (+0.23 against +0.94) and almost uncorrelated with molecular size (per-pool Spearman with heavy-atom count -0.001, where the inherited SD gives -0.213 and its top decile averages 16.5 heavy atoms against the new statistic's 30.3), and the budget still went to degenerate objects, only to the large end instead of the small one. The arbitrage is therefore not a property of the archive-distance statistic. It is a property of a search in which nothing prices molecular size or scaffold identity, so whichever end of the size axis a dispersion stops defending becomes the end that drifts. That rules out the whole 'better uncertainty statistic' family as a remedy for degeneracy on this lineage: archive-distance magnitude correction, closed-form pricing, explicit distance amplification, removal, and now a dispersion built from a different source entirely have all failed in the same direction, and none of them failed because the statistic's ordering was wrong. What the search actually did is visible in the trajectories and it is a local-refinement ratchet, not an exploration deficit. Purchases moved closer to the session archive than the inherited rule's would have on identical pools (mean nearest-neighbour distance 0.104 against 0.147), scaffold counts fell and within-batch similarity rose, and on deco_hop seed 0 the run grew one lineage of head-to-tail concatenated xanthine-like rings to a session median of 76.5 heavy atoms, 213 of 290 purchases above fifty and a maximum of 119, while its best score crept 0.588 to 0.605 and the cell lost 0.251 against the Anchor's compact 30-heavy-atom tricycle at 0.856. The score surface permits this: the molecular report finds a hard 0.5 floor on deco_hop and a flat top end, so mass is never punished, and the 187 proposals above seventy heavy atoms all score below the run's best, which is a 45-atom molecule. The cost is not only score: that one cell's oracle time rose from 84 to 4893 seconds, 68 per cent of the frozen task timeout, while the declared ensemble work itself cost 9.3 seconds across all fifteen sessions. The surrogate's ranking is not the limitation in general - predicted-versus-realized batch rank correlation is 0.496 against the Anchor's 0.515 with lower prediction error - but it is the limitation on the worst cell: sitagliptin_mpo is the weakest-ranked objective in both runs and fell further here (0.208 against 0.328), and it is the seed where the molecular report finds the generator hanging thiols and phenols on the scaffold instead of fluorinating it while the Anchor's same-seed run fluorinated 269 of 290 proposals and reached 0.766. That points the next move away from the dispersion and toward the predictive location, which no node on this Anchor has touched, and toward a proposal or batch-selection scheme that is explicit about scaffold identity and molecular size - a diversity-aware batch acquisition over scaffold-level features, or a surrogate whose features are size-normalised - rather than any further choice of uncertainty estimator. Two things this result cannot settle. The gated reading is unavailable: this Anchor has only its ungated law-free reference, the trigger-matched gated reference is the sibling ticket bound in the same batch and it has no realization yet, so the in-regime stratum here (exposure 109 of 435 batches in 15 of 15 sessions against the Anchor's 88 in 13 of 15; conversion 0.000306 against 0.000622 per evaluation) stays a descriptive control and supports no claim about the eligibility mask. And the attribution of the 0.911 drop in increment mass is bounded rather than clean: the panel loss is only 0.005 outside a band whose own half-width is seventeen times the registered effect size, 70.6 per cent of it sits in the two cells the rule pre-registered as fragile, and the newly-bought-versus-agreed conversion split is selection-conditioned accounting, because candidates nobody bought carry no scores. The configuration is closed either way: its own conditions forbid sweeping the resample count, the resampling design, the rescaling rule or the record threshold, and the behavioural reading that was supposed to justify continuation came back saying the statistic was never the binding object.

nodes.hypothesis: Generate neural proposals ancestrally from the normalized geometric mean of the adapted-policy and frozen-prior next-token distributions at each shared generated prefix, with equal fixed exponents and unchanged accepted-score learning.
nodes.finding:
The intended sampling mechanism activated. Across 12,000 raw neural sequences and 579,478 active token prefixes, the recorded behavior distribution differed from the adapted policy. On those same prefixes, mean KL divergence to the frozen prior fell from 0.182477 for the adapted-policy endpoint to 0.040980 for behavior; mean behavior/policy L1 distance was 0.144892. Every raw sequence had lower average behavior-to-prior divergence. All 150 saved audit prefixes reconstruct the registered geometric midpoint. Valid-novel raw yield rose from 7,991/12,000 (66.59%) to 10,319/12,000 (85.99%), improving in all three seeds and all five tasks. Invalid draws fell from 3,807 to 1,680, unterminated draws from 37 to zero and duplicates from 165 to one. However, mean accepted neural score fell from 0.204941 to 0.158382. Among 1,350 later neural emissions, exact ring-core overlap with previously trained graph molecules fell from 53 to 39. The three-seed mean final-best score was 0.542371 versus the parent's 0.550198, a paired change of -0.007826; population standard deviations were 0.030347 and 0.021738. Paired macro changes were +0.009185, -0.078386 and +0.045722. Task-mean changes were -0.020870 for zaleplon, -0.052561 for scaffold hopping, -0.012984 for DRD2, -0.004175 for median similarity and +0.051459 for sitagliptin. Every task completed all 300 evaluations.

Direct reference anchoring can substantially improve syntactic and novelty yield at generated prefixes while attenuating useful accepted-score adaptation. The effect was strongest after the first adapted-policy batch: later valid-novel yield rose from 64.00% to 85.42%, while later accepted neural mean score fell from 0.211885 to 0.160124. Graph feedback continued to train the policy: all 6,480 nonterminal graph-bearing replay steps had nonzero graph-only gradients, and exact accepted graph log likelihood increased by 0.180643 on average per training exposure. The weaker downstream family overlap and scores therefore occurred despite active graph learning. Ring-core overlap is a descriptive connection, not proof of causal or functional transfer. The extra raw yield did not expand the evaluated neural stream under this sampler. Both runs emitted exactly 1,500 neural molecules from 150 calls and needed no additional sampling call. The valid surplus discarded after filling a batch increased from 6,491 to 8,819. Mean active sequence length shortened from 59.409 to 48.290 draws including EOS, but measured neural-phase generation time rose from 14.608 to 27.896 seconds across the runs, including diagnostic overhead. This narrows the result: improved parser/novelty yield alone was not a limiting resource for these full batches. The supplied chemistry assessment describes broad ring-rich output with ordinary medicinal motifs alongside reactive bonds, unusual heteroatom bonding, uncontrolled growth and absent stereochemical specification. Those combined neural/graph outputs do not establish that the extra unscored valid draws preserve useful functional context. The experiment supports the conditional distribution effect and higher raw yield, while leaving useful molecular transfer and search advantage unsupported. It does not show that the adapted weights stayed closer to the prior; the KL comparison holds the generated prefix fixed and compares two sampling distributions at that prefix.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove only the best-return exploitation consumer at virtual parent 0. For the identical eligible sibling rows retain K_ij, D_i=sum_j K_ij*N_j, S_i=sum_j K_ij*W_j, P_i=sum_j K_ij*O_j and B_i=sum_{j:N_j>0} K_ij*N_j*M_j. At _choose(parent_id=0), use S_i/D_i as exploitation when D_i>0, otherwise the inherited neutral 0.5. At every parent_id!=0 continue to use B_i/D_i with the same neutral rule. Both levels retain the identical bonus 0.5*sqrt(2*log(max(2,N_parent+O_parent))/(D_i+P_i)), D_i+P_i==0 priority and earliest-occurrence tie. Preserve all accepted-only maximum ledgers and all-return N/W/Q, independent O, initial normalization, route-local receipt identity and alias isolation. Reducing the influence of isolated root maxima should broaden initial-root follow-up and reduce allocation/gain concentration while retaining deeper peak exploitation. This is a conditional component removal; no additional arm or alternative adaptive trajectory is introduced.
nodes.finding:
The intended selector change ran correctly in all 15 task/seed cells: 3,207 of 4,358 root decisions changed, with no arithmetic or receipt-accounting discrepancies and deeper peak selection preserved. All 150 supplied roots received optimizer follow-up, up from 137, and root purchase concentration fell from 0.27168 to 0.16563. Within the 12 cells where both runs gained, root gain concentration also fell, from 0.68769 to 0.56379. But the largest receipt accounted for 25.51% of total gain versus 23.56%, and the largest task/seed cell accounted for 38.33% versus 25.92%. Full gain rose from 1.77439 to 2.23597 while second-half gain fell from 1.07389 to 0.54762. Thus the broader-allocation result is established, but the full gain-deconcentration explanation remains mixed. Mean endpoint score rose from 0.32678 to 0.35756, a paired gain of 0.03077 above the supplied 0.002 scale; seed changes were -0.05647, +0.02191 and +0.12688. The mean remains 0.24947 below the formal Anchor.

On this complete finite panel, retaining peak exploitation at the root has negative conditional endpoint contribution when deeper peak exploitation is retained. That answers the component question, but it does not show that broader allocation caused the score gain: one docking seed supplies the dominant improvement, receipt concentration increases, and later purchases yield less gain. The inconclusive mechanism verdict concerns that mixed explanatory chain; execution succeeded, the score improved, and the registered joint coverage/concentration falsifier did not trigger. This settles neither the value of deeper peak selection nor the tree approach as a whole. The remaining method limitation is now clearer: merely reaching every initial root does not produce sustained productive refinement. Of 13,044 nonroot occurrences, 10,605 received only one return; terminals using earlier-announcement prefix feedback barely changed, from 3,156 to 3,130 of 4,350. Molecular evidence shows broad ring and scaffold exploration, with fewer tiny fragments but more products above fifty heavy atoms (461 versus 401), reactive motifs and no assigned tetrahedral stereochemistry. The strong docking tail includes amine-rich structures already accessible to the generator, while most sampled molecules remain weak. These observations support investigating a proposal operator that preserves useful cores and functional-group roles, or a search scheme that obtains more informative repeated feedback on promising prefixes. They do not establish a missing pharmacophore, a universal size cutoff, or a benefit from retuning the same root statistic.

nodes.hypothesis: Extend each valid unselected fresh final proposal to exactly one later suggestion by appending the immediately preceding fresh pool's surviving unselected records after a fully generated current fresh pool, then apply the unchanged current accepted-only correlated posterior selector to that ordered union.
nodes.finding:
The lifetime mechanism ran with full fresh generation intact: all 435 decisions first produced 160 fresh proposals. Of 62,105 admitted deferred occurrences, every prediction changed after ten new real labels and 1,315 were evaluated. They produced 46 incumbent improvements; 593 later became breeders, and 2,797 accepted molecules had a delayed ancestor. Yet the complete mean final Top-1 fell from 0.595670 to 0.548956, a paired change of -0.046714 against the required +0.002 gain. All three seed averages were lower; nine of fifteen task/seed endpoints fell and six improved. The largest task-mean losses were sitagliptin_mpo (-0.147107) and deco_hop (-0.080214), while median_2 improved by 0.005534. Seed dispersion decreased from 0.026593 to 0.012479, around a lower mean. All formal evaluations completed within the unchanged budget and limits.

The result rules out missing exposure, failed revaluation and curtailed fresh output as explanations for the failed endpoint prediction. Useful delayed molecules and extensive descendant ancestry were insufficient to improve the full objective: most delayed evaluations still lost to their original best parent, and one task/seed had no delayed incumbent gain. The matched contrast rejects this fixed one-round lifetime rule under the tested composition; it does not isolate the cost of deferred competition from wider joint draws and the later adaptive trajectories. The passive fresh-only choices have no separately observed outcomes. The chemistry assessment likewise found more distinct core graphs without consistently better leading families: aromatic heterocycles and aryl amines remained prominent, and the strongest Parent arrangements were not reproduced in the tasks with the largest losses. Reactive local bonds, difficult ring geometry and undefined stereochemistry persist alongside more conventional high-scoring examples. Graph diversity and ancestor reachability therefore cannot stand in for reliable endpoint progress or plausible independent chemistry.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove two-parent connected-fragment crossover from fresh-pool production, routing every proposal through the inherited single-parent local-mutation walk while retaining the count-based posterior and correlated batch allocation.
nodes.finding:
Crossover disappears from every one of 73,611 breeding attempts, even though a distinct eligible partner was available each time. The Parent used crossover on 34,334 attempts and evaluated 1,492 crossover offspring. The retained one-parent walks, all seven ordinary mutation families, accepted feedback and correlated posterior selection continue to operate. All three seeds complete. Mean final score falls from 0.595670 to 0.540732, a paired loss of 0.054937 against the registered 0.002 material-loss threshold. Seed losses are 0.112917, 0.004694 and 0.047200. Twelve of fifteen task-seed endpoints fall; median_2 and sitagliptin_mpo improve on seed 1, and zaleplon_mpo improves on seed 2. Population dispersion across seed macros falls from 0.026593 to 0.019996, so the lower dispersion accompanies lower scores. Strict local parent beats nevertheless rise from 629 to 726 and incumbent gains from 258 to 282; those local counts do not predict the endpoint result.

This complete isolated removal supports a positive contribution of connected-fragment crossover in the current exchange-free search composition. That conclusion concerns the whole adaptive rerouting experiment, including changed ancestors and proposal histories; it does not assign value to an individual fragment or recombinant. A simple diversity-collapse explanation is inadequate: typed emitted cores increase from 1,851 to 1,924 while generic cores decrease from 1,118 to 1,009, and every Child emission retains a ring. Mean molecular size increases even though the extreme size range narrows. Molecular evidence likewise shows rich annulated amide, amine and heterocyclic families, with high-scoring conventional alternatives and persistent reactive bonds, difficult geometry and unspecified stereochemistry. More local wins or more typed cores therefore cannot substitute for the complete endpoint comparison or establish chemical feasibility. Which useful arrangements crossover helps search reach, and how that benefit interacts with the retained posterior and mutation continuation, remain open.

nodes.hypothesis: Resolve exact ties at the maximum accepted batch score by choosing the candidate with the fewest heavy atoms, then the lexicographically smallest canonical identity, while leaving every non-tied accepted maximum and the independent best archive unchanged.
nodes.finding:
Six of 28 exact maximum-score ties selected a different molecule, all on deco_hop plateaus in two seeds. Every changed choice preserved the accepted maximum score and used one or two fewer heavy atoms than the lexical winner, saving ten atoms across those decisions. Three choices kept the source size and three reduced it by one atom. All 407 unique maxima retained the same choice on the same accepted batch, and the identity, archive and transition audits passed. Descendants exceeded the compact selected size after five of the six changes; the remaining case finished at that size after five further steps. Later archive improvements occurred, but the complete three-seed macro mean fell from 0.521759 to 0.520655, a paired loss of 0.001104 against the required gain of 0.002. Both affected seeds declined; all four other tasks and the third seed retained exactly the parent's molecule/score sequences.

Equal immediate scores do not make tied molecules equivalent starting points for the remaining search. The rule reached smaller real states and preserved the independent archive, so the missing score benefit cannot be explained by a tie implementation failure or an immediate sacrifice in accepted score. The two affected walks ended smaller than their parents yet found lower best scores, narrowing the claim: this size preference controls some neutral growth, but has not identified better future neighborhoods. The chemistry assessment reinforces the distinction between atom count and useful simplification: deco_hop proposals had slightly fewer atoms on average but greater molecular mass and more nitrogen-halogen bonds, while unusual sulfur chemistry persisted. A compact winner can also be a bond change or element substitution. Local chemical organization or neighborhood quality therefore remains a more informative open question than size alone. Six interventions in two overlapping walks do not isolate the contribution of each choice, and the sparse activation does not establish how the rule would behave on other tasks.

nodes.hypothesis: Search around scored task-local molecules in an injective SELFIES SeqFlow latent space, adapt the flow to high-scoring observations, and use a latent GP with Thompson sampling to select fresh trust-region proposals whose perturbed token blocks are chosen from estimated sequence-level PMI before exact inverse-flow decoding.
nodes.finding:
The node is recorded buggy with no macro score, and its mechanism is refuted. Three objectives completed their full 290 proposals, but drd2_docking stopped at 140 accepted molecules and median_2 at 230, in both cases when a flow adaptation aborted. Of 129 adaptation attempts only 127 completed. The components that did run checked out: corpus pretraining moved held-out token loss from 15.283 to -3.877, exact left-inverse decoding held with a maximum error of 7.7e-07 at the selected checkpoint, all 840 pointwise mutual information estimates were nondegenerate, and every one of the 124 completed batches emitted exactly the announced ten valid novel molecules.

The failure is not in the idea but in adapting the flow while a session is live. Re-encoding every observation after each adaptation is what makes the latent geometry stay useful, and it is also what puts a failure-prone training step inside the oracle loop, where an abort costs the remaining budget on that objective. The partial results that did land are suggestive, with 0.652 on drd2_docking from only 140 calls, so the approach is not obviously weak. The molecules also show a distinct problem: perturbing token blocks in a SELFIES-based latent produces boron, phosphorus and cumulated-double-bond structures at very high rates. A repair should move adaptation to a batch boundary with a guarded fallback before this lineage is judged on score.

nodes.hypothesis: Replace the active accepted-only count-GP learner and Gaussian function distribution jointly with 128 fixed bootstrapped CART response trees on unchanged Morgan counts, allocating each batch position by the maximum of one uniformly sampled tree function with replacement and original-index exact ties.
nodes.finding:
All 435 accepted-archive refits and all 55,680 native tree structures reproduced. Every pool contained 128 distinct functions with 7 to 47 distinct first maximizers, and all 435 selected sets differed from both ensemble-mean and generation-order controls. Selection still relied heavily on pool order: 4,092 of 4,350 sampled-function maxima were exact ties. One unselected tree was constant; no entire batch lacked functional exposure. Real feedback remained intact, with 581 parent wins and 252 incumbent advances, compared with 629 and 258 for the Parent.

The complete three-seed mean fell from 0.595670 to 0.534693, a paired loss of 0.060977 against the required gain of 0.002. Seed changes were −0.082304, +0.000169 and −0.100795. Five task/seed endpoints improved: deco_hop seeds 1 and 2, drd2 seed 1, sitagliptin seed 1 and zaleplon seed 2. Ten declined; all five task means and all three median_2 endpoints were lower. The implemented mechanism is confirmed and its endpoint-benefit prediction is falsified.

Distinct fitted functions and changed evaluation choices were not sufficient for endpoint benefit. Selected-stream mean squared error improved from 0.012718 to 0.010939, while ordering correlation fell from 0.5322 to 0.4474. Every median_2 error improved even though all its endpoints declined. These are different adaptive evaluation streams, so neither the lower error nor the empirical tree spread establishes calibration or explains the total loss. Exact ties, leaf-average support and later search history remain possible contributors whose individual effects were not isolated.

The inherited inputs still merge some distinct molecules: nineteen current alias pairs were observed, but only one pair had both members scored, at an equal value. Trees additionally give equal predictions to many unequal count vectors. Neither representation aliases nor shared leaves prove chemical identity or independent scaffold coverage. Conventional compact indole amides, carbon-bound halogens and available amines coexist with giant linked-ring structures, reactive bonds and difficult bridges. Useful conventional counterexamples rule out a universal need for those liabilities; they do not establish a chemical cause of the score loss.

This result concerns the joint fixed learner and sampled-function law. It does not reverse the useful GP boundary or its conditional component findings, and it does not identify separate effects of trees, bootstrapping, ties or uncertainty. The large runtime spread is preserved: all replicas completed under identical resources, with much of the observed elapsed variation in deco_hop oracle time. Changed molecules and nested instrumentation prevent an isolated learner-speed or chemistry attribution.

nodes.hypothesis: After each complete inherited ordinary single-parent mutation chain, offer its original final product first and then its proper successful graph snapshots in reverse chronological order to the same bounded novel-candidate pool, without shortening or extending the chain.
nodes.finding:
The full inherited mutation chains ran, and 7,287 proper intermediate products entered the fixed pools. Of 461 evaluated prefixes, 78 beat their generating parent, 353 lost and 30 tied; 29 advanced the incumbent. After feedback, 370 survived their batch and 294 later bred in 10,630 actual parent draws. All 435 pools filled. Multiple admissions reduced independent generation attempts from 75,961 to 67,373, without shortening any completed chain. All three matched replicas completed. Mean final score fell from 0.595670 to 0.554740, a paired loss of 0.040930 against the required gain of 0.002. Seed changes were −0.089537, +0.003553 and −0.036805. Four task/seed endpoints improved—zaleplon seed 0, drd2 and sitagliptin seed 1, and median_2 seed 2—while eleven declined. The mechanism is confirmed and its endpoint-benefit prediction is falsified.

Making earlier products visible can expose useful molecules without improving the overall search. Among 49 same-attempt pairs where both prefix and final were actually scored, prefixes won 34, lost ten and tied five. These selected, dependent comparisons do not describe all intermediates. The only prefix that first attained a session endpoint was a zaleplon product whose original final remained unscored; that session still finished below its matched Parent. Across the whole Child, parent wins rose from 629 to 722 and incumbent advances from 258 to 306, yet the complete endpoint mean declined. The retained GP also had lower error on its changed evaluated stream, which cannot establish a better model or explain the loss.

The result applies to this one final-first/reverse-prefix collection rule. Prefix occupancy, fewer independent attempts and later adaptive histories changed together, so their separate effects remain unresolved. It does not reverse the earlier positive contribution of retaining ordinary continuation or justify assuming shallower products are better. Chemical counterexamples reinforce that boundary: a higher-scoring prefix retains an acyl fluoride, while another oxygen-ring prefix loses substantially to its sulfur-ring final. Conventional indole amides and useful aryl amines coexist with reactive bonds, excessive elaboration, difficult rings and unspecified stereochemistry. Extra path coverage did not establish chemical feasibility or independent scaffold coverage. Higher-floor recovery and mutation-call exhaustion were tested only in isolated controls, not naturally exercised here.

nodes.hypothesis: Trigger-matched, channel-matched law-free path divergence in the allocator stream of the stall-masked Anchor. No law, probability, threshold, rule or constant changes anywhere, and no mechanism is added, removed or modified. Inside FingerprintPosterior.select, after the inherited predictive distribution and the inherited pool_posterior Cholesky factorization have been computed and immediately before the inherited allocation draws its own standard-normal array, draw exactly one extra standard-normal array of the inherited allocation shape (suggestion batch size by pool size, 10 by 160) from that selector's own seeded torch generator - the generator that draws nothing else in the program - and discard it, if and only if the restrict_top_mean argument of that same call is not None. That argument is the inherited per-batch eligibility-restriction object itself: the same value the mask below reads to build the eligible set, computed by the inherited K=3 counter in Evolution.suggest and logged in that batch's stall_regime_state. The gate is therefore the restriction's own predicate, so the discard cannot fire in a batch whose eligible set is unrestricted and cannot fail to fire in one whose eligible set is restricted. Outside the restricted regime nothing extra is consumed at all. Because the selector's generator is consumed only by that one inherited draw, the discard is exactly a one-block offset of the inherited allocator stream: from each session's first restricted batch onward the ten correlated sample rows are different pseudo-random words, so different eligible candidates win the ten sequentially masked purchases, and the realized path departs from the Anchor inside the restricted regime only. Everything that decides anything stays exactly as inherited: the accepted-only chronological count-Morgan generalized-Tanimoto posterior with its 0.05 observation-noise SD, adaptive mean and population-SD normalization, its full cross-candidate covariance, its float64 Cholesky jitter ladder and its predictive mean and marginal dispersion; the eligibility rule with K=3, M=40 of the unchanged 160-member pool, the (-posterior mean, pool index) ordering, the per-pick mask update, the first-index tie rule, the bounded valid fallback and restoration on the first improving batch; the single array of the inherited shape the allocation draws for itself and its consumption order; the sulfur gate, canonical identity admission, both duplicate scopes, greedy-64 retention, quantile breeding with its shared random.Random(seed) stream, the continuation law, the seven operator families at unchanged weights and connected-fragment crossover at 0.45 with its 0.35 finishing edit. No decision, receipt-driven or otherwise, reads a discarded value. The claim is a measurement, not a gain: the complete matched fifteen-cell panel delta against the Anchor is what law-free allocator-stream departure costs when it is confined to the batches the mask governs, with the Anchor's other 347 announced batches and both of its never-stalling deco_hop sessions untouched by construction.
nodes.finding:
The construction did exactly what it declared, on the real CUDA receipts. One discard receipt was written in every one of the 435 announced batches; a standard-normal block of the allocation shape was actually drawn and thrown away in exactly the 89 batches whose own stall counter had the restriction active, and never in the other 346. The two sessions that never stall, deco_hop seeds 0 and 2, reproduced the Anchor molecule for molecule and score for score across all 300 records and all 29 batches, finishing at 0.8561477 and 0.6442340 exactly; every other session reproduced the Anchor event for event up to its own first restricted batch (75,856 inherited log events, 2,163 of 4,500 trajectory records). The one-block offset is now verified on the real hardware and not just in the pre-run check: at each session's first restricted batch the discarded block is the Anchor's own active block to all 1,600 values in 13 of 13 exposed sessions, the run's own block there differs in all 1,600 values, and it is the block the Anchor only reaches one batch later. At that batch the bred pool of 160, the fit, the predicted means and the eligible forty are the Anchor's receipts hash for hash, and only the purchases move: 7 to 10 of the ten buys differ, all still inside the eligible forty. Every inherited law audited clean on both sides, including the stall counter recount in 435 of 435 batches, the first-index-argmax purchase rule at all 4,350 positions, and the operator, crossover and finishing frequencies within four standard errors of their declared values.

The panel came in at 0.589106 against the Anchor's 0.607030, a paired fifteen-cell mean of -0.017924, about nine times the 0.002 scale the campaign calls meaningful. No seed moved up: the seed macros fell by 0.020631, 0.029333 and 0.003810, so the across-seed spread is 0.0106 and seed 0 is the second largest loss rather than a gain; the orientation figures circulating with this ticket (a positive seed 0 and a spread near 0.037) do not reproduce from the receipts. Seven of fifteen cells rose, five fell and three are identical. The registered reading rule gives a spread of 0.048176 over the fifteen cells, so the half-width is 2*s/sqrt(15) = 0.024878 (the 0.009482 two-point floor never binds) and the gated allocator-channel band is [-0.042803, +0.006954]. The Anchor's +0.010577 over its mask-free Parent therefore sits above the band's upper edge by 0.003623 under the position clause, while the band's own half-width is 2.35 times that gain, which the same rule's width clause classes as leaving the restriction uncalibrated. The median_2 band is [-0.014090, +0.007792] (R -0.003149, half-width 0.010941 from its three cells 0.228969/0.221824/0.226250). Of the four protected task means, deco_hop, drd2_docking and zaleplon_mpo stay within margin and sitagliptin_mpo falls 0.088529, beyond its 0.02 margin. In-regime behaviour is otherwise the Anchor's: zero of 890 restricted purchases outside the eligible forty, mean predicted rank 10.96 against 11.70, increment mass 0.483876 against 0.547037, 25 of 89 restricted batches breaking the stall against 25 of 88, and unchanged diversity (115.5 distinct scaffolds per session against 117.5, mean pairwise similarity 0.312 against 0.311).

The scale the campaign went looking for now exists in the right channel, and it does not rescue the restriction. Matching the channel was supposed to be what made the earlier number too wide: the gated breeding-channel half-width was 0.023549, and the hope was that perturbing the stream the restriction itself acts in would give something near the 0.009482 the mask-free Parent showed. It gave 0.024878 - slightly wider than the breeding-channel figure, two and a half times the margin it has to price. So channel mismatch was never the reason the scale was wide, and the two remaining explanations the campaign had for calling the element uncalibrated have collapsed into one.

That one reason is now measured precisely, and it is the finding worth carrying forward. The Anchor's entire +0.010577 over its mask-free Parent is two cells: sitagliptin_mpo seed 0 (+0.071580) and seed 1 (+0.144470), with the other thirteen cells averaging -0.004415. This run, which changes no rule and only reorders the words one generator reads inside about one round in five, moved those same two cells by -0.093646 and -0.171941 - each larger than the gain it carries - while the other thirteen cells moved by an average of -0.000252 and never by more than 0.0221. The breeding-channel reference moved the identical pair by -0.102470 and -0.157500. Two placebos in two different streams, with two different gates, hit the same two cells by the same order of magnitude and leave the rest of the panel alone. The Anchor's margin is therefore not merely unseparated from path luck; it is located exactly where this method's endpoint is least reproducible, and no reading that leans on those two cells can price any mechanism at this budget. The useful corollary for planning is cheap to state: on this Anchor, a thirteen-cell or two-cell reading is a statement about sitagliptin_mpo, not about an algorithm, and a difference below roughly 0.025 on the fifteen-cell panel is not readable as a rule effect in this exposure class at all.

Reported as an observation and not as this node's claim, median_2 says the same thing from the other side. All three of its seeds diverged early (records 41, 181 and 81), and the top-25 Murcko scaffold sets of this run and the Anchor share nothing on any seed - not one scaffold, not one molecule - yet the three cells land within 0.0162 of the Anchor's, two of them above. The objective's own landscape explains it: the best of 870 proposals is 0.228969 against a 900-record median of 0.187508, 35 distinct scaffolds share the top 50, and single-atom ring relabellings score within 0.009 of the leader. sitagliptin_mpo seed 2 makes the point sharply: it diverged at record 171 and still finished on exactly 0.620122, from a different molecule. So median_2 is nearly blind as a discriminator of allocation rules at 300 calls - its cells will agree whatever the search does - while sitagliptin_mpo is where all the variance lives. A future measurement on this host should expect to learn almost nothing from median_2 and should be designed around sitagliptin_mpo's instability rather than averaging over it.

On the method itself, two measured limitations, both inherited rather than introduced here. First, the surrogate ranks worst exactly where the restriction makes it decisive: the within-batch agreement between predicted and realized scores is 0.377 across the 89 restricted batches against 0.560 across the 346 unrestricted ones (Anchor 0.392 against 0.547), so the stall reflex responds to a stall by narrowing all ten purchases onto the part of the posterior ordering that is least trustworthy in that regime - and the narrowing is not inert, since 76 of 89 restricted batches buy a different batch than a passive full-mask replay of the same drawn rows would. The class of change that could remove this is a different ranking model (one fitted to order candidates rather than to regress their scores, or one that prices its own disagreement) or a stall response that changes where proposals come from instead of narrowing allocation over the same surrogate; a different K or M cannot fix a ranking that is wrong in the regime it governs. Second, late search is local refinement of one inherited skeleton: distinct Murcko scaffolds per 100 proposals fall from 54.2 in the first hundred to 36.0 in the last hundred, and a quarter of each session's final hundred proposals sit on the final best molecule's own scaffold (the Anchor: 55.0 to 36.7, and 26.7 per cent). The molecular report finds the same thing chemically - ring N-S and N-N bonds produced by relabelling one ring atom, scoring within 0.009 of the leader - which points at a proposal operator with skeleton-level moves (ring replacement, valence-aware ring vocabulary, fragment-level recombination late in the budget) rather than any reweighting of the seven existing edits. Neither diagnosis is about this node, which reproduces the Anchor's diversity profile exactly as a law-free offset should.

What stays open. This is one dependent realization: it bounds a departure, estimates nothing, and supports no significance statement in either direction. Whether the eligibility restriction contributes anything on this host is still unanswered, and the catalog's empty evidence list for it is unchanged by this node. The two ungated allocator-channel positions of this same round are still in flight, so the confined-versus-whole-run comparison within this channel cannot yet be made. And the measurement that could still separate the restriction from regime-confined luck is the one the campaign already named: a mask-confined variant on the Anchor's own path, or any design that does not have to read its answer out of sitagliptin_mpo seeds 0 and 1.

nodes.hypothesis: Gate two-cut graph crossover by reciprocal equality of the retained and opposite discarded endpoint contexts, preserving the Parent fragment draws and routing mismatches through its existing mutation fallback.
nodes.finding:
The gate rejected 18,963 otherwise valid joins, including 18,158 that were also novel and encodable. Every one of the 847 surviving applicable joins satisfied both independently reconstructed endpoint matches. The channel remained usable, but barely: only two changed pure crossovers reached evaluation, alongside 27 crossovers followed by mutation. Crossover evaluations fell from 1,133 to 29, and their best-parent beats fell from 121 to two. Overall graph yield improved from 452/2,850 to 541/2,710 best-parent beats; on the same observed batch prefixes, the Parent had 437/2,710. All 271 reached graph batches were full, and all 143 reserved first descendants had real current policy ancestry. However, a feedback identity error stopped one task at 90 of 300 evaluations, so the panel used 4,290 of 4,500 calls and has no complete three-seed score. The two completed seed macro scores rose from 0.542383 to 0.565620 and from 0.579854 to 0.586448. Across complete three-seed task endpoints, sitagliptin rose by 0.163068 and deco_hop by 0.010448, while median_2 fell by 0.020074 and drd2 by 0.002229. Zaleplon fell by 0.006004 over the two completed seeds.

Exact local attachment matching can suppress genuinely available mismatched grafts while preserving a small usable crossover channel. Its dominant effect here was to replace crossover with first-parent mutation: 23 of the 27 later-mutated crossover emissions had reproduced a parent before mutation, and only six evaluated emissions had a changed immediate recombination product. Better overall graph yield therefore does not establish better recombination. Mutation work rose from about 149 to 192 attempts per graph request, and scaffold variety within individual task/seed pools narrowed even though every pool filled. The rule also preserves unusual chemistry already accepted in a source: both pure crossover emissions retained N–F bonds, and the broader output still contained N–O and N–N environments and unspecified stereochemistry. The strong sitagliptin score increase cannot be read as improved synthetic quality. The completion failure is separately explained by an inherited molecule reader alternating between two aromatic SMILES representations after a protected ring-closing mutation; it does not erase the measured gate activation. Full three-seed utility and a useful contribution from compatible recombination remain unresolved.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove the per-sign reservation from bounded inverse-motif installation: select up to the inherited four changed motifs by the Parent's global descending absolute occurrence-change and canonical-motif rank without sign quotas, preserving inherited insertion order on coincident selections and retaining the same-transition bidirectional veto and memory lifecycle.
nodes.finding:
The removal executed exactly and changed 116 of 420 memory installations that could affect later proposals. Most still retained both signs: 414 of 420, while total selected motif-change magnitude increased by only one count. On the Child’s recorded history, restoring balanced selection would change twelve gate decisions: ten candidates were newly admitted by the removal and two were newly vetoed. This reached actual scored allocation and selected states. Eight of fifteen task/seed trajectories changed; all fifteen finished. The three-seed mean final Top-1 score fell from 0.521759 to 0.509908, a paired loss of 0.011851 that exceeds the allowed 0.002 decline. Seed effects were +0.009516, -0.041309 and -0.003760. Sitagliptin supplied the largest loss, especially seed 1 at -0.195597, and DRD2 also declined; zaleplon improved. Mean recorded AUC fell from 0.393354 to 0.391556. The mechanism is confirmed, and the non-inferiority prediction is rejected.

Keeping both signs available is not enough to preserve the contribution of balanced memory allocation. Which motif representatives inherit each transition’s provenance matters even when capacity, magnitude ranking, veto logic and memory lifetime stay fixed. Ten relaxed admissions produced only one source improvement, one tie and eight losses, with no immediate archive gains; most changed the batch cutoff without becoming the next state. Conversely, one added veto enabled an oxygen-deletion refill that did improve the zaleplon archive. These opposing local effects show why fewer vetoes cannot stand in for better search. The loss supports retaining the quota in the developed method on this panel, while leaving the responsible individual replacements unresolved: ten conditional comparison batches lack a tenth recorded member, and passive memories do not define independently evolved walks or scores. Chemistry remained in the same aromatic/carbonyl, aryl-amine and sulfur-cage families, with nearly unchanged size and persistent reactive heteroatom bonds and unspecified stereochemistry. The observed score tradeoff therefore does not establish improved chemical feasibility.
