nodes.hypothesis: Remove descending-score priority from historical replay membership by uniformly sampling the inherited number of eligible original accepted elites without replacement, using the already-consumed session draw and sorting its selected indices into inherited memory order, while retaining score-ranked memory retention, inverse-exposure historical weighting and individual target ceilings.
nodes.finding:
Uniform selection changed the historical identity subset in all 405 nonterminal updates with surplus eligible records. It replaced 1,705 historical row appearances relative to ranked selection on the same states. Every changed subset had lower mean accepted reward than the strongest available subset, and every one changed the weighted gradient direction after clipping, beyond the measured padding discrepancy. The 15 no-surplus controls had exactly zero selection-gradient difference. All 450 real first backward passes matched the actual training objective exactly and produced parameter movement.

Summing distinct replayed identities separately within each task and seed, coverage rose from 525 to 1,023. Mean previous fitting count fell from 4.529 to 1.930, while mean accepted replay reward fell from 0.360292 to 0.286586. On the child's own states, a passive score-ranked selection would have mean reward 0.376524: its 0.089938 advantage establishes the immediate loss of reward enrichment without pretending that this comparator is a separately trained policy.

All fifteen task sessions completed their budgets. Mean final Top-1 fell from 0.522705 to 0.499302, a paired change of -0.023403, exceeding the allowed loss of 0.002. Seed changes were -0.012824, -0.008929 and -0.048456; population standard deviation fell from 0.020072 to 0.006326 around the lower mean. Task means changed by +0.007883 for zaleplon, -0.026559 for deco-hop, -0.002636 for docking, -0.000532 for median similarity and -0.095172 for sitagliptin. The losses in deco-hop and sitagliptin occurred in every seed. Mean recorded AUC nevertheless rose from 0.405593 to 0.417991. The endpoint non-inferiority prediction is therefore rejected even though selection and learning activation are confirmed.

Raw duplicate draws fell from 32.21% to 22.56%, and batches needing extra sampling fell from 16 to one. Raw validity fell from 91.79% to 90.15%, but all 4,350 submitted proposals in each panel were accepted as valid and novel. Distinct nonempty molecular cores increased from 2,813 to 2,889. Among the 4,200 accepted molecules following historical updates, strict incumbent improvements fell from 135 to 87; the number sharing a core with the immediately selected history fell from 44 to 11. These are observed molecular outcomes, with initialization and terminal learning kept outside that comparison.

Score priority still contributes to final performance in the combination with exposure weighting and target ceilings. Broader reuse, fewer duplicate draws, broader core coverage and higher average AUC did not make it dispensable. Matching loaded priors and exact behavior through the first 30 accepted observations in every session narrow the intervention to the changed historical subsets. The experiment removes selection priority while preserving score-biased admission and retention; it does not establish that historical replay itself is necessary or unnecessary. The original comparison with current-only learning still has only one paired seed.

Keeping the historical loss share at one half did not keep historical influence constant. The less frequently practiced history began much further from its fixed targets: mean historical squared residual increased from 3.252 to 25.281, and the mean normalized historical-only gradient norm rose from 42.83 to 432.30 on the resulting trajectories. Historical residuals worsened on fewer rows during fitting, 303 instead of 905, yet endpoint performance deteriorated. This narrows a plausible explanation to spending more learning effort on weaker, less practiced history; neither residual improvement nor a fixed coefficient share proves useful preservation. The passive ranked comparator also has a lower previous fitting count than actual uniform history on the child's states, 1.642 versus 1.930, illustrating why a local comparator cannot stand in for the count state of a separately evolved parent.

The molecular assessment explains why additional cores are an incomplete success criterion. The output remains rich in medicinal rings and polar linkers, but broader coverage did not reliably preserve the stronger combinations of compact shape and polar-group arrangement seen in the parent. Oversized growth, unusual attachment chemistry and absent stereochemical definition remain. Those associations do not identify a universal missing functional group or prove the cause of a score change. The remaining question is how to retain useful exploration while preserving replay's reward enrichment; this panel does not identify a replacement selection rule.

nodes.hypothesis: Replace raw accepted-score regression targets inside the retained count-GP selector with deterministic standard-normal midrank targets, preserving exact score ties and applying the inherited centering and population-SD normalization, while all search-state updates and endpoints continue to use real raw scores.
nodes.finding:
The exact tie-preserving map changes all 435 fitted target vectors and all 435 selected sets. All latent models, raw-reference controls and raw-feedback joins reconstruct; normalized covariance and original random draws remain unchanged on identical inputs. Yet mean within-batch ordering correlation falls from the raw reference’s 0.484299 to 0.443166 on the same scored molecules. Mean raw endpoint falls from 0.595670 to 0.574603, a loss of 0.021067 instead of the required 0.002 gain. Seed macro changes are -0.043227, +0.022366 and -0.042341. Six task-seed endpoints improve and nine decline; all three median_2 endpoints improve. Macro dispersion decreases from 0.026593 to 0.011472. Every evaluation completes.

The missing benefit is not explained by an unexposed transformation or unchanged choices: ordinal targets alter the entire panel, but their registered ordering advantage fails. Preserving observed label order is insufficient to preserve useful cardinal spacing or improve prediction on newly selected molecules. Even so, all three median_2 endpoints improve while their ordering correlations worsen, and raw parent beats and incumbent gains rise from 629/258 to 655/272 despite the lower overall endpoint mean. Those counterexamples prevent treating ordering correlation or local gains as complete explanations of search utility. Six distinct-molecule pool pairs still share both folded and native count vectors. Conventional aryl amines and carbonyl families remain useful alongside reactive bonds, complex rings and unspecified stereochemistry; target remapping does not repair those chemistry or identity limits. Latent uncertainty has no established raw-score calibration, and no raw-unit error or coverage proxy is substituted. This is a negative result for the rank-target increment on this composition, while the earlier positive evidence for the composite selector remains intact; the role of lost cardinal gaps and later adaptive paths is unresolved.

nodes.hypothesis: Conditional integration of the measured shared-mean virtual-root consumer with the Parent direct-frontier controller. For parent_id == 0 only, use S/D (or the inherited neutral 0.5 when D=0) in exploitation; for every parent_id != 0 retain B/D. D=sum_j K_ij*N_j, S=sum_j K_ij*W_j, B=sum_j K_ij*N_j*M_j over N_j>0 and P=sum_j K_ij*O_j remain exactly inherited. Retain the 0.5*sqrt(2*log(max(2,N_parent+O_parent))/(D+P)) bonus, D+P==0 priority and earliest occurrence tie rule. Root mean can reduce domination by isolated remembered peaks, spreading real direct-frontier purchases across initial roots and enabling more useful later refinement without altering deeper peak selection. Zero successful suffix transitions, path-local accepted-only credit and all generation/admission laws remain capabilities of the actual Parent. This one code-Parent experiment measures the combination conditional on zero rollout, not independent effects or a numerical sum of source effects.
nodes.finding:
The selector ran correctly in all fifteen sessions. It changed 3,439 of 4,565 root decisions while preserving deeper peak selection, zero rollout and exact accepted/pending credit. Root follow-up broadened from 141 to 149 of 150 supplied roots, and late follow-up from 112 to 149. Purchase concentration fell in every session, with mean root HHI dropping from 0.33055 to 0.18002. More paid frontiers were later selected on a route that produced an accepted descendant: 1,550 versus 1,359. But those routes yielded fewer descendant purchases, 3,070 versus 3,191, and less associated gain, 0.67517 versus 1.18928. Full-budget gain per purchase fell from 0.00048141 to 0.00025426; late-budget gain fell from 0.00050541 to 0.00020497. Thus wider access did not produce the predicted sustained useful conversion.

Mean endpoint score fell from 0.34810 to 0.28223, a paired loss of 0.06587 against the registered minimum gain of 0.002. All three seed means fell, by 0.06635, 0.12582 and 0.00546. Seven task/seed endpoints improved and eight worsened; the largest loss was 0.60485 on docking seed 1, and all three sitagliptin endpoints declined. Concentration remains mixed: paired root gain HHI and the largest cell share fell, while the largest single-receipt share rose slightly from 16.60% to 16.82%. The formal Anchor mean remains 0.60703. All sessions completed; no technical failure explains the loss.

This experiment separates successful redistribution from useful search. The root selector clearly changes allocation, and more distinct frontiers receive later paid follow-up, yet the total amount and value of descendant refinement decline. That refutes the registered integration benefit and its sustained-conversion explanation on this panel. It does not refute the selector’s ability to broaden coverage, the Parent’s direct-frontier mechanism, or every possible tree-search intervention. The earlier root-mean source already showed a late-gain loss under a different rollout condition; its favorable whole-run score cannot be added to the direct-frontier result. This conditional combination supplies contrary measured evidence, without rewriting either source verdict or establishing causal mediation by a particular route.

The method’s limitation is not a lack of graph variety alone. Deeper decisions fell from 6,986 to 5,702, and 2,757 of 4,525 nonroot occurrences still received only one completed return. Molecular assessment finds hundreds of scaffolds per objective but repeated high-scoring use of inherited aromatic scaffold families, with useful coordinated aromatic and nitrogen-containing arrangements reached by the Parent sometimes absent from the Child’s upper tail. Tiny fragments and oversized joins persist: 468 proposals have fewer than six heavy atoms and 177 exceed fifty, versus 432 and 165 for the Parent. These observations support a limitation in converting broad graph edits into useful connected molecular arrangements; they do not establish global scaffold collapse, an absent atom type, or chemical stability from a score. A proposal scheme that preserves and recombines useful connected groups, or an allocation scheme that learns which branches support repeatable descendant gain, could address that kind of limitation. Neither alternative was tested here, and broader coverage or a numerical retune alone is not evidence that it would work. No literature component was newly adopted: this was an internal-evidence combination, with the recorded source paper serving only as context.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove cross-candidate dependence from allocation residual draws by sampling independent Gaussian residuals with the Parent's unchanged jittered marginal variances, while retaining the fitted count-based joint posterior.
nodes.finding:
Allocation cross-covariance was removed in all 426 recorded child batches while each jittered marginal variance was preserved. All recorded draws and all 4,260 masked winners reconstruct from the original normals. Replaying correlated draws on the same child pools changes 1,962 selection positions and 411 of 426 batch sets. The other fifteen sets coincide despite changed draw values; they are downstream non-effects, not failed covariance removal. Initial pools, predicted means, raw standard deviations and normal arrays match the parent exactly in all fifteen sessions.

Fourteen task runs finished. Deco-hop seed 0 timed out after 210 of 300 evaluations, so that seed has no final macro score and the full three-seed non-inferiority test cannot be decided. The two complete seeds improve by +0.011662 and +0.013814: their mean final Top-1 is 0.580592 versus 0.567854 for the same parent seeds. These two successful replicas cannot replace the missing result; the incomplete seed already loses 0.084067 on its completed sitagliptin task. Across the fourteen completed task pairs, mean recorded AUC falls from 0.474455 to 0.441510.

In matched available evaluation windows containing 4,260 scored offspring per panel, strict beats of the best generating parent rise from 615 to 690, and incumbent improvements rise from 238 to 272. Mean offspring-minus-best-parent score is still negative, changing from -0.085277 to -0.072497. The session-averaged accepted batch maximum falls from 0.487030 to 0.456226. Distinct nonempty cores fall from 1,778 to 1,711, while the largest core occupies an average 61.3% of each session's top ten proposals, versus 57.3% before. Prediction MSE falls from 0.011505 to 0.009159, but nominal 95% latent-interval coverage also falls, from 76.74% to 74.20%. These describe changed evaluated streams, not repaired calibration or scores for unselected alternatives.

Small average model correlations can still have a large effect on who wins a sampled maximum. All recorded pools offered a covariance-removal opportunity, and almost every batch set changed even though every candidate retained the same fitted mean and sampled marginal variance on fixed inputs. Removing stochastic dependence also did not make the selected chemistry independent: on the child's same pools, actual selected-pair absolute model correlation is 0.05568 versus 0.05137 under correlated replay, and mean nonempty core coverage is 6.64 versus 6.77. Independence of allocation noise is therefore neither a scaffold-diversity constraint nor removal of the fitted joint model.

The completed seeds leave the narrower dependence-removal hypothesis plausible, but the timeout and mixed task outcomes prevent calling dependence dispensable. The retained full factorization succeeds at its first jitter in every recorded batch. The timed-out stream ends after a complete allocation and emission, with ten externally scored molecules lacking candidate feedback. Its measured fitting time is only 0.46 seconds across twenty fits; the records do not isolate the source of the long task wall time. The parent already needed about 3,265 seconds on that same task and seed, so the evidence does not establish a new covariance-factorization failure or a speed benefit from this change.

The molecular assessment explains why additional local parent beats do not settle chemical progress. Familiar aromatic, amide and amine families still coexist with reactive heteroatom bonds, repeated large assemblies and constrained closures. In matched windows, molecules containing rings of at most four atoms increase from 268 to 920, and products exceeding sixty heavy atoms increase from 168 to 320. Both panels leave every detected tetrahedral centre unassigned. These are observed coverage and plausibility limits; they neither explain the timeout uniquely nor prove that removing a particular bond or scaffold would improve scores.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove individual zero-ceiling projection only from selected historical replay targets: fit t_i = frozen_prior_log_likelihood_i + 60 * accepted_score_i for historical members, while current elites retain t_i = min(frozen_prior_log_likelihood_i + 60 * accepted_score_i, 0), preserving all selected membership, inverse-exposure coefficients and squared-residual Adam updates.
nodes.finding:
All 180 nonterminal updates with positive historical targets changed the learning direction after clipping. The intervention restored 566 historical target appearances that the parent would have capped, while preserving every current target and replay coefficient. Across all 420 nonterminal history updates, mean historical likelihood-derivative pressure increased from 1.211 to 4.849, and every real first backward matched the intended objective. The six median and sitagliptin sessions had no eligible targets and reproduced the parent's complete trajectories exactly.

Mean final Top-1 fell from 0.522705 to 0.513006, a paired decline of 0.009699 that exceeds the registered 0.002 effect. Seed changes were +0.003786, -0.001762 and -0.031122. Decoration hopping lost 0.025509 on average and declined in every seed; zaleplon lost 0.019707 despite improving in two seeds; docking lost 0.003279, concentrated in seed two. The other task means were unchanged. Population score dispersion fell from 0.020072 to 0.004937, and all fifteen sessions completed. Recorded mean AUC was nearly unchanged, 0.405593 to 0.405885.

Raw duplicate draws rose from 32.21% to 39.50%, and batches needing extra sampling rose from sixteen to forty-five. Decoration hopping explored more distinct nonempty molecular cores, 439 versus 355, while finishing worse; zaleplon core coverage contracted from 539 to 505. These coverage and sampling changes do not substitute for the score result.

The historical ceiling contributes useful control even when current elites remain capped and score priority and inverse-exposure weighting remain active. Recovering distinctions among positive historical targets increased their upward probability pressure but did not improve final search quality. The exact inactive sessions and matched policy prefixes rule out changed preparation or a universally different update path as explanations for this result. The improved seed and heterogeneous task responses still preclude a universal claim or an additive decomposition of current and historical ceiling benefits.

The large fitting residuals are partly unavoidable: positive sequence log-probability targets cannot be attained. Historical weighted error on the child's recorded states fell from 121.816 to 110.472 under the restored targets, while the all-capped comparator evaluated on those same states fell from 3.798 to 1.799. This separates an impossible target demand from failure to fit the feasible boundary; the comparator did not run an alternative policy. Clipping reduced gradient magnitude without erasing the directional intervention, and the higher duplicate burden is consistent with spending more draws revisiting structures. Individual current ceilings still do not ensure jointly feasible targets.

The chemistry assessment narrows the limitation further: familiar medicinal scaffolds remain available, yet broader decoration-hop core coverage moves into a lower-scoring leading family. Productive attachment patterns and size balance matter beyond adding more cores or restoring target distinctions. Missing stereochemical specification and uneven molecular size remain shared limitations, not consequences uniquely diagnosed by this ablation. The evidence supports retaining the historical ceiling in this composition while leaving its task dependence and interaction with repeated fitting open.

nodes.hypothesis: Modify only the membership of each already-eligible fresh-root episode. At the beginning of observe capture the earliest accepted global incumbent record before any feedback from that boundary. After every pending return has been reconciled, when the inherited strict-improvement-and-positive-remaining-budget trigger fires, initialize exactly two fresh roots in order [new earliest accepted global incumbent, captured pre-observe incumbent]. Each distinct root receives exactly its own original accepted receipt as one cached context return. All old topology and visits are discarded as in the Parent; the initial supplied forest and trigger remain unchanged. The two origins compete through the inherited count-Tanimoto sibling peak B/D plus pending exploration. This is a single origin-membership intervention whose necessary consequences include two-root competition and a super-root normalized by two real cached contexts plus new episode purchases; it does not separately identify breadth, context or competition mediation.
nodes.finding:
The extra origin was fully active: all 115 preceding-incumbent roots produced accepted descendants, totaling 1,686 purchases, while all 115 current-incumbent roots also remained accessible and supplied 1,894 purchases. The Parent supplied 3,580 purchases from its single current origin. The preceding origins produced 47 strict incumbent improvements, so their access was real and sometimes useful. They nevertheless failed to improve total conversion: late gain per paid molecule fell from 0.00062872 to 0.00039798, and full gain per paid molecule fell from 0.00100346 to 0.00093958. Current-origin first access remained immediate, but only 72 of 115 current origins produced a global improvement, compared with 101 of 114 Parent origins. All fifteen sessions completed and receipt, root-membership and selection checks found no mismatch. The complete paired mean score fell from 0.499496 to 0.480970, a change of −0.018526; eight task/seed endpoints improved, six declined and one tied. Two of three seed means declined. The frozen +0.002 Parent utility criterion failed, and the result remained 0.126060 below the formal Anchor. The registered late-conversion and endpoint predictions are refuted; execution and descendant access are supported.

Keeping a recent alternative can preserve useful proposals without blocking access to the newest incumbent, but access alone does not preserve refinement quality. Almost 47% of post-promotion purchases went to the preceding origin. Its 47 improvements did not offset the lost gain mass elsewhere, even though the total number of strict improvements stayed at 148. The late result was also more concentrated: one receipt supplied 43% of late gain and one session supplied 51%. This settles the registered two-origin adjustment under this complete panel, not the wider tree approach or the Parent’s established restart capability; whether breadth, competition or changed proposal paths caused the loss remains unresolved. The borrowed solution-to-origin element operated, while the simultaneous two-root adaptation failed its own benefit prediction, so the result is not a verdict on the source algorithm.

The trajectories show a limitation of the search method beyond root access. Typed scaffold coverage rose from 1,704 to 1,837, yet fragment-excluded within-session molecular similarity also rose, especially late, from 0.42764 to 0.46865. Broad aggregate coverage therefore coexists with increasingly local refinement. Internal failed routes fell from 541 to 146, but that efficiency improvement did not translate into higher scores. Molecular assessment finds useful ring/amine/carbonyl arrangements mixed with 319 tiny fragments, 244 molecules above fifty heavy atoms, reactive heteroatom linkages and unspecified stereochemistry. Useful structures are reachable; their relationships are not reliably preserved during graph edits. A proposal operator that makes coherent scaffold or fragment changes while preserving those relationships is a plausible way to address this limitation, but this experiment does not establish its benefit or select its recipe. Neither additional root access nor fewer invalid actions alone resolves that structural limitation.

nodes.hypothesis: Replace fixed-width folded Morgan count coordinates with occurrence counts keyed by the corresponding native unfolded environment hash identifiers, using the same generalized count-Tanimoto covariance so distinct modulo-bin aliases no longer mix in posterior similarities.
nodes.finding:
Native counts preserve multiplicity and remove modulo-bin mixing on 41,278 of 69,600 pool occurrences. All 435 pool kernels change against their folded controls, changing 392 selected sets while 43 sets remain identical. Nine distinct-molecule pairs still share native count vectors. Every active fit and choice reconstructs, and every evaluation completes. Mean endpoint score falls from 0.595670 to 0.547507, a decrease of 0.048163 rather than the required 0.002 increase. Seed macro changes are -0.077453, -0.013541 and -0.053495. Six task-seed endpoints improve and nine decline; all three median_2 endpoints improve. Macro dispersion drops from 0.026593 to 0.000322 around the lower mean.

The experiment rules out insufficient representation or allocation exposure as an explanation for the missing gain. Removing folding changes ordinary similarity relationships and adaptive choices, but it does not reliably help the retained optimizer. On the same Child selected molecules, prediction MSE improves only slightly, from 0.007847 to 0.007808, and interval coverage rises from 75.36% to 75.82%; those diagnostics do not rescue the endpoint result. All three median_2 streams worsen in prediction MSE while improving at the endpoint, further limiting a simple prediction-to-search explanation. Exact native-count ties remain, as do finite-hash and local-environment limits. The molecular output retains useful aromatic, amine, urea and carbonyl organization alongside reactive bonds, crowded rings and unspecified stereochemistry; neither the losses nor the median_2 gains establish a universal size or chemical-feasibility rule. This is a negative result for the incremental unfolding variant on this composition, not a reversal of the earlier evidence for retaining occurrence counts. Changed means and covariance, adaptive graph paths and possible lost accidental regularization remain unresolved mediators.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove latest-transition refresh of an already-live signed inverse-motif restriction: preserve its original entry and expiry unchanged, treating repeated selected-transition credit for that signed key as a no-op until ordinary expiry or release makes the key absent.
nodes.finding:
All 48 overlapping requests preserved the original restriction and its deadline, with zero refreshes or backfilled credit slots. On the recorded search history, this changed five candidate decisions across four batches: four vetoes disappeared and one was added. All fifteen task–seed runs completed. Mean final Top-1 fell from 0.521759 to 0.518794, a paired decline of 0.002965 that exceeds the 0.002 non-inferiority margin; population SD rose from 0.006329 to 0.008617. All eligible nonzero uncertainty corrections reduced the raw gradient's uncertainty directional derivative, and every optimization retained a positive confidence gain; none needed a fallback.

On the single supplied seed, macro Top-1 fell from 0.361872 to 0.307903, a loss of 0.053969. The posterior covers coefficient uncertainty conditional on an empirical noise estimate; it does not cover attachment choices, stereochemistry or the gap between a relaxed state and its assembled molecule. nodes.hypothesis: Two-region graph-local posterior control with observed-progress contraction and restart. The coupled unit is (region, episode): a scored incumbent, a task-local seed set and accepted descendant labels, an independently conditioned count-GP, a finite successful-edit-path radius and counters updated solely by that episode's real accepted purchases. Each field contains region-labeled descendants of the two current centers. Independent local joint function draws are restored to raw objective units, concatenated and competed for the entire announced oracle batch, without regional purchase quotas or a global posterior-mean stall mask. A region with repeated measured failure contracts; repeated failure at minimum extent retires its episode and resets its local fit at a different already scored task-local center. Regional ownership, local support and reset are causally coupled, not a mixture average over one global pool. The intended path is separate local fits -> region-dependent raw sample prices and purchased descendants -> feedback-dependent extent and restart -> useful local progress after contraction/restart -> potentially more global incumbent increment per actual evaluation. It does not assume that graph-path radius is graph edit distance or that additional scaffolds alone improve the score.
nodes.finding:
The construction and control checks passed across all fifteen sessions: 870 separate local fits replaced 435 global fits, all 4,350 purchases matched the raw-score sample auction, and the controller made 38 contractions, 16 expansions and 15 actual restarts. Thirteen restarted episodes received purchases and nine improved their local and global incumbents. Across 850 post-restart purchases, local improvement totaled 0.19539 and global improvement 0.14911. Yet the complete panel produced more, smaller global improvements: 278 versus 253, with total improvement falling from 5.97807 to 5.44337 over the same 4,350 optimizer evaluations. Improvement per evaluation fell from 0.00137427 to 0.00125135, triggering the registered useful-conversion falsifier. Mean endpoint score fell from 0.60703 to 0.57138, a paired change of -0.03565; one seed improved and two declined. Gains on zaleplon, median_2 and the drd2 mean did not offset losses on deco_hop and sitagliptin. This is an executed mechanism with a refuted conversion claim, not a technical failure or merely a missed endpoint threshold.

Independent models and working restarts were insufficient to sustain useful competition between regions. Both regions received labels in ten sessions, but 406 of 435 batches bought from only one region. Two restarted regions spent 42 later fits and 3,360 proposals with one training label, scale 0.001 and no purchases; the correct no-purchase rule then left their state unchanged. This identifies a limitation in cross-region uncertainty calibration and feedback exposure. A model that compares uncertainty across very different local data sizes, or a search scheme that can replace unexposed regions, is the kind of methodological change that could address it; these data do not show which would improve scores.

The molecular evidence also separates field variety from useful accepted exploration. Generated-field similarity fell from 0.60468 to 0.49733, while purchased-molecule similarity rose from 0.71338 to 0.75259. Small-fragment purchases increased from 91 to 133 and produced no global gain; purchases above fifty heavy atoms increased from 44 to 284 and contributed only 0.04083 total global improvement. Repeated aromatic/carbonyl and fluorinated heterocyclic families still dominate successful structures, with reactive heteroatom caps and unspecified stereochemistry. A construction method that preserves coherent alternative cores is relevant to that limitation, but chemical plausibility is not demonstrated to improve this benchmark.

The three borrowed local-model, adaptive-neighborhood and restart elements operated in their declared graph adaptations. Their continuous or categorical guarantees do not transfer: one successful graph step can change size substantially, and reset initialization has only one known label. The result settles the frozen joint configuration’s claim of better budget conversion. It does not isolate the contributions of local fitting, removing the old mask, graph construction or restart, nor end the broader local-optimization approach. The total global-increment mass telescopes to endpoint improvement from the common initial best, so it is not an independent causal proof of why the score changed.

The fixed first-parent control now has an informative answer; support-only value, chemical mediation, the partner-only control and whole-foundation contribution remain open.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove historical replay from the active optimization loss, fitting only the unchanged current accepted elites to their individually ceiling-projected targets with a plain mean squared residual, while retaining historical memory, selection and exposure bookkeeping solely as passive comparison state.
nodes.finding:
Historical examples received exactly zero loss weight and zero likelihood derivatives in all 5,220 real optimizer steps containing history. All 420 history-bearing updates followed by proposals changed the gradient direction after clipping; every real first backward matched the current-only objective exactly. All fifteen matched initialization controls reproduced the same first twenty accepted records, and every session completed its budget.

Mean final Top-1 fell from 0.522705 to 0.495640, a paired decrease of 0.027066, exceeding the registered 0.002 effect. Seed changes were +0.008523, -0.023353 and -0.066368; population score dispersion fell from 0.020072 to 0.011865. Every task mean fell, led by sitagliptin (-0.072443) and deco-hop (-0.041088), then median (-0.015291), zaleplon (-0.006499) and docking (-0.0000068). Recorded mean AUC nevertheless rose from 0.405593 to 0.430068, with docking reaching strong scores earlier. The final-score loss therefore coexists with better discovery earlier in the recorded budget.

Current projected fitting error fell from 60.166 to 3.804 within updates. On the same actual updates, weighted error on passively observed history rose from 69.678 to 86.195; under active replay in the parent it fell from 3.366 to 2.436. Those are fitting measurements on each run's own states. Raw duplicate draws fell from 32.21% to 25.99%, and batches needing extra sampling fell from sixteen to three, while raw validity fell from 91.79% to 87.35%.

The developed learner still benefits from repeatedly fitting accepted history at the final endpoint. The parent's small historical gradients were not evidence that history was redundant: the records were already well fitted under continued replay. Once replay stopped, previously accepted examples often became much worse fitted even though current elites remained easy to fit. Matched initialization, exact loss isolation and the complete paired score panel support a contribution from replay in this composition. They do not show universal protection against forgetting, and the improved seed plus higher AUC leave the timing and task dependence of that contribution open.

The result separates useful search from generic novelty. Deco-hop explored more distinct nonempty molecular cores, 438 versus 355, yet finished worse. The supplied chemistry assessment finds familiar aromatic amide, sulfonamide and cyclic-amine families on both sides; generally smaller molecules and broad ring coverage did not reliably recover the stronger parent's fragment arrangements. New molecules shared a core with the selected historical set in 320 of 4,200 subsequent emissions, versus 685 with active replay, but that association cannot identify which remembered molecule caused a score change. Unspecified stereochemistry, oversized outliers and unstable-looking linker alternatives remain unresolved.

This removes historical loss contributions, not learned historical information: policy parameters and persistent Adam moments retain earlier current learning. Passive memory selection, exposure counts and union forwarding also remain, so fewer duplicate draws do not establish a replay runtime saving. Individual target ceilings remain active but do not make the joint current target set attainable: 177 of 420 nonterminal current sets still demand total sequence probability above one. Further contribution tests must keep those residual target constraints and the difference between early AUC and final quality explicit.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove off-diagonal completed density solely from the promoted-root exploration and zero-start consumer, on n-fc3b91c9623a and only when episode > 0 and parent_id == 0. For root i, keep D_i=sum_j K_ij*N_j and P_i=sum_j K_ij*O_j stored/computed exactly as before, but let active_started_i=N_i+P_i instead of D_i+P_i. nodes.finding:
All fifteen Search sessions completed. The removal increased exploration bonuses in 7,426 of 7,427 eligible root rows and changed 1,216 of 3,714 root choices: 1,186 switched from the current to the preceding incumbent origin and 30 switched back. Changed choices reached 1,158 of 4,350 paid molecules, including 717 of 2,175 late purchases. Fourteen task/seed cells were exposed; the never-promoted median_2 seed-0 session remained exactly unchanged. Source and receipt checks found no isolation, arithmetic, credit or purchase-join discrepancy. The mean final Top-1 score fell from 0.5001487124432433 to 0.493992363073594, a paired change of -0.006156349369649354. This crosses the registered -0.002 utility falsifier. Seed mean changes were +0.012008293955467986, -0.017959810390718034 and -0.012517531673698012; six task/seed endpoints improved, eight worsened and one tied. Total incumbent-increment mass fell from 4.37484902101401 to 4.282503780469271 even though strict improvements rose from 142 to 150. The arithmetic and paid behavioral prediction happened; the registered expectation that this removal would be non-inferior did not. The result supports positive conditional contribution of shared completed exploration density when promoted roots use their own accepted-return peaks and still share pending density. It preserves the earlier value-only result and says nothing additive about pending density, deeper sharing or two-root membership. This is a scientific utility refutation, not an execution failure or a verdict on the whole tree-search approach. The controller bought 1,589 preceding-origin descendants instead of 785 and 1,991 current-origin descendants instead of 2,795. Preceding-origin increment mass rose from 0.27218464819532534 to 1.4796325349706514, while current-origin mass fell from 3.6563807047140133 to 2.3565875773939475. These descriptive allocations show that extra access and extra local peak renewals can coexist with lower total conversion; they do not identify which alternative purchase would have won. Most of the task-mean loss came from sitagliptin_mpo (-0.05076437433620579) and zaleplon_mpo (-0.01585388776582025), partly offset by drd2_docking (+0.03304154036490403). The chemistry does not support a simple scaffold-collapse diagnosis. Typed/generic scaffold unions increased from 1,684/1,188 to 1,811/1,288, while the fragment-excluded within-session count-Morgan similarity remained nearly unchanged (0.22278266458637686 to 0.22272000697904817). Fewer below-six-heavy-atom purchases (306 to 251) coexisted with more above-fifty purchases (289 to 314). Thus broader coverage and fewer fragments alone did not solve useful conversion. A proposal operator that preserves rewarded connected structural relationships during topology changes, or a search scheme that values expected further progress rather than peak renewal alone, could address that limitation; neither is tested here. No surrogate-ranking diagnosis is available because this active controller has no learned surrogate. Controlled runtime effects, safety, mediation and transfer beyond this finite Search panel remain open.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove optional ordinary single-parent mutation continuation (m-00000000000b). When the inherited saturation floor min(6, 1 + member_attempts // 80) equals one, each ordinary single-parent breeding attempt makes exactly one GraphOperators.mutate call. The original base-length draw rng.choices([1, 2, 3], [0.82, 0.15, 0.03]) is still made at its original position. When the floor exceeds one, the inherited max(base length, floor) walk is kept. Crossover and its finishing mutation, mutate's internal retries, the sulfur admission gate, pool size and correlated posterior allocation are unchanged.
nodes.finding:
The removal ran exactly as intended. In all 15 task/seed runs every ordinary single-parent mutation made one edit, suppressing 8,726 requested second and third edits; the Parent had made 8,742. About 18% of requests (7,463 of 41,716) asked for a longer walk and were cut to one edit, so the removal was exposed in every run. Before the first cut, each run reproduced the Parent molecule for molecule. No multi-edit offspring reached a pool or the oracle; the Parent evaluated 310 of them. Evaluated mutation offspring moved closer to their parents: mean Tanimoto similarity rose from 0.712 to 0.746, and the share below 0.5 fell from 6.2% to 1.9%. Crossover finishing (0.358), mutate retries, full 160-member pools and every posterior fit and selection were unchanged. One prediction failed. Ordinary sulfur-gate rejections were expected to fall below 100 but rose from 100 to 232. Multi-edit rejections did fall from 38 to zero, and the gate rule held in every case. Most of the rise (197 of 295 rejections) came from drd2, where the Child's populations drifted onto sulfur-bearing scaffolds: 97-99% of parents, against 21-41% in the Parent. The mean score fell from 0.5965 to 0.5658 (-0.0307), well past the 0.002 scale, and all three seeds were lower (-0.070, -0.007, -0.015). Nine of 15 task/seed cells were lower, four higher and two within the band. The largest single loss was deco_hop seed 0: the Parent's late 0.856 breakthrough was not reproduced and the Child ended at 0.607, accounting for -0.017 of the mean. Without that cell the loss is still -0.014. zaleplon was lower in all three seeds (-0.012 to -0.024), and in seed 1 the Parent's winning molecule was itself a two-edit product. sitagliptin was lower in all three seeds (-0.032 to -0.088). median_2 was slightly higher in all three (+0.001 to +0.025), and drd2 was mixed.

Optional multi-edit continuation now has a positive contribution on three different Parents: -0.027 on the ungated count-GP Parent, -0.019 on an exchange-containing Parent, and -0.031 here. The sulfur gate, which rejects multi-edit products disproportionately, did not change the sign, so the gap the catalog flagged for this Anchor is closed: keep continuation. The loss does not appear in local hit rates. Parent-beating offspring (648 to 659) and incumbent improvements (255 to 277) were flat or slightly up, and the single-edit products of formerly long requests were at least as productive per evaluation as the multi-edit ones they replaced (95 parent beats in 525 evaluations, against 43 in 310). So the value of the occasional two- or three-edit jump is not a higher success rate per proposal. It lies in the rarer larger moves that set where a run ends up: plateau escapes, late breakthroughs and the zaleplon winner that only a two-edit walk produced. That matches the Molecular assessment: without continuation, late leaders are one-atom permutations of a single inherited core, the 'refining familiar structures' pattern the research brief worries about, now somewhat stronger. Three cautions narrow the reading. First, about half the similarity gain comes from one-edit offspring themselves sitting closer to their parents in the diverged populations, not only from fewer long walks. Second, the uniform sitagliptin loss occurs where the Parent's multi-edit products never improved the incumbent, so part of the effect is adaptive divergence whose mechanism is unidentified. Third, sulfur-gate rejection counts track population chemistry rather than walk length, so they are a poor activation proxy. Worth trying next: a modestly larger or adaptive multi-edit share, testing the opposite direction. This removal does not locate an optimum, and the model-guided continuation variant lost 0.048 elsewhere, so more steps are not automatically better. Higher-floor saturation recovery and interactions with this round's kernel and pool-size siblings remain untested.

nodes.hypothesis: Project each selected sequence's augmented likelihood target independently onto the nonpositive log-probability half-line, t_i = min(frozen_prior_log_likelihood_i + 60 * accepted_score_i, 0), while preserving the Parent's inverse-exposure historical coefficients, selected membership and squared-residual Adam update.
nodes.finding:
All positive target excess was removed, and the change reached actual learning. Among 420 historical updates followed by proposals, 195 contained positive targets: 465 current and 602 historical row appearances were capped, removing 13,705.38 nats of unattainable target excess. Every affected update changed gradient direction after clipping. The three affected initialization updates did too. All 244 no-positive updates retained exactly the same local raw and projected gradient, and every one of the 450 real first backward passes matched the projected objective exactly. No capped row reversed from upward to downward likelihood pressure.

On the child's own historical training states, projection reduced the mean sum of absolute scalar learning factors from 12.795 to 6.305. Projected weighted squared error fell from 26.936 before learning to 2.984 afterward; error against the original raw targets on those same states fell from 135.072 to 97.457. Those are fitting measurements under different target definitions, not score gains. All fifteen tasks completed their budgets. Raw duplicate draws fell from 36.22% to 32.21%, and batches needing extra sampling fell from 29 to 16.

Mean final Top-1 rose from 0.517655 to 0.522705, a paired gain of 0.005050. Seed changes were -0.008594, +0.007415 and +0.016329. The gain was concentrated in deco-hop, whose task mean increased by 0.025328; docking rose by 0.001300 near its ceiling, zaleplon fell by 0.001379, and the other two tasks were unchanged. Mean recorded AUC fell from 0.406769 to 0.405593, so the endpoint gain did not produce faster useful discovery overall. Terminal updates establish execution only and contribute no later proposals.

Removing individually impossible demands can alter the direction of a clipped, exposure-weighted update without reversing any capped sequence's scalar learning direction. The matched controls make this attribution unusually clear: all six sessions without a positive target reproduced the parent's complete molecular records and scores exactly, and every changed session retained its matched proposal prefix until the first positive-target intervention. This narrows the effect to active target projection under the existing replay and optimizer rules.

The mechanism satisfies only the individual probability ceiling. Two hundred of the 420 historical updates still had combined projected target probability above one. Thirty-six batches set all ten selected targets to zero, erasing their raw target distinctions. Positive raw-target appearances actually increased from 977 to 1,067 as search changed; the mechanism removes their excess when fitting, rather than preventing such opportunities. Lower projected loss also does not protect every remembered row: 905 of 2,100 historical residuals worsened, almost the parent's 906, and 1,006 historical likelihoods decreased. Every repeated training appearance was consecutive, so these records cannot establish forgetting between skipped updates.

The chemical assessment places the main gain in a more concentrated decorated quinazoline family, while overall medicinal scaffolds remain ring-rich and attachment chemistry and stereochemical definition remain unresolved. Distinct observed cores increased for zaleplon despite its slightly lower endpoint and decreased for deco-hop despite its gain. That combination rules out treating broader core counts or lower duplication as a sufficient explanation for useful search. The open question is whether the endpoint benefit persists across seeds while retaining distinctions among saturated targets and preserving useful progress earlier in the budget.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove generated accepted records only from active GP conditioning by fitting immutable copies of the original usable initial accepted cohort, while recomputing the inherited score mean and scale from the full current accepted archive at every original fit call and retaining immediate live genetic feedback.
nodes.finding:
All 435 fits kept the same ten initial records in exact order while normalization used the growing accepted archive. The 4,200 generated records with a later fit never entered conditioning, but all entered normalization; 150 final records had no later opportunity. Every first batch matched the Parent exactly. After feedback, all 420 later sets differed from a full-conditioning reference on the same saved pools and normal draws. Of 3,608 actual accepted choices absent from those reference sets, 3,475 later entered normalization and 1,146 later bred. Across all offspring, 1,626 identities served as later parents, so feedback remained active outside conditioning.

All fifteen task runs completed. Mean final Top-1 fell from 0.595670 to 0.370013, a paired change of -0.225656 against the registered 0.002 loss scale. Seed changes were -0.245204, -0.221990 and -0.209774. Fourteen endpoints and all five task means declined; zaleplon in seed 2 increased by 0.001361. Docking had the largest mean decrease, from 0.998989 to 0.298274. The Child still made 511 strict generating-parent wins and 118 incumbent advances, versus 629 and 258 for the Parent. These local successes did not preserve its endpoint.

Generated conditioning records have positive conditional value even when adaptive normalization, score-based survival and recursive breeding remain available. This answers the missing membership question without treating the intervention as removal of all online learning. The same-input reference had lower prediction error on the actual scored molecules, but it supplies no rewards for omitted alternatives and no alternative future history; prediction error, reuse and uncertainty changes do not identify the route to the endpoint loss.

The earlier joint freeze and normalization-only findings remain intact. With complete matched outcomes and source boundaries checked, the four-treatment arithmetic interaction is +0.108156. Initial-only conditioning with current normalization scored 0.073800 below the jointly frozen version, while the historical full-conditioning comparison supported current normalization. The sign therefore depends on the conditioning context in these observations. This descriptive comparison shares one control, retains mixed task-level interaction signs, and establishes neither independent replication nor additive or mediated effects.

The molecular assessment finds persistent sulfur-rich, heavily halogenated docking families where the Parent reached more conventional aryl/amine arrangements, and more tiny fragments on every task. Useful aromatic amides and alternative ring arrangements still occur. These chemical associations help describe the weaker search outcomes but do not attribute them to one motif or prove a chemical mediator. Bond plausibility, ring geometry, stereochemical identity and the broader graph-evolution contribution remain open.

nodes.hypothesis: Nonpositive predictive-variance-weighted decision-location discount toward the current pool minimum. For the inherited raw-score means m_i and raw-score marginal predictive standard deviations sigma_i over the current fresh pool, compute m_bar=mean(m), s2=mean((m-m_bar)^2) with the population divisor, r=min(m), alpha_i=s2/(s2+sigma_i^2), and m_tilde_i=r+alpha_i*(m_i-r). Use alpha_i=1 only when its denominator is exactly zero. Substitute m_tilde for m only as the additive location in samples = m_tilde[None,:] + score_scale*(normals @ factor.T). The original means still supply every inherited ranking and K=3/M=40 eligibility decision; the covariance, Cholesky factor, jitter, residual amplitudes, one normal array and its consumption, availability updates and first-index ties remain inherited. There is no floor, clipping, fitted parameter, alternate variance estimator, data window or added size constraint. The predicted path is that the signed penalty changes sampled winners while retaining non-greedy choices, reduces both size tails in actual purchases and increases realized incumbent-increment mass. This is a decision heuristic, not a calibrated posterior or an identified correction of true prediction bias.
nodes.finding:
The arithmetic and inherited sampling rules passed independent checks across all 435 batches. Purchased sets changed in 433 batches, and 74.4% of live choices still differed from the adjusted-location greedy choice. Purchases below six heavy atoms fell from 91 to 55, but those above fifty rose from 44 to 668, including 656 in deco_hop. That upper-tail reversal refutes the registered two-ended routing prediction. Realized incumbent-increment mass fell from 5.978073 to 5.134770 even though the number of incumbent improvements rose from 253 to 259. The complete fifteen-cell endpoint mean fell from 0.607030 to 0.550810, a paired change of -0.056220; all three seed averages declined and three task-safety margins were exceeded. This was successful execution with a refuted routing prediction and no score improvement, not a technical failure. The conversion falsifier was conditional on both tails shrinking, so that conditional test does not separately trigger; conversion was nevertheless measured and worsened.

A downward location penalty can suppress tiny fragments and preserve stochastic selection while still narrowing structural search. The weight was strongly associated with proximity to the accepted archive: mean within-pool Spearman correlation between alpha and archive distance was -0.945. Purchases within distance 0.25 rose from 4025 to 4186; distinct nonempty Murcko scaffolds fell from 1667 to 953, and fragment-excluded mean batch similarity rose from 0.721 to 0.791. The molecular evidence explains what that narrowing looked like: repeated heterocyclic assemblies grew in the oversized branch, while compact alternative ring and linker arrangements were reached less consistently. In the clearest scaffold-loss case, the count fell from 559 to 159 without a large change in median molecular size. A proposal scheme that preserves useful groups during compact scaffold or linker rearrangements, or a ranking model that distinguishes duplication from productive structural changes, could address this measured coverage limitation. Those alternatives are not tested here. On the same purchased molecules, adjusted-location rank agreement with realized scores averaged 0.390 versus 0.467 for original means, so the literature-inspired weighting did not establish better ranking or correction of true predictive bias. The pool minimum is not a fitted prior and the retained GP dispersion is not measured estimation error; full Bayesian Hybrid Shrinkage was not implemented. Fixed-Parent-state routing support failed to predict adaptive growth, which is what this run now settles about the frozen construction. The observed score loss lies inside the descriptive span padded around two dependent same-host allocator references; they do not provide a confidence interval or a significance test. Reliable expected-score contribution, the utility of other location models, and the contribution of retained components remain unresolved; this result does not end the broader approach.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove sampled residual influence on successful choice (m-000000000006) from the masked Anchor's correlated Thompson allocation, and nothing else. At every successful selection position the winner becomes the available pool member with the maximum fitted posterior mean under the inherited ascending-index first-maximum tie rule, instead of the member with the maximum value in that position's correlated sample row; the chosen member is masked out before the next position exactly as before. The full count covariance, its bounded pool Cholesky factor with its inherited jitter ladder, the score_scale residual amplitude, the single (10, 160) standard-normal array drawn from the same generator at the same control-flow point, the resulting sample rows and their finite guard all remain, drawn and consumed in the same order, as passive computations that route no choice and keep the random stream position and the numerical-failure routing identical. The stall-conditioned eligible set is inherited untouched (K=3 consecutive non-improving announced batches, M=40 of 160 by (-posterior mean, pool index), effective size min(M, pool size), full field restored on the first improving batch), so the removal is measured inside the restriction rather than against it. Because every pool holds 160 members and the effective mask of 40 therefore always contains the ten highest posterior means, the emitted batch under this rule is the top ten of the posterior-mean ordering whether or not the batch is restricted: the mask stays present, audited and non-binding, and the measured endpoint is the total departure cost of the draw on this Anchor.
nodes.finding:
The removal executed cleanly on all three seeds and every pre-registered observable moved exactly as forecast. All 4,350 oracle calls across the fifteen sessions were the highest posterior mean of their own available set, and all 435 announced batches were exactly the top ten of the posterior-mean ordering; the Anchor's sampled rule had departed from that mean maximum at 3,733 of those 4,350 positions and matched the top-ten set in only 3 of 435 batches. The posterior-mean rank of every purchase collapsed to 0-9 (mean 4.5, maximum 9) in and out of the stalled regime, against the Anchor's in-regime mean rank 11.70 and out-of-regime 31.27 with 997 of 3,470 purchases at rank 40 or worse. Purchases from the top posterior-SD decile fell from 199 to 8 of 4,350. On the node's own pools the ten bought carried 3.4248 of summed posterior mean against 3.2282 for the sampled rule replayed on the same pool and mask (higher in 434 of 435 batches) and 0.1583 of summed posterior SD against 0.2684 (lower in 432 of 435). The random stream, the model arithmetic and the inherited eligibility rule were untouched: one 10-by-160 standard-normal array per batch in the same place and order, pool size 160 in every batch, no numerical fallback, the stall counter reproduced from the node's own accepted scores with no mismatch, and the retained mask binding in none of the 435 batches. At each session's single same-state first batch the pools, means, SDs, score scale, jitters and all ten normal rows were identical to the Anchor's, the removal displaced exactly 132 of 150 of the Anchor's picks with every one of the fifteen per-session counts as forecast, the average posterior mean of the ten bought rose in all fifteen, and the passive replay of the old sampled rule reproduced the Anchor's own ten in all fifteen.

Downstream, realized incumbent-increment mass fell from 5.9781 to 4.0747, a 31.8 per cent loss, spread over almost the same number of improvement events (250 against 253): each improvement simply got smaller. Inside the stalled regime the mass fell from 0.5470 to 0.2112.

The endpoint panel is complete and paired on seeds 0/1/2 across all five tasks: macro 0.480136 against the Anchor's 0.607030, a paired loss of 0.126894. Seed macros fell by 0.233405, 0.061951 and 0.085327; thirteen of fifteen cells fell and two rose (median_2 seed 0 +0.012805, zaleplon_mpo seed 0 +0.004139). Task means: sitagliptin_mpo -0.258049, drd2_docking -0.246948, deco_hop -0.116224, zaleplon_mpo -0.013731, median_2 +0.000481. The two fragile high cells are included, not excluded: deco_hop seed 0 fell from 0.856148 to 0.595220 and sitagliptin_mpo seed 0 from 0.765861 to 0.438199. Against this Anchor's own law-free band of [-0.055482, +0.014579] around -0.020452, the -0.126894 sits 2.3 times below the band's lower edge, so the loss is not a plausible path-departure realization; the three median_2 cells all sit inside that task's own band.

One result was not predicted and is the most consequential. This node's fifteen scored trajectories are identical record for record - all 4,500 molecules, same SMILES, same scores - to the mask-free mean-only removal the campaign ran on the previous Parent, and its macro mean, three seed macros and five task means match to full precision. The two programs are different: this one carries the whole stall-mask machinery and exercised it in 116 of 435 batches, the other has no mask at all. Because a mean-only buyer always finds the ten highest posterior means inside the eligible forty, the mask never bound once, so the two removals land on exactly the same realization. The entire difference between this Anchor's departure cost of -0.126894 and the mask-free -0.116317 is -0.010577, which is precisely the Anchor's own published gain over its mask-free Parent.

The registered question is answered on the Anchor that carries the mask. Sampled residual influence is strongly load-bearing here: removing it costs 0.126894 of panel mean, far beyond the 0.002 descriptive scale and far outside this Anchor's own law-free departure band, so the conditional contribution of the draw is positive and large. The campaign no longer has to borrow the mask-free number: the masked figure is larger, not smaller, than the -0.116317 it refused as transferable, which settles the round's framing question in the opposite direction from the one the restriction argument suggested.

What makes the answer unusually clean is also what limits it. Because the removal reproduces the mask-free removal exactly, the -0.126894 is the cost of departing from this Anchor to one specific greedy destination, and it cannot be split into a residual term and a mask term - both the draw and the mask stop operating at that same destination. The corollary is a new fact about the mask itself: the stall-conditioned top-forty eligibility rule, whose +0.010577 made this Anchor, is worth exactly nothing once the draw is gone, not approximately nothing but identically nothing, demonstrated by an equal realization rather than argued from pool arithmetic. Whatever that rule contributes is wholly conditional on a sampled residual being present to restrict. That is a direct, if partial, answer to the open question about whether the mask's margin is real: it is at best a property of the sampled regime, and it is zero outside it. It still says nothing about intermediate residual amplitudes or about other values of the mask size, where the restriction could bind.

For this round's other arms the greedy bound is now in hand at the same path realization: an improvement- or dispersion-based pricing arm that loses materially less than 0.126894 is buying something the pure posterior mean does not, and one that lands near it has merely rediscovered the mean order. The pricing diagnosis the campaign recorded - that this stack's limitation is candidate pricing and ranking - survives this test with its sign fixed: the fix is not to remove dispersion from the buy.

On the method itself, the trajectories and the molecular report converge on one diagnosis, and the receipts support it. Buying strictly by posterior mean turns the search into sustained local refinement of whichever skeleton the surrogate currently likes: distinct Murcko scaffolds per session fall to 54.9 from the Parent's 117.5 (lower in 14 of 15 matched sessions), mean pairwise Tanimoto rises to 0.432 from 0.296 (higher in 15 of 15), the single most common scaffold takes 39.9 per cent of a session's proposals against 18.9, near-duplicate proposals rise to 10.5 per cent from 1.4, and one session spent 290 proposals on 15 scaffolds with 76 per cent on one. None of that is visible to the string-uniqueness check, which still reports 864-875 unique strings of 870 on every objective - a caution for any future node that reads uniqueness as diversity. The allocation receipts are the mechanism of that collapse: every purchase in the mean head, top-SD-decile purchases down from 199 to 8, summed purchased SD down to 0.158 from the 0.268 the sampled rule would have taken on the same pools. The downstream signature matches - almost the same number of incumbent improvements with a third less mass, which is what a halogen walk around a frozen skeleton produces. There is a second, weaker reading worth flagging: within its own top ten the surrogate's prospective rank correlation with realized score averages 0.375 and is negative in 64 of 435 batches (the Anchor's is 0.515, negative in 30), so the fine ordering the greedy rule spends the whole budget on is only weakly informative at that resolution. That figure is deflated by the narrow score spread inside a top-ten batch and should not be read as a like-for-like comparison. The limitation this prices is a property of the purchase rule, not of the proposal operators: what would remove it is a ranking model or acquisition that keeps a dispersion or diversity term in the buy - expected improvement with a risk term, a batch rule with an explicit scaffold-novelty or determinantal diversity penalty, or a surrogate whose uncertainty is not a function of archive similarity - rather than any retuning of the residual's amplitude, which two earlier arms already showed moves the endpoint by only -0.009718 and -0.003338.

What stays open: whether any part of the 0.126894 can be recovered by a pricing rule that is deterministic but not mean-greedy; whether the mask has value at intermediate residual amplitudes, where it could actually bind; and whether the loss is partly a property of this one dependent realization - three seeds, thirteen of fifteen cells down, with two cells carrying 0.588 of the 1.903 of lost increment mass. This route should not iterate: it is a control that reached its registered destination, it is not a candidate improvement, and repeating mean-only allocation on this Parent would buy nothing new. The goal it serves stays open for the eight retained identities on this Anchor whose contribution is still unmeasured.

nodes.hypothesis: Within m-000000000005, remove only restricted within-set predictive-location preference on n-5e03d3ccd1b7. At a successful FingerprintPosterior.select call let mu be the original fitted raw-score mean vector, a=self.score_mean from the current accepted archive, s=self.score_scale, L the unchanged full posterior Cholesky factor including its actual successful jitter, and Z the one inherited normal array. Original mu still defines exact eligibility sorted by (-mu_i,i), and each position still chooses the first maximum in ascending available pool index, then removes only that identity. When unrestricted, use the original mu+s*(Z@L.T) without replacement. The independent residual law and marginal variances s**2*sum_j L_ij**2 stay exact; the fitted covariance is not diagonalized or refit. Prediction: eliminating candidate-dependent location decreases aggregate original-mean preference in active restricted selections versus a passive original-location replay on the same state, changes paid identities, and may reduce full/late useful gain and matched endpoint mean. nodes.finding:
The registered behavior occurred in 100 of 435 announcements. Within those restricted sets, 569 of 1,000 choices differed from the original-location replay; 98 purchase sets changed and 436 identities were displaced. Original predictive-mean sum fell from 437.246705 to 402.657100, while mean-rank sum worsened from 11,754 to 21,570. Eligibility, residuals, normal draws and the unrestricted rule passed the same-state checks. All 4,350 optimizer purchases joined to feedback; 323 of the 569 changed choices survived their batch and 96 later generated paid children, with 22 censored by the final batch. Full incumbent-gain mass fell from 5.852783 to 5.656162, and late gain from 1.020751 to 0.812268 over 2,175 purchases. Positive generating-parent gain also fell, although the signed generating-parent total became less negative. The complete mean score fell from 0.598678 to 0.585570, a paired change of -0.013108, exceeding the registered 0.002 loss criterion. Seed macro changes were -0.005059, -0.005032 and -0.029234; nine task/seed endpoints fell, three rose and three tied. Both never-restricted cells reproduced their Parent trajectories. There was no execution failure, and the primary isolation, activation and useful-gain falsifiers did not trigger.

Fine mean preference still contributes after restricted residual correlation has been removed. This closes that conditional sign question at the registered descriptive scale; it does not establish a uniform task effect, an interaction obtained by subtracting sibling effects, or generalization beyond this Search panel. The Child remained 0.021461 below the formal Anchor. Full selected-stream GP mean-squared error changed only from 0.011217 to 0.011281, while removing its location preference lowered endpoint performance. That separates a useful predictive consumer from the question of how to improve the overall search. At the same time, within-batch similarity after excluding tiny fragments fell from 0.4121 to 0.4041. More local variation therefore coexisted with less useful progress, rather than establishing a cure for the conversion bottleneck. Unusual heteroatom halogenation and absent stereochemical assignments remain proposal limitations, not demonstrated causes of the score loss. A proposal/search scheme that preserves distinct coherent core and functional-group alternatives, or a ranking model aimed at substantial incumbent gains, is the kind of method change that could address the observed limitation; neither is tested here. Original GP errors beat the archive constant on the actually bought restricted molecules, but these paid-stream associations cannot score the unpurchased replay or prove mediation. The posterior approach remains open. Diagnostic time is nested in other timing, and no independent replication or trusted comparative task-safety conclusion is available.

nodes.hypothesis: Success-counter hysteresis on the exit of the stall regime: the regime is still entered exactly when the session's counter of consecutive non-improving announced batches reaches K=3, but once active it governs every following announced batch until the session has produced tau_succ=2 consecutive improving announced batches, at which point the Parent's inherited unrestricted behaviour is restored exactly and both counters are cleared; a single improving announced batch no longer releases the regime. Everything the regime does when active is inherited unchanged - the initial availability mask of the correlated Thompson allocation is restricted to the M=40 members of the unchanged 160-member fresh pool with the highest fitted posterior mean ordered by (-posterior mean, pool index), and the pool target, the standard-normal array's shape, order and consumption count, the Cholesky factor and jitter, the residual scale, the per-pick mask update and the first-index tie rule are exactly the Parent's. The new state is two integers maintained from this session's own accepted scores at announcement and at observation; it consumes no randomness and reads no task identity, no absolute score level and no other session.
nodes.finding:
The hold ran exactly as registered in all fifteen sessions. Entry was untouched: every one of the 22 regime entries came at exactly three consecutive non-improving announced batches. Every one of the 15 exits came at the second of two consecutive improving batches, never after a single one, and the other 7 episodes ran to the end of their session. The logged regime state agreed with an independent recount from the run's own scores in all 435 announced batches. Exposure rose from the Parent's 88 restricted batches to 162 of 435, against a forecast of 164. 75 of those batches were held batches, which the inherited rule would have released. 41 improving batches inside a regime no longer ended it. On the target task, median_2, restricted batches rose from 10 to 26 (forecast 28). The inherited top-forty restriction itself stayed exact. Not one of 1,620 in-regime picks went to a candidate ranked 40th or worse by posterior mean, and unrestricted picks stayed at the Parent's level (29.6% ranked 40 or worse, against 28.7%). Every session was the Parent's run, molecule for molecule, up to its own first held batch. Each first held batch fell exactly where it was forecast. The two deco_hop sessions that never stall (seeds 0 and 2) and the zaleplon_mpo seed-1 session reproduced the Parent record for record. At the first held batches the swap matched the forecast to the digit: 47 of 130 positions and 42 picks changed, and the dropped picks had averaged 0.321 against 0.400 for the kept ones.

The extra exposure did not pay per batch. Summed over the regime, every quantity grew because there were more batches: best-so-far increments rose from 0.547 to 0.767, positive gain over the generating parent from 1.68 to 3.11, and incumbent improvements from 31 to 65. Per restricted batch, the increment fell 24%, from 0.00622 to 0.00474. Positive gain mass stayed flat (0.01919 against 0.01908) and the mean in-regime offspring score was marginally lower (0.4122 against 0.4126). Reweighting the Parent's per-task rates to the Child's heavier share of slow-moving tasks still gives 0.00571 per batch, so the drop is not only a task-mix effect. Task by task, in-regime accepted quality stayed about +0.028 above the Anchor's stalled batches (the Parent's figure was +0.031). The molecules the regime chose were as good as before; they just moved the incumbent less. The held batches were the weakest: 0.00423 per batch, against 0.00518 for the batches the inherited rule also restricts. They improved more often (40% of held batches against 30%) but by less each time: an improving held batch added 0.0106 on average, against 0.0173 for counter-triggered batches and 0.0219 in the Parent. Within an episode, gain came early. Pooled across sessions, the first three batches of an episode averaged 0.0097, 0.0063 and 0.0084. The fourth averaged 0.0041 and the fifth nothing. Batches six to ten averaged 0.0019, and batches eleven and later 0.0038. Increments traceable to in-regime offspring and their descendants fell from 1.142 to 1.079, and increments after each session's first stall fell from 1.198 to 1.079.

On the complete matched panel the mean fell from the Parent's 0.6070 to 0.5991, a paired delta of -0.0079. The seed macros moved -0.0170, -0.0071 and +0.0002. With any single cell left out the delta stays negative, between -0.0098 and -0.0011. Seven cells rose, four fell and four were unchanged. The whole loss sits in sitagliptin_mpo: seed 0 lost 0.103 and seed 1 lost 0.045, the two cells that had carried the Parent's own margin. The other twelve cells average +0.0010. Against the Anchor the panel is +0.0026, nominally above the +0.002 bar. That figure rests on seed macros of -0.0104, +0.0150 and +0.0033 and lies inside the law-free path reference's seed spread (-0.0127 to +0.0080). Without sitagliptin_mpo seed 1 it becomes -0.0043. median_2 missed its target. Its three-seed mean of 0.2260 is +0.0033 against the Anchor, below the +0.010 required, and -0.0028 against the Parent, and its seed-2 cell (0.2264) is below the Anchor's 0.2323. All four protected tasks held their margins against the Anchor: deco_hop +0.0030 (margin 0.02), drd2_docking -0.0035 (margin 0.03), sitagliptin_mpo +0.0286 (margin 0.02) and zaleplon_mpo -0.0180 (margin 0.02, leaving 0.0020 of headroom).

The question was whether the Parent's +0.0106 came from the top-forty rule itself, in which case it should grow with exposure, or from one favourable path. The answer points to the path. Exposure nearly doubled as designed and the rule stayed exact. Even so, the per-batch increment fell and the panel dropped below the Parent's. The whole loss sits in the two sitagliptin_mpo cells that had carried the Parent's margin, while the other twelve cells are flat. That pattern is what to expect if the Parent's margin came mainly from where those two sessions happened to go. It is not what to expect if the restriction gains value with every additional stalled batch it governs. The registered falsifier therefore triggered, and the exposure-scaling claim is recorded as refuted. The verdict concerns the claim, not the implementation, which ran exactly. By the registered rule this ends the hold direction: no sweep of the exit count, no per-task value, no re-thresholded entry and no change to the eligible-set size follows.

The run also shows how holding fails. A held batch comes right after an improvement, so the search sits next to a fresh incumbent. There, the top quarter of the posterior mean still yields good molecules (in-regime accepted quality kept its advantage over the Anchor) but only small steps. Holding raised the share of improving batches and shrank each improvement, and almost all in-episode gain came in the first three or four batches. On median_2, the score-compressed target, the result was 2.6 times the restricted exposure and many tiny incumbent steps, with no movement of the three-seed mean beyond path noise. The bottleneck there is not how long the restriction lasts. This fits the molecular review of this node. Late-session proposals are mostly one-atom halogen and substituent permutations of a single scaffold that the objectives barely separate, so a sharpened mean-ranked set keeps harvesting near-ties instead of crossing a plateau. That link is consistent with the data but was not measured directly.

The evidence now leans away from longer holds and toward shorter ones. A rule that releases or escalates a restricted episode after a few batches without progress is the natural next distinguishing test. It is the part of the borrowed trust-region method that neither this node nor its Parent adopted. The case is not clean, however. Among cells with an episode of eight batches or more, four gained and four lost against the Anchor. The largest loss, sitagliptin_mpo seed 0, followed a single held batch that changed two picks and then an eleven-batch terminal stall that the inherited rule would also have restricted.

Two things remain open. This round's law-free reference, held at the same regime, has not finished, so the size of pure path noise at this exposure is still known from a single draw. The sibling arm that holds the regime around the fourfold fresh pool will show whether the exposure law also fails on a second element. The must-preserve constraint held, but zaleplon_mpo has only 0.002 of its 0.02 margin left.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove only ongoing recomputation of the GP score-normalization mean and scale by retaining the exact initial accepted-label normalization constants, while continuing full-archive raw-label conditioning and the inherited correlated posterior selector at every original fit.

The passive reference has no rewards for omitted choices and no alternative future history, so mediation remains open. This complete exposed panel answers the registered normalization-only control under the current budget and composition; it supplies neither a broader claim that uncertainty should always increase nor a reason to retune this fixed control.
