nodes.hypothesis: Inside the inherited correlated Thompson allocation over the mixed-origin 160-member pool, reserve a fixed integer r = 2 of the ten sequential picks for the prior-origin proposal family. The joint posterior draw is unchanged: one (10 x 160) matrix of standard normals is still drawn once per batch from the same generator in the same order and mapped through the same Cholesky factor of the same conditional covariance, so the sampled function values at every position are the values the Parent's rule would have used. Picks at positions 0 through 7 are the inherited rule exactly - the argmax of that position's sampled function over all not-yet-selected pool members, with the inherited first-index tie rule. At positions 8 and 9 the availability mask is additionally restricted to pool members whose recorded origin is prior_continuation and which are not yet selected, and the pick is the argmax of the same position's same sampled function inside that restricted mask. Nothing is re-drawn, re-fitted or re-normalized, and no quantity outside the mask changes. If a reserved position finds no unselected prior-origin member the inherited unrestricted mask is used for that pick and the event is logged; on the Parent's own receipts every one of the 435 pools held at least 31 prior-origin members, so this fallback is expected to be empty. The reservation is one bound integer applied identically in every announced batch of every session: no per-task value, no mid-run adaptation, no schedule, no dependence on score level, task identity or stall state. The causal claim is that this restriction diverts 20% of the evaluation budget to candidates the archive-anchored similarity kernel prices below the incumbent's neighbourhood, and that those forced purchases - not more supply of them - are what determines whether the refusal measured in round 42 was costing realized endpoint gain.
nodes.finding:
The reservation activated exactly as registered. All 870 reserved picks (positions nine and ten of 435 announced batches, 15 sessions) bought a prior-origin candidate, with zero empty-mask fallbacks, restricted masks of 28 to 40 members, and 812 of the 870 picks (93.3%) landing on a different candidate from the one the inherited unrestricted draw would have taken at that same position. The prior-origin share of evaluations rose from the Parent's 231 of 4,350 (5.31%) to 1,097 of 4,350 (25.22%), at or above 20% in all 15 sessions, and no announced batch bought none, against the Parent's 292 of 435 empty batches including all 29 batches of sitagliptin seed 2. The diversion was real and not a relabelling: reserved picks sat at in-pool predicted-score percentile 0.490 and uncertainty percentile 0.654, against 0.838 and 0.361 for the eight free picks, which themselves stayed at the Parent's level (0.841 / 0.336) and never deviated from the inherited argmax in any of 3,480 picks; one ten-by-one-hundred-sixty normal draw per batch in 435 of 435 batches, no posterior fallback, and batch-one selections identical to the Parent through the eighth pick in 15 of 15 sessions. The supply was held fixed to the receipt: pooled prior-origin share 0.2487 against the Parent's 0.2486, pools complete at 160 in 435 of 435 batches, the prior's weights byte-identical to the Parent's for every seed with zero online updates, no oracle labels and no stored corpus molecules.

Conversion is where the hypothesis died. The prior-origin group's share of realized incumbent-increment mass rose from 2.79% to 20.51% (1.1114 of 5.4187 against the Parent's 0.1405 of 5.0403), but that share reached its own 20-25% evaluation share in only 3 of 15 sessions, against the registered six, and the reserved positions returned 0.9784 of the node's 5.4187 total mass - 18.1% of the gain for 20% of the budget. Per evaluation the forced purchases were plainly worse than what they displaced: parent-beat rate 0.099 against 0.155, survivor admission 0.498 against 0.832, incumbent-improvement rate 0.030 against 0.059, and a more negative mean child-minus-best-parent in 14 of the 15 sessions. In one realization the prior-origin increment mass gained 0.9709 while the graph-origin mass lost 0.5925. The registered recovery prediction failed outright: sitagliptin_mpo, named in advance as the task with a measured mechanism to recover, lost 0.0625 against the Parent and 0.1964 against the Anchor, and its seed-2 session - the one that had bought nothing in 29 batches - bought 63 prior candidates, beat a breeding parent once in 63, improved the incumbent zero times, returned 0.0000 increment mass, and the cell fell 0.1173.

The paired fifteen-cell panel against the code Parent is +0.025228 (0.569740 against 0.544512; seeds -0.021619, +0.052101, +0.045204; 10 of 15 cells positive), and 79.0% of it is a single cell: deco_hop seed 2 at +0.298890. Drop that one cell and the panel mean is +0.005302, inside the ungated law-free reference band's half-width of 0.040983, which is the registered opposite-way refutation. Against the Anchor the node is -0.026713, inside the ungated band; its must-preserve task means are deco_hop +0.007109 (margin 0.02), drd2_docking -0.007518 (0.03), zaleplon_mpo +0.036142 (0.02), median_2 +0.027114 with cells 0.258268 / 0.236775 / 0.254494, and sitagliptin_mpo -0.196411, a deepened breach of its 0.02 margin against the Parent's own -0.133933.

The deco_hop seed-2 cell resolves to one purchase. At batch 19 the reserved position nine bought a prior continuation scoring 0.905207 and carrying an incumbent increment of +0.242796 - 66.7% of that session's whole 0.363810 gain and 64.2% of the entire fifteen-cell panel movement. It is the prior's half-prefix continuation of a scored 0.659675 parent, which rebuilt the 6,7-dimethoxy-4-anilinoquinazoline with a methylenedioxy aniline. But at that position the inherited unrestricted rule would have bought exactly the same pool member: it is one of the 58 of 870 reserved picks the restriction did not change, so the decisive purchase is not attributable to the reservation. What the reservation did buy is the road to it: the conditioning parent's own ancestry runs through reserved picks at batches 1, 2 (both, whose crossover first displayed the anilino-methylenedioxy motif), 5, 11 and 17, eight of those ten being genuine diversions, and the Parent's own deco_hop seed 2 never entered that chemistry at all - 7 of its 290 molecules carried a methylenedioxy fragment, best score 0.598480, and it plateaued at 0.613301 on an unrelated triazolylpyridine series. The event is also unrepeated: it happened once in fifteen sessions, the surrogate predicted 0.63422 for it at a posterior SD of 0.01308 (a 20-sigma miss), and the 100 evaluations that followed it in that session returned a further +0.006984 in total.

The campaign now has the discriminating answer its two round-42 structural-limitation lessons asked for, and it is negative: on this Parent, at 300 evaluations per task, the archive-anchored posterior's refusal to buy prior-origin chemistry was mostly correct pricing, not foregone gain. Forcing 20% of the budget onto that chemistry bought candidates that beat their breeding parents at two thirds the rate, survived at six tenths the rate and improved the incumbent at half the rate of what they displaced, and the reserved fifth of the budget returned less than a fifth of the realized gain in eleven of fifteen sessions. The one session that paid, paid 0.30 of score through a single step event the surrogate under-predicted by 0.27 at a posterior SD of 0.013. That is the real shape of the loss surface here: the benefit of distant chemistry on this benchmark is not a density the allocator can harvest at the margin, it is a rare step whose expected value fifteen sessions cannot estimate. The cheapest member of the reserved-evaluation class is therefore closed with receipts rather than left as an untested prescription, and no share, temperature, prefix, width, depth, checkpoint or quota sweep follows from it.

The method diagnosis is that the limitation is the surrogate's scale, not its ranking, and a reservation cannot reach it. Within batches the Gaussian process ranks well - mean predicted-versus-realized rank correlation 0.608 here against the Parent's 0.534 - but its posterior SD around the incumbent neighbourhood is of order 0.013 while the only move that mattered was worth 0.27. No acquisition rule reading that posterior can prefer such a candidate, and a family reservation does not help, because the family label says nothing about which member is informative: the reserved pick is still the mis-scaled posterior's own argmax inside the family, at in-pool percentile 0.49. What would address it is a different kind of model, not a different quota - a predictor whose uncertainty is comparable across chemotypes (ensemble, deep-kernel or conformally calibrated) or a comparison-trained ranker, combined with an acquisition that prices information rather than score. The companion arms in this round are now the informative contrast: the distance-reserved arm on the Anchor uses the same reserved-mask interface but labels by archive distance instead of proposal family, which separates 'reservation fails' from 'this label fails', and the field-reduction control separates pool composition from allocation.

The trajectories also show a second, separable limitation that no reservation touches. In the one session that found the rewarded scaffold, the remaining 100 evaluations were spent relabelling it: 32 scored at or above 0.90, 8 at exactly 0.905207, median similarity to the conditioning parent 0.887, total further gain +0.006984. The molecular report reads the same way from the chemistry side - narrow structural diversity, one scaffold family in the deco_hop top thirty, every molecule above 0.90 a one-atom decoration of a single parent, saturated amine centres reachable only where the seed population already had a nitrogen, no declared stereochemistry anywhere, and sub-molecular one- and two-atom strings still consuming evaluations. That pattern argues for a fragment-attachment proposal operator and a diversity-aware batch rule (clustered or determinantal selection instead of ten sequential Thompson argmaxes over one pool) plus a minimum-size admission floor, which are proposal- and selection-scheme changes rather than parameter values.

Two narrower things are now settled. First, the deco_hop lesson needs updating: this is the first of thirty-one complete ungated children to satisfy the deco_hop margin against the Anchor (+0.007109, where the previous thirty all fell between -0.116414 and -0.084946), and it did so without reproducing the Anchor's seed-0 0.856148 cell (it scored 0.612855 there) by reaching 0.912192 in a different seed through a different chemistry. The high deco_hop region is reachable by more than one route; it is a step the search hits rarely, not a property of one inherited realization. Second, sitagliptin_mpo's breach is now persistent and deeper (-0.196411 against the Anchor, -0.229935 against the ungated reference), and by this route's own registered condition that ends the route rather than inviting a re-threshold. What stays open: whether reserved allocation fails for the family label or in general, which only the distance-labelled arm can say; and whether a calibrated-uncertainty surrogate would price the step chemistry high enough to buy it without a quota at all.

nodes.hypothesis: Reject a graph-valid canonically novel neighbor before tabu testing when it increases the source-relative count of bonds between F, Cl, Br or I and a non-carbon heavy atom, redirecting the existing edit stream away from new non-carbon halogen attachment while preserving carbon-halogen eligibility and the Parent walk.
nodes.finding:
The gate rejected 130 valid, novel attachment increases; all 130 would otherwise pass the contemporaneous tabu rule, and each was followed by another actual neighbor from the same source. Starting from zero-count molecules, the complete panel emitted no targeted bonds, compared with 974 affected Parent emissions. Carbon-halogen chemistry remained active in 2670 evaluated molecules versus 2596 before, including 265 source improvements and 153 archive gains. Generation attempts per batch rose from 12.15 to 12.63. The macro mean fell from 0.520918 to 0.513044, a paired loss of 0.007874 exceeding the permitted 0.002. Gains in DRD2 and some other endpoints did not offset the larger sitagliptin losses.

The attachment criterion has a distinct effect beyond existing tabu memory: every measured rejection changes which fresh neighbor can reach evaluation. It also separates carbon-bound halogens from direct nitrogen-, oxygen- and sulfur-halogen bonds, rather than simply eliminating all halogen-containing molecules. The chemistry cleanup therefore happened, but its score cost is real in this panel. The Parent had obtained six immediate archive improvements from count-increasing moves, so this was never a uniformly unhelpful channel; those historical scores do not label the different rejected products. The rule is source-relative and would permit equal or lower counts on a molecule with pre-existing counted bonds. Its complete absence here depends on the zero-count starting states. Other liabilities remain outside the mechanism: the molecular assessment still finds unusual sulfur coordination, dense bridges, small unsaturated rings and undefined stereochemistry. Removing one attachment class neither establishes generally plausible chemistry nor preserves objective performance.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove Morgan environment multiplicity from the shared posterior representation by replacing each inherited count vector c with binary presence 1[c > 0] for every training, pool and next-fit feature use, while retaining the generalized Tanimoto implementation and all fitting, graph-generation and correlated-allocation rules.

Every active feature is binary under extensive repeated-environment exposure, and all 435 fitted pools change their posterior relative to counts on the same inputs. The retained correlated draws, graph operations and accepted feedback reconstruct correctly. Mean final score falls from 0.595670 to 0.544374, a paired loss of 0.051296 against the registered 0.002 scale. All seed macros decline: 0.077877, 0.002003 and 0.074008. On the actual binary stream, latent 1.96-SD coverage is 79.75% versus 73.52% for a passive count model using the same earlier labels and scored molecules. Their MSEs are 0.016600/0.009873. Binary error is higher in all fifteen task-seed cells, while its coverage is lower for median_2 on every seed despite the aggregate increase. These diagnostics answer a different question from endpoint search utility.

The isolated reverse control supports a positive contribution of environment multiplicity in the current exchange-free composition. It changes both fitted means and covariance, so the experiment does not assign the gain specifically to calibrated uncertainty. More structural variety is also insufficient: binary selection yields 2,267 typed and 1,546 generic cores versus 1,851 and 1,118 under counts, yet strict local parent beats fall from 629 to 565 and incumbent gains from 258 to 218. Molecular evidence preserves the useful conventional ketone and aminoaryl-dione gains alongside reactive environments, repeated large assemblies and destructive fragments; no universal size or chemistry rule explains the score loss. The fifteen trajectories and all shared non-timing decisions exactly reproduce the earlier binary ancestor. That establishes provenance and rules out treating the replay as new independent evidence; the current matched Parent comparison remains the contribution test. Which changes in similarity, means and covariance mediate the useful search behavior remains open.

nodes.hypothesis: Walk from the best supplied molecular observation by directly evaluating fresh graph-edit neighbors that pass expiring inverse local-subgraph restrictions, move to the highest-scoring accepted neighbor even when it worsens the current score, and install bounded inverse attributes of that selected transition while retaining a separate best-observed archive.
nodes.finding:
Both new replicas reproduced the intended graph walk and structural memory. All 2,900 accepted proposals were valid novel edits of the actual current graph. Temporary inverse-motif restrictions vetoed 7,503 otherwise valid novel draws (72.12% of such tests), changed 279 of the 280 batches after initialization, and led to 176 selected next states absent from the first ten unfiltered valid novel neighbors. Every one of 89 required worsening moves occurred; 62 later recovered above their own pre-move score, 24 did not recover despite later opportunities, and three occurred at the terminal step. Memory installation, refresh and four-step expiry reconstructed correctly, and neither new replica needed a forced release. Accepted neighbors beat their generating current score 292 times out of 2,900 (10.07%), with 167 strict improvements to the best-observed score. The new macro final-best scores were 0.49531 and 0.50903, alongside 0.51081 in seed 0. The three-seed mean was 0.50505 with population standard deviation 0.00693. Task means were 0.40256 for zaleplon, 0.60530 for scaffold hopping, 0.83839 for DRD2 docking, 0.18975 for median similarity and 0.48924 for sitagliptin. Every task finished all 300 oracle evaluations, and every final best score exceeded its supplied initial best.

The replication rules out memory acting only as whole-molecule duplicate rejection or as a passive record: its restrictions repeatedly removed unseen molecules and changed actual state selection. Worsening moves can be followed by recovery and later incumbent gains, but the episodes overlap and do not establish distinct successful escapes. The separate best archive matters: on sitagliptin the final current scores were only 0.16887 and 0.20350 while the preserved best scores were 0.41959 and 0.46369. Following the current walk alone would therefore conceal much of what the search had found. Broad structural vetoing still coexists with weak average local proposals: accepted neighbors scored 0.06743 below their current source on average, despite positive average winner transitions. The passive reference has no scores for omitted molecules, so changed batches and incumbent-gain provenance cannot establish an advantage over an unrestricted walk. The molecular assessment further shows that graph sanitization and numerical gains coexist with N-halogen bonds, unusual sulfur valence and strained ring arrangements in tightly related high-scoring families. Correct tabu operation does not make those products chemically plausible or demonstrate broader useful scaffold exploration. A scored comparative walk and chemically meaningful evaluation remain necessary to separate useful memory from redirection toward permissively scored chemistry.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove within-niche redundancy from the retained breeding population. Retention keeps at most one accepted record per niche - the highest-scoring member, earliest serial on ties - where a record's niche is the canonical form of its own molecular graph with every atom mapped to carbon and every bond to a single bond, computed from the graph alone. Niche elites then compete for the inherited 64-member capacity in the inherited (-score, serial) order and are handed to the untouched score-quantile sampler in that order, so the accepted incumbent is always retained and the population stays bounded exactly as before. Path of effect: the slots that currently hold element-permutation siblings of the leader are freed for topologically distinct accepted records; because the removed records are the leader's own near-duplicates rather than weak distant molecules, the freed slots sit inside the bands the sampler actually draws from, so each announced batch is bred from more distinct chemistry at a near-unchanged parent score level, which is the condition under which the rare large early increments this panel's endpoint depends on can appear.
nodes.finding:
The retention rule ran exactly as registered in all 4,350 accepted retention calls of the fifteen sessions. No call ever retained two records of one skeleton, none exceeded the inherited 64-member capacity, the maximum accepted score was present and first in the population after every call, and the key never fell back to a record's own identity (0 of 4,500 keys); all 4,350 newcomer keys recompute from the published trajectories without a single mismatch. The partition was active and nowhere near degenerate: 1,564 of 4,350 calls (35.95%, against a forecast 38.0%) placed the newcomer in an already occupied skeleton, 1,470 records were deleted as within-niche non-elites that the passive same-state greedy-64 comparator would have kept (67 to 150 per session, forecast 54 to 187), the population averaged 55.3 to 58.8 of its 64 slots (forecast 55.4 to 58.7) and reached the full 64 in 15 of 15 sessions, and occupancy never collapsed below the ten skeletons of the initial cohort. Divergence from the Parent begins exactly where the mechanism predicts and nowhere earlier: every session reproduces the Parent's molecules evaluation for evaluation up to the first announced batch bred after the first within-niche deletion, at evaluation 21, 31, 41 or 51 of 300, and the whole eight-hunk change is confined to retention and its receipts, with pool width, the single ten-by-one-hundred-sixty normal draw per batch and its consumption, the jitter ladder, zero posterior fallbacks, the sulfur gate, both duplicate scopes and the K=3 / M=40 stall mask all behaving identically to the Parent in all 435 batches.

The two intermediate diversity observables moved as forecast. In the ranks the inherited quantile edges can actually draw, distinct skeletons rose from a Parent-replay 19.05 to 29.20 (forecast 28.80) and distinct generic Murcko frameworks from 7.85 to 10.73 (forecast 11.19); in the 0.6-weight top band distinct skeletons rose from 4.83 to 6.38 (forecast 6.31) at a top-band mean-score cost of 0.010 (0.4658 to 0.4554, forecast 0.4549). The breeding parents actually used carried that diversity: per session 74.5 distinct skeletons and 28.3 distinct generic frameworks among the parents of the 290 accepted offspring, against the Parent's 59.4 and 23.3, at a near-unchanged mean first-parent score (0.4470 against 0.4558) and unchanged topness. Late-session concentration fell on the mean, the single most common generic framework over a session's last hundred accepted records dropping from 0.533 to 0.411, but its spread widened to 0.10-0.96 against the Parent's 0.22-0.86, with one session putting 96% of its last hundred records on one framework. Final survivors spanned 21.1 typed Murcko ring systems (Parent 15.8) and 17.3 generic frameworks (Parent 9.0).

The benefit did not follow. Summed best-so-far increment mass over the fifteen cells fell from the Anchor's 5.978073 to 5.269884, a loss of 0.708189 (11.8%), with 245 incumbent improvements against 253. The early mass the intent asked to protect actually rose, 3.740876 to 4.014261, so the loss is entirely later: batches 11-20 fell from 1.586726 to 1.022236 and batches 21-29 from 0.650471 to 0.233387, and the stall mask fired in 97 of 435 batches against 88. Per-evaluation offspring quality did not degrade at all (mean accepted offspring score 0.3809 against 0.3782, median 0.4137 against 0.4117, parent-beating accepted records 673 against 634), which separates this arm cleanly from the earlier physicochemical-champion arm that halved offspring quality. The endpoint panel fell: child macro mean 0.559818 against 0.607030, paired delta -0.047213 with all three seeds negative (-0.107912, -0.018696, -0.015029), against a registered minimum effect of +0.002. By task, zaleplon_mpo +0.017877 and drd2_docking +0.011548 held their 0.02 and 0.03 margins, median_2 moved +0.005691 and stayed inside its registered band as the source's own tie predicted, deco_hop lost 0.078274 and sitagliptin_mpo lost 0.192905 on all three seeds. The deco_hop loss is the documented departure cell: seed 0 realized 0.623961 instead of the inherited 0.856148, worth about -0.0155 of the fifteen-cell mean, and the panel delta of -0.047213 sits inside the registered ungated law-free reference band, which would place it below that reference only under -0.050871. Every cell completed with 1,500 oracle calls, status ok, no timeout and no invalid or duplicate proposal; the registered per-key cost held at 0.44 ms for the retention key and 1.06 ms for all three cached labels, about 0.3 s per session.

The experiment did what a clean falsification should. Score-greedy truncation really was filling this Anchor's breeding bands with element permutations of the leader, the fix removed them exactly as designed, the freed slots really did land inside the bands the sampler draws from, and the parents that bred really were more skeleton-diverse at nearly unchanged score - and the panel's realized gain still fell. That is the registered premise test, not an implementation failure, so the population-concentration explanation of this lineage's endpoint ceiling is now refuted for this Anchor, and the route stops on its own condition: no sweep of niche feature, resolution or capacity is licensed, which closes the partition-redefinition follow-up as well as this configuration.

Two measurements explain why more distinct chemistry bought nothing, and both point away from the population. First, the key counted decoration, not chemistry. The 10.15 extra skeletons the rule put into the sampler-reachable support bought only 1.08 extra typed Murcko ring systems and 2.88 extra generic frameworks, a ratio of about nine new skeletons per new ring system, and the 0.6-weight top band still spans under three generic frameworks among its 6.4 members (Parent 2.57). The molecular review's independent read of the same streams finds the same thing from the other side, 40 distinct skeletons collapsing onto 7 generic frameworks in one top decile with one framework taking 36.8% of the band. Erasing element labels and bond orders makes moving a pendant halogen from a ring carbon to an amide nitrogen a new niche while leaving the ring system untouched, so the archive was partitioned largely by where the decoration sits. Second, and more decisive, the proposal stage converted the richer population straight back into indistinguishable spend: exactly equal accepted-record scores stayed flat at 601 against the Parent's 622, and the molecular review finds elite bands where only 33 to 84 of the top 87 proposals have distinct scores at all. The budget is being spent on edits the objectives cannot resolve regardless of which parents are available, and the timing signature confirms it - the richer population was consumed earlier (76.2% of all increment mass in the first ten batches, up from 62.6%) and then stalled harder, rather than sustaining later gains.

So the search behaviour that limits this method is move granularity, not membership. The operator mixture performs sustained local refinement of whatever scaffold it starts on - single-atom and pendant edits, plus a crossover whose products stay inside the inherited ring systems - and no retention rule, acquisition quota or ranking term can make such a move set produce the rare large increments this endpoint needs. Two earlier arms on this lineage already failed on the supply and quota sides and this one fails on the membership side, which is three independent stages exhausted on the same premise. The class of method the evidence now points to is a proposal operator that changes what the molecule is: fragment- or ring-system-level moves (scaffold replacement, fragment-library recombination, whole-substituent installation and removal) together with a novelty or duplicate key read at ring-system granularity rather than on the decorated whole-molecule graph, so that one proposal differs from its parent by an amount the objective can resolve. This also weakens, without testing, the route's reserved acquisition-side diversity-ranking successor: diversity entered the ranking that matters here through the population and was used, and the conversion still failed, so a ranking term inherits the same conversion problem. A secondary limitation worth naming is that the inherited quantile edges reach only ranks 0-31 of the 64-member archive at a mean parent topness of 0.94, so the lower half of the niche archive - exactly its most topologically distant records - is never bred from; the published source's own escape route, breeding from distant niches, was deliberately not adopted here, and the one lineage test of uniform champion access lost 0.055, so any access-side variant has to be rank-aware rather than uniform. The surrogate is not implicated: within-batch prediction-to-score rank correlation was 0.526 here against 0.515 in the Parent and chronological prediction error was slightly better, so roughly half the within-batch ordering is uninformative in both arms and this node did not change it. What remains open is attribution of the score loss rather than of the mechanism: the deco_hop seed-0 departure accounts for about a third of the panel delta, the whole delta lies inside the registered path-noise band, and sitagliptin_mpo's loss on all three seeds - concentrated entirely in batches 11 to 29 while its early mass rose on two of the three - is not explained by any quantity measured here.

nodes.hypothesis: Law-free allocator-stream path divergence on the stall-masked Anchor, in the ungated exposure class. No law, probability, threshold, rule, constant, gate or mechanism changes anywhere. Inside the inherited posterior allocation, after the pool posterior covariance has been factorized on the inherited jitter ladder and immediately before the inherited correlated Thompson draw consumes its own standard-normal array, draw exactly one additional array of precisely the inherited allocation shape - (announced batch size, pool size) = (10, 160) on this Parent's own path, float64, on the selector's own device - from the selector's own seeded torch generator, the single consumer of that stream, and discard it unread; then let the unchanged allocation proceed. This happens in every announced batch of every session, regardless of the inherited stall state, and nowhere else. Its only effect is that the allocator stream is advanced by exactly one array per announced batch, so the batch that the Anchor served with its n-th array is served here with its 2n-th, and every later allocation consumes the next unused block of the same i.i.d. stream. The posterior fit and its adaptive normalization, the fitted covariance and both Cholesky factorizations with their jitter ladder, the predictive mean and its (-posterior mean, pool index) ordering, the sampled-maxima purchase rule with its per-pick mask update, the stall-conditioned eligibility mask with K=3 and M=40 and its restoration on the first improving batch, the 160-member fresh pool and its target, the Evolution's own breeding generator and every decision it drives, the seven graph operator families at unchanged weights, connected-fragment crossover at 0.45 with its finishing edit, the sulfur admission gate, the canonical identity admission path, both duplicate scopes and greedy retention all stay exactly as inherited, and no decision anywhere reads a value from the discarded array. The node therefore prices no component and adds no mechanism; it is one dependent realization of this Anchor's ungated allocator-channel departure distribution.
nodes.finding:
The construction executed exactly as declared, on the real evaluation hardware, and the one prediction the pre-run check could not test on the implementation machine is now closed. A discard receipt was written in every one of the 435 announced batches, 29 per session in all fifteen sessions, each reporting exactly one discarded array of the inherited allocation shape (ten by one hundred sixty, float64, on the selector's own GPU generator), each logged before its own batch's pool and purchase receipts; the Anchor has no such receipt anywhere, and neither run has a single fallback batch. The one-array offset is exact on hardware, not just in arithmetic: for the first fifteen batches of every session the discarded array is bit-for-bit the array the Anchor consumed one step earlier in the same stream, and for the first fourteen the array this run actually spent is bit-for-bit the Anchor's next one. That is 435 array comparisons and 696,000 float64 values with zero mismatches, including the three registered first elements reproduced in all five sessions of each seed. The Anchor published only 29 arrays per session, so batches 16 to 29 of this run consume stream positions the Anchor never reached and cannot be compared; any third draw inside the audited batches would have broken the alignment, and none did.

Every inherited law audits clean on this run's own receipts. One pool, one batch selection, ten purchases and two factorizations on the inherited jitter ladder in 435 of 435 batches; all 4,350 purchases recompute as the sequentially masked argmax of their own logged sample row with the correct per-pick mask update; the stall counter recomputed from this run's own accepted scores agrees with its logged counter in 435 of 435 batches; every restricted batch restricts to exactly the top forty of its own recomputed posterior-mean ordering and no unrestricted batch excludes anything; no purchase anywhere fell outside the eligible set; all fifteen cells spent their full 300 oracle calls on 290 accepted attempts with no invalid and no duplicate proposals, at the registered profile. At identical state the breeding side is byte-identical: in all fifteen sessions the first batch's pool of 160 molecules, its 171 to 193 breeding records, its sulfur-gate decisions, its identity admissions, its posterior means and standard deviations, its score scale and its jitters match the Anchor's, differing only in wall-clock timing fields.

The paths then part immediately and completely. The first differing scored record is evaluation 11 - the first proposal after the shared ten initial records - in all fifteen sessions, and 290 of 300 records differ in every one of them; no session reproduced the Anchor, so this is a real departure realization and not an implementation reading. Exposure drifted with the path: 81 restricted batches of 435 in 30 episodes across 13 of 15 sessions, against the Anchor's 88 in 29 episodes across 13 of 15, with the deepest single episode falling from 17 batches to 9 and the two never-restricting sessions moving from two deco_hop seeds to one deco_hop and one drd2_docking seed.

The panel came in at 0.564932 against the Anchor's 0.607030: paired seed deltas -0.083687, -0.027859 and -0.014748, a fifteen-cell mean of -0.042098, twenty-one times the 0.002 the campaign calls meaningful, with no seed improving. Seven cells rose and eight fell, but the loss is not spread out. Three cells - deco_hop seed 0 at -0.241696 and sitagliptin_mpo seeds 0 and 1 at -0.204634 and -0.163548 - carry -0.609878 of the panel's -0.631469 total, and the remaining twelve average -0.001799, below the minimum effect. Of the four protected task means, zaleplon_mpo (+0.013694) and drd2_docking (+0.003721) hold their 0.02 margins while deco_hop (-0.089564) breaches its 0.03 and sitagliptin_mpo (-0.130178) breaches its 0.02; median_2 sits at -0.008162 with a three-cell band of [-0.025315, +0.008991]. The registered single-panel rule gives this realization a cell spread of 0.084139 and a half-width of 0.043449, band [-0.085547, +0.001351]. Every orientation figure supplied with this ticket - the Anchor's three seed macros, this run's three, the paired deltas and the mean - reproduces exactly from the receipts.

Read beside this round's second ungated allocator-channel realization, the two-array arm at -0.109836, the registered two-point rule gives this Anchor its first ungated allocator-channel width: points at -0.042098 and -0.109836, a span of 0.067739 and a band of [-0.111836, -0.040098], with per-arm cell-dispersion half-widths of 0.043449 and 0.117976. The registered question was whether matching the channel would make the scale materially narrower than the breeding channel's 0.035031. It does not. By every estimator the matched channel is wider - 1.24 times wider on this arm, 3.37 times on its sibling, 1.93 times as a two-point span - and seven times the 0.009482 the identical construction produced on the mask-free Parent.

The premise that motivated this measurement is now inverted, and that is the finding. The campaign suspected that rounds 45 to 47 had been read against a scale roughly four times too wide, because the only channel-matched numbers it owned - a pair drawn on the mask-free Parent - spanned just 0.009482 against the breeding channel's 0.035031. On the Anchor itself the allocator channel is the widest channel measured anywhere on this host: a single ungated re-draw of nothing but stream position costs 0.042098, a second costs 0.109836, and the two-point span is 0.067739. The 0.009482 figure was a property of the mask-free Parent, not of the allocator stream, and it must not be carried onto this host. Arms of rounds 45 to 47 that were called losses at -0.035153, -0.053288, -0.060755 and -0.081702 all sit inside or above the range two pure-luck re-draws sweep here; only -0.126894 and -0.136643 fall below both of them. Which of those arms this band may actually price is a per-arm question of channel and exposure class that belongs to the ledger, not to this node, but the direction of the correction is unambiguous: those readings were too confident, not too conservative.

The Anchor's own +0.010577 over its mask-free Parent does not survive as a resolvable quantity. The ungated allocator-channel half-width on this host is 4.1 times that gain on this arm and 11.2 times on its sibling; the two-point span is 6.4 times it. Even the narrowest departure scale ever measured on this Anchor, the gated breeding reference at 0.023549, is 2.2 times the gain. The only width smaller than +0.010577 anywhere in the campaign is the mask-free Parent's 0.009482, which prices a different host and is inadmissible for an arm standing here. Strictly, the Anchor-versus-Parent difference is itself a cross-host quantity for which no exactly matched reference exists, so this is a bound rather than a matched reading - but the bound runs the wrong way for the restriction: the host that carries the mask is the host where pure path luck is largest.

A second pattern is now hard to ignore. Five independent law-free references have been drawn on this Anchor - two in the breeding stream, one gated and one not, one gated in the allocator stream, and the two ungated allocator points of this round - and all five landed below it, at -0.020452, -0.021233, -0.017924, -0.042098 and -0.109836. These are dependent realizations that share the Anchor's initial records and its code, so this is a direction count and not a width or a significance claim, and it must not be pooled across channel or exposure class. But five of five in one direction is what regression from a selected maximum looks like: the Anchor's 0.607030 is the realization on which it was chosen, and re-running the identical algorithm on a different stream position is expected to come in lower. Any future reading that treats the Anchor's panel as the algorithm's central value, rather than as its best observed draw, inherits that bias.

The departure is also not isotropic jitter, which matters more for planning than the panel mean does. Per objective, across the two independent ungated re-draws, zaleplon_mpo moves by +0.013694 and +0.016916 (span 0.0032) and median_2 by -0.008162 and +0.000824 (span 0.0090): those two objectives are path-stable to about 0.02 and can carry a reading. deco_hop loses 0.089564 and 0.100669 and sitagliptin_mpo loses 0.130178 and 0.163389 in both draws - consistently, not randomly - which says the Anchor's cells on exactly those two objectives are high realizations that re-drawing gives back. drd2_docking is a third regime: +0.003721 here and -0.302864 on the sibling, the whole difference being one cell.

That cell is the sharpest practical lesson in the round. The sibling arm's drd2_docking seed 2 finished at 0.0956 where every other realization of this objective lands between 0.97 and 1.00, including this arm's 0.9714, 0.999992 and 0.9935 - and it did so with its full 300 oracle calls, 290 accepted attempts, no invalid or duplicate proposals, perfect validity and an ok status. Nothing in that run's own receipts flags it; the chemistry report for that arm shows it simply never let go of the inherited sulfonamide fragment and reached the right chemistry only in its last two windows. One such cell moves a seed macro by about 0.18 and a fifteen-cell panel by about 0.06, under unchanged rules, in one channel. So a single-realization arm on this host cannot be read as evidence about a rule at any resolution finer than about a tenth of a seed macro, and quality gates - budget spent, validity, status - cannot detect the failure mode. Readings on this host need either replicate realizations, per-cell screening against the objective's known range, or a statistic that does not let one cell carry a panel.

On median_2 the two apparently conflicting readings are both correct and belong to different levels of description, which this arm can settle from its own receipts. At family level the chemistry is reproduced: both arms converge on a 2-alkylquinoline attached to an N-methyl glycine-anhydride ring and both stall at the same 0.21 to 0.24 ceiling. At graph level nothing is shared: among this arm's top twenty-five molecules there are 14 to 16 distinct Murcko scaffolds per seed, the Anchor has 7 to 16, and the overlap is zero on every seed - exactly what the gated sibling found - while the cells still land within 0.0261. The pair establishes that median_2's top is a scaffold-degenerate plateau: many different ring systems inside one chemotype family reach the same score, so the objective's endpoint is fixed by the family the method can reach and is almost blind to which graph it ends on. As a discriminator of allocation rules at 300 calls median_2 will agree with almost anything, and a narrow median_2 band is evidence about the objective, not about the arm.

On the method itself, this arm independently reproduces two inherited limitations the gated sibling identified, which matters because reproducing them on a completely different path shows they are properties of the method rather than of a lucky run. First, the surrogate ranks worst in exactly the regime where the stall reflex makes it decisive: within-batch agreement between predicted and realized scores is 0.385 over this run's 81 restricted batches against 0.559 over its 354 unrestricted ones (the Anchor: 0.392 against 0.547), and the narrowing is not inert, since 71 of 81 restricted batches buy a different set than a full-mask replay of the same drawn rows would. No value of the trigger or the mask size repairs a ranking that is least trustworthy where it is most used; the class of change that could is a different ranking model - one fitted to order candidates rather than to regress their scores, or one that prices its own disagreement - or a stall response that changes where proposals come from instead of narrowing allocation over the same surrogate. Second, search is scaffold-selection variance dressed as optimization: distinct Murcko scaffolds per hundred proposals fall from 47.1 early to 39.6 late (Anchor 54.1 to 36.1), 26.9 per cent of each session's final hundred proposals sit on the final best molecule's own scaffold, 691 of 870 proposals on one objective still carry the indole of a single initial molecule, and eleven molecules tie at exactly 0.645074 on one deco_hop seed. The chemistry report names the same thing from the molecular side: the generator can decorate a core but cannot hop to a new one, so which family a run ends on is decided early and by chance. That is the mechanism behind the two loss-carrying objectives here - the two tasks whose scaffold family the path chose are precisely the two that moved - and the class of change that addresses it is a proposal operator with skeleton-level moves (ring-system exchange, bioisosteric core swap, fragment-level recombination late in the budget), not a reweighting of the seven existing single-atom edits.

What stays open. This is one dependent realization and the two-point rule rests on exactly two points, so the width is crude and supports no significance statement; the sibling arm that supplies the second point had not been published as a node when this report was written, so Curate should re-confirm the span from its record before the band is used. Whether the stall-conditioned eligibility restriction contributes anything on this host remains unanswered, and this node leaves the catalog's open evidence gap on it exactly as it found it. And the band measured here reads only ungated arms that depart through the allocator stream on this Anchor: an arm confined to restricted batches needs the gated point, an arm that changes the posterior and the stream together still has no matched reference in either channel, and nothing here may be pooled across channel, exposure class or host.

nodes.hypothesis: Change only the active-tree root lifecycle: preserve the initial forest until a complete observe boundary strictly improves the global accepted incumbent and budget remains; then discard the old active tree and instantiate a fresh single-root tree at the earliest accepted receipt attaining the new maximum. Reuse that receipt once as root context, without a new evaluation or inherited path visits. Subsequent search uses the same direct-frontier and sibling best-return controller on the new origin. This is the frozen obstacle intervention on access to discovered states, not another rollout-horizon adjustment or a root-mean consumer combination.
nodes.finding:
All 15 Search sessions completed. The 114 eligible improvements produced exactly 114 fresh roots, with no transferred visits or extra billed labels. Every root received a novel accepted descendant at the next announcement, compared with 44 of 60 opportunities in the Parent; the median first-descendant delay fell from two announcements to one. Unique descendants that created a new global incumbent rose from 17 to 134 out of 4,350 paid proposals. Full gain per proposal rose from 0.0004814 to 0.0010035, and late gain per proposal from 0.0005054 to 0.0006287. Thus both access and useful refinement passed their registered tests. Mean final score rose from 0.348101 to 0.499496, a gain of 0.151395, with 13 improved cells, one unchanged cell and one small loss. All three seed means improved. The formal Anchor remains higher at 0.607030, leaving a mean gap of 0.107534. The one session with no improvement kept its initial forest throughout.

The missing access to newly discovered incumbents was a useful obstacle to address on this tree: the result goes beyond mechanically enlarging descendant ancestry because actual new-incumbent receipts and full and late gain rates also increased. The adopted solution-to-new-root element operated successfully in its molecular adaptation; it does not validate the source paper’s scheduling, backup or width changes. The experiment prices the complete lifecycle change, so it cannot separate improved access from erased statistics, reset depth or removed root competition. Discarding 2,779 occurrence occupancies, including 240 root occupancies, did not prevent this matched Parent gain, but the rewards of abandoned branches remain unknown.

The search still shows local proposal limitations. Full and late fragment-excluded similarity increased from 0.2985/0.3214 to 0.3888/0.4332, while panel-wide typed scaffold coverage grew; this is more concentrated local refinement, not uniform scaffold collapse. All three zaleplon sessions had no late gain. In one of them, 6,621 internal invalid actions occurred after the last improvement, including 6,618 from single-atom halogen branches; 6,463 were crossover attempts. The unchanged generator can therefore spend substantial effort on structural dead ends despite successful incumbent reuse. Molecules below six heavy atoms barely changed (432 to 425), while those above fifty rose from 165 to 301. The Molecular assessment finds useful ring, amine and carbonyl arrangements but inconsistent preservation of those relationships through edits and grafts. Proposal operators that preserve informative ring and functional-group arrangements, or search schemes that retain alternative productive origins, are plausible ways to address these observed limitations; their benefit remains untested. The evidence establishes this intervention’s useful contribution under the matched conditions while leaving the gap to the stronger Anchor and broader transfer open.

nodes.hypothesis: Make the ordinary single-parent requested mutation-call law state-conditioned instead of constant. Keep one integer counter of consecutive non-improving announced batches, defined only on this session's own accepted scores: after the ten initial records, an announced batch of ten is improving when at least one of its accepted members raises the session best-so-far above the value held when that batch was announced, otherwise non-improving; the counter increments on a non-improving batch and resets to zero on any improving batch. While that counter is at or above the bound threshold K=3, and only at saturation floor one, the ordinary route draws its requested length from rng.choices([1, 2, 3], [0.50, 0.35, 0.15]) instead of the inherited rng.choices([1, 2, 3], [0.82, 0.15, 0.03]), using exactly one active draw in its inherited stream position; the inherited law is restored for the generation of the first announced batch after an improving batch. Nominal optional-call share inside the regime rises 0.18 to 0.50 and nominal requested mean 1.21 to 1.65; on the same uniform draw the changed-length intervals have total probability 0.44 and expected added requested calls 0.44 per exposed floor-one attempt. Whenever min(6, 1 + member_attempts // 80) exceeds one, the ORIGINAL [0.82, 0.15, 0.03] base draw and the original max(base, floor) schedule apply unchanged, so the rejection-conditioned escalation identity is untouched. Per-call internal retries, break-on-failed-mutate, single final-only admission, the original scored generating-parent references and the sulfur gate, crossover and its finishing mutation, parent sampling, survivors, pool refill, the count-fingerprint GP and the correlated Thompson allocation with its exact draw count and order all stay exactly as inherited.
nodes.finding:
The switch behaved exactly as registered. Thirteen of fifteen sessions stalled long enough to trigger it: 33 stall episodes covering 96 of 435 announced batches, close to the Anchor's 29 episodes and 91 batches. Inside those batches the single-parent walk asked for more than one edit in 49.8% of attempts instead of 17.5% on the same random draws. Its mean request rose from 1.21 to 1.64 edits, and because no edit ever failed, every extra request became an executed edit. Outside the stall the requests matched the old law exactly. The two sessions that never stalled (deco_hop seeds 0 and 2) reproduced the Anchor's 300 records exactly. Every other session first diverged from the Anchor at the first stalled batch, never earlier. The saturation floor never rose above one, so the separate failure-driven escalation was never exercised.

The longer walks did travel further, but only modestly at the level of what got scored. The posterior allocator picked lengthened-walk products at about a third the rate of single-edit products (3.4% versus 10.4% of pooled candidates), so only 133 of 3,952 lengthened products were evaluated. Those 133 moved well away from their parent: median fingerprint distance 35 versus 20, and the scaffold changed in 74% versus 52%. Yet their median heavy-atom change was still one atom. Spread across all 608 scored single-parent products made in stalled batches, the median fingerprint distance rose only from 20 to 22 (mean 24.7, against 22.0 in the Anchor's own stalled batches), and heavy-atom change stayed at a median of one.

Stall episodes paid off somewhat better than the Anchor's. They ended after 2.94 batches on average instead of 3.20, only 2 ran to the end of the budget instead of 4, and together they produced 0.600 of best-score gain against 0.477. Gain over the best parent was 2.13 versus 1.64. The gain per exit, however, was unchanged (+0.0194 versus +0.0191). Of the 0.600, the longer-walk products themselves supplied only 0.052; crossover supplied 0.348 and ordinary single edits 0.193.

On the score, the complete matched panel averaged 0.6041 against 0.5965, a gain of +0.0076 that clears the registered +0.002 bar. Eight cells rose, five fell, and the two unstalled cells were identical. Seed macros moved -0.0082, +0.0183 and +0.0128, and seed-to-seed spread narrowed (population SD 0.023 versus 0.034). The gain comes entirely from sitagliptin_mpo (+0.019, +0.082 and +0.057; task mean +0.053). The other twelve cells average -0.0036, with zaleplon_mpo down 0.010 on average, and dropping the single best cell leaves only +0.0023.

The gate itself is the most transferable lesson. Because the Anchor's exact policy runs until a session has gone three batches without a new best, sessions that never stall keep their Anchor endpoints exactly. That includes the deco_hop seed-0 result of 0.856, which all 28 earlier complete-panel children of this Anchor lost by 0.22 to 0.28. A state-gated change therefore cannot lose ground in sessions where the search keeps improving, whereas every one of those earlier children gave up about 0.016 of panel mean in that one cell alone. That is a reason to prefer gated designs for any further generator intervention on this Anchor.

The longer-walk channel itself is only weakly supported. Longer executed walks are certain. Larger structural steps show up only in fingerprint space, not in molecule size. The allocator screens most lengthened products out, and the molecular review finds that the ones it does score often dismantle what the first edit built: 21 of 133 lose an aromatic ring and only 16 of 133 beat their parent. The extra in-stall gain was carried mainly by crossover and single edits on trajectories that had already diverged, and it is concentrated in one objective. There the molecular review ties the gain to piling fluorine onto compact fused cores, with oxygen-halogen bonds rising from 82 to 288 molecules, rather than to bigger single-parent jumps. No lengthened product raised the sitagliptin best directly, though one +0.068 step came from a direct child of one. So the campaign can now say that spending extra walk length only during measured stalls does no harm and, under these exact conditions, came with a small panel gain. It cannot say the longer walks caused that gain rather than the changed history that follows the first lengthened walk.

By its registration, this one exposed panel ends the schedule recipe: no probability, threshold or length sweep follows from it. What stays open is attribution. Would a gain confined to one objective, and only +0.0023 without its best cell, survive independent replication of the same code? Do lengthened products contribute anything beyond restarting the trajectory? The allocator's threefold down-selection of lengthened products also suggests that walk length is not the binding constraint while the count-fingerprint posterior filters out long jumps. The pending same-trigger siblings that change allocator uncertainty weight and pool breadth test that more directly.

nodes.hypothesis: Choose the fingerprint Gaussian process's standardized observation-noise standard deviation at each fit by minimum exact negative log marginal likelihood over five fixed multiples of the inherited noise level, using only the current accepted archive.
nodes.finding:
The learned noise reached the actual posterior in 255 of 435 fits; 180 retained the reference level and 116 selected the largest allowed value. All five likelihood trials, final conditioning, accepted-label provenance and recorded posterior draws reconstructed correctly. After feedback, mean uncertainty on the admitted molecules remained 0.02821 score units, compared with 0.00405 under the fixed-noise rule on those same current archives.

On the 4,350 molecules actually submitted, the matched fixed-noise comparison shows latent 1.96-SD coverage rising from 79.68% to 82.44%. Including fitted observation noise raises observed-score coverage from 79.72% to 89.84%, with average interval width increasing from 0.1901 to 0.2604. Mean predictive negative log density improves from 6.3965 to 1.9102, and prediction MSE falls from 0.012180 to 0.011625 against an archive-mean baseline of 0.024654. Within-batch rank association weakens from 0.4146 to 0.3943. These are comparisons on identical accepted data and actual emissions.

Search utility declines: mean final-best score falls from 0.551771 to 0.534231, a paired loss of 0.017540 that misses the registered +0.002 benefit criterion. One seed improves and two decline; population standard deviation rises from 0.008223 to 0.023491. DRD2 and zaleplon task means fall, sitagliptin rises, and decoration and median retain exactly the same trajectories in every seed. Actual best-parent beats are essentially unchanged at 592 versus 593. All tasks and pools complete, with no numerical fallback; the additional 2,175 noise-trial factorizations consume 3.745 seconds of recorded unsynchronized host search time.

Archive likelihood can identify and propagate substantial surrogate mismatch without improving the search endpoint. The matched measurements show better average coverage and predictive loss, but wider intervals still cover fewer than the nominal 95% of observed scores, and ranking gets weaker. Better uncertainty accounting is therefore insufficient evidence that the unchanged posterior-draw selector allocates evaluations more productively. The unchanged decoration and median trajectories also show that a measurable posterior change need not alter an emitted choice.

The remaining uncertainty problem includes score scaling. In an early sitagliptin batch, even the maximum standardized noise is multiplied by an archive scale of 0.001: a predicted mean of 0.00111 and total SD of 0.00118 precede a score of 0.18595, more than 157 SDs away. This narrows the next modeling question toward anticipating score-unit changes from a nearly flat accepted archive; expanding the menu alone is not established as a remedy. Frequent upper-endpoint selection leaves the appropriate noise range unresolved, while unchanged binary-fingerprint ties leave representational limitations intact.

The chemistry assessment also finds the existing structural liabilities intact, including unusually large repeated scaffolds, reactive heteroatom bonds, undefined stereochemistry and a new sulfur-radical branch. These observations limit what improved statistical coverage or occasional high scores mean chemically; they do not identify the cause of the aggregate score loss. The evidence establishes noise-learning activation and a failed score-benefit expectation on this panel, without isolating the causal value of any individual changed selection.

nodes.hypothesis: Retain the Parent's local Morgan occurrence-count covariance and add sparse topological atom-pair occurrence-count covariance, using the fixed equal-weight average of their separate generalized Tanimoto kernels for every GP block while preserving raw-score learning and the inherited search rules.
nodes.finding:
All 435 batches changed their raw posterior means, uncertainties and conditional covariance. Against the same-input local-only reference, 432 selected sets and 433 orders changed; three sets and two orders remained unchanged. All six distinct local-count alias pairs split, but none had both members scored. All three matched replicas completed. Mean final score fell from 0.595670 to 0.562261, a loss of 0.033408 against the required gain of 0.002. Seed deltas were −0.072325, +0.009185 and −0.037084. Six of fifteen task/seed endpoints improved: all three zaleplon results and the seed-1 deco_hop, drd2 and sitagliptin results. Every median_2 result declined. Seed dispersion decreased from 0.026593 to 0.006995 around the lower mean. The mechanism ran correctly; its registered endpoint-benefit prediction was falsified.

More descriptor distinctions and better predictions on selected molecules did not yield better endpoint search in this fixed mixture. On the actual accepted stream, raw MSE improved from 0.009475 for the passive local model to 0.009335, and mean batch ordering correlation rose from 0.545819 to 0.571243, despite the endpoint loss. These improvements were uneven: MSE worsened in seven task/seed cells, including all median_2 cells. Ordinary similarity and regularization changes were broadly exposed, whereas alias-mediated benefit was not: ten members of five split pool pairs remained unscored, and only one member of the cross pair was evaluated. Thirteen other pairs shared atom-pair counts but remained distinguishable through local counts; the channels still do not establish complete molecular identity. The negative result belongs to this one equal-weight composition and does not undo the earlier evidence for retaining local occurrence counts or isolate atom-pair information from mixture weighting. Molecular evidence still shows reactive heteroatom-halogen and sulfur motifs, large linked assemblies and destructive fragments alongside conventional high-scoring chemistry. Added topological information does not enforce chemical feasibility, and neither a universal size explanation nor an alias-resolution explanation is established.

nodes.hypothesis: Rank real task-local molecular observations into positive and negative examples, build fresh categorical regions by randomly fixing a positive exemplar's SELFIES-frame coordinates until every observed negative frame is excluded and the remaining free-coordinate count is bounded, then sample uniform token assignments inside those regions with a broader uniform construction-space component.
nodes.finding:
All five objectives completed on the screening seed, with 300 evaluations each and all 1,450 generated submissions accepted. Every initial molecule preserved its identity through token encoding, every returned score stayed attached to its actual sampled frame, and all 150 rank-label snapshots included the required cutoff ties. All 1,355 constructed regions retained their positive exemplar and reduced the number of included observed negatives to zero, while leaving exactly four of 79 token positions free. Real feedback was reused: all 1,400 generated observations with a later opportunity participated in subsequent region construction. However, the final restrictions in every region were identical to those obtained from the four-free-coordinate limit alone.

The five-task final Top-1 mean was 0.315539, compared with 0.208492 for the supplied initial observations. Initial-to-final Top-1 scores were 0.305105 to 0.345581 for zaleplon_mpo, 0.548381 to 0.579123 for deco_hop, 0.019041 to 0.120104 for drd2_docking, 0.167839 to 0.167839 for median_2, and 0.002094 to 0.365051 for sitagliptin_mpo. All 18 incumbent improvements came from regional submissions. Only 67 of 1,304 accepted regional proposals (5.14%) beat their selected exemplar; mean child-minus-exemplar score was -0.096376. There is no Parent comparison or additional seed in this root experiment, so these within-run gains do not establish a comparative score advantage.

Negative examples were consulted and newly admitted negatives prolonged the exclusion phase in 330 regions, so the classifier was active. Yet exclusion always finished after at most 70 fixed coordinates, while the uncertainty limit required 75. The limit therefore determined every final mask, and perfect exclusion supplies no evidence for an additional contribution of negative labels to proposal geometry or score. The observed procedure supports direct molecular score provenance and feedback-guided sampling around positively ranked exemplars; whether making negatives influence the final region improves search remains open.

Distinct token restrictions also did not imply distinct molecular neighborhoods: 48 raw decodes overlapped an earlier different region, and ten draws recovered a currently negative molecular identity through another encoding. Filtering caught these cases, but it cannot repair weak molecular geometry. The molecular assessment finds frequent radicals, unusual charges and reactive linkages among high scorers, with only an uneven subset of conventional scaffold chemistry. Together with the low exemplar-beating rate and the unchanged median_2 incumbent, this identifies useful, chemically credible token neighborhoods as an unresolved bottleneck. Neither reliable performance across seeds nor a benefit from alternative serialization views is established.

nodes.hypothesis: Replace dot-product count Tanimoto covariance with fixed Matérn-3/2 covariance on L2-normalized unchanged folded Morgan count rows: z(x)=x/||x||2 for nonzero x and z(0)=0; r=||z(x)-z(y)||2; K(x,y)=(1+sqrt(3)*r)*exp(-sqrt(3)*r), with lengthscale one and unit amplitude.
nodes.finding:
The replacement changed 434 of 435 accepted candidate sets and 435 selection orders when compared with the original predictor on exactly the same pools, earlier observations and random draws. All 4,350 Child offspring reached real feedback with their original pre-label predictions; no formal numerical fallback or rejection occurred. On those actual Child selections, unequal-label pair-order accuracy was 0.646947, versus 0.731356 for passive original predictions; average defined within-batch Spearman was 0.380506, versus 0.579077. Raw-unit selected-stream MSE was 0.012160, versus 0.007080 for the passive original and 0.032088 for the archive mean. The actual Parent stream had pair accuracy 0.711063, Spearman 0.532208 and MSE 0.012718; those adaptive streams differ after the first batch. Strict best-generating-parent beats increased from 629 to 682, and sequential incumbent advances from 258 to 269. Batch-frozen incumbent beats were 373 versus 346. Despite those local events, mean final Top-1 fell from 0.595669649733 to 0.568161409345, a signed change of -0.027508240389. Seed macro changes were -0.062538302981, +0.001846540890, -0.021832959074; 4 of 15 task/seed endpoints improved. Population seed dispersion was 0.007592488960 versus 0.026592870628. The complete +0.002 gain criterion failed.

The failure is informative because the new predictor had real allocation exposure, complete accepted feedback and intact numerical controls: an inactive implementation or unseen changed choices cannot explain the negative endpoint result. More parent-beating offspring and incumbent events did not translate into better final best molecules. Average best-generating-parent score fell from 0.470456 to 0.416185, and offspring score from 0.385256 to 0.338080: beating weaker sources more often is not independent evidence of stronger exploration. The original predictor also ranks the very same scored Child selections better, narrowing the predictive hypothesis without requiring unscored pool labels. Local event counts and selected-stream errors cannot stand in for the benchmark objective. Normalizing count rows deliberately loses overall count scale and introduces proportional-coordinate aliases by construction, although no proportional-only pairs or zero rows were naturally exposed in this panel; those effects belong to the complete tested covariance recipe and were not separately randomized or attributed. Productive-event reuse, later conditioning and descendant cores remain conditional associations with overlapping ancestry and censored final-batch sources. The chemistry assessment also shows familiar useful carbonyl/aromatic and amine frameworks alongside reactive heteroatom-halogen arrangements, unresolved stereochemistry and occasional large elaborations; compact leaders and useful deletions show that blanket growth, fluorination or fragmentation rules are not justified. No evidence identifies that chemistry as a mediated consequence of covariance geometry. End this exact exposed complete law under the registered rule. A future materially different law needs a sourced distinguishing hypothesis; transferable kernel-family benefit and independent plausible descendant coverage remain open.

nodes.hypothesis: Offer direct transfer of a ketone carbonyl oxygen to an adjacent methylene as an alternative within change_bond, preserving molecular formula, the carbon skeleton and ketone class while exposing a new carbonyl position to the inherited fresh-pool selector.
nodes.finding:
The oxygen-position mechanism happened. All 70 executed shifts retained the molecular formula, carbon skeleton and ketone class and produced a different, stable molecular identity. Forty-eight pool entries retained the exact immediate shifted graph, covering 39 distinct identities. Four reached evaluation as sole changes to accepted scored molecules: a DRD2 transfer improved its source by 0.003265, a median_2 transfer lost 0.003475, and two ring transfers tied. A fifth evaluated history included an additional atom replacement and lost 0.002890 against its generating parent. All five entered the survivor population; none improved the incumbent.

Every generated pool and batch was full, but deco_hop in seed 2 timed out after 240 of 300 evaluations, leaving 14 of 15 task sessions complete. The two complete seed macros average 0.553584 versus their matched parent's 0.553199, a paired gain of only 0.000385, with one seed lower and one higher. This is below the registered 0.002 target on the available complete seeds; the full three-seed effect cannot be evaluated. The parent completed the entire panel. The changed whole-search chemistry still contains reactive bonds, large repeated assemblies and unspecified stereochemistry.

A ketone can move within these observed ring and acyclic carbon frameworks without destroying its class or changing the molecule's composition. That establishes a usable positional neighborhood, while the direct score results show that utility depends on the particular position and molecular family. Exposure is narrow: only 140 of 7,723 bond-change calls had an eligible source, and only four of 4,290 scored proposals isolate the transfer itself. The available evidence therefore supports access to this neighborhood more strongly than a reliable optimization benefit.

The largest whole-search improvement, a 0.083867 gain in one sitagliptin run, occurred with no selected ketone transfer at all. Two eligible calls instead chose the original bond-order mode, changing subsequent random consumption. This rules out interpreting that gain as an observed benefit of the shifted oxygen; selected molecules and later search history changed together. The four direct comparisons are the evidence for local positional utility. Their unchanged composition also explains why they do not establish repair of the chemical liabilities identified by the molecular assessment. Broader useful exposure, consistent improvement and completion of the full score panel remain open.

nodes.hypothesis: Completed-feedback progressive widening on the inherited sibling-kernel tree: for an ordinary graph occurrence v, authorize another normal child iff child_count(v) < max(1,floor(1.5*(N_v+1)^0.5)), with N_v counting only actual completed returns, including the supplied root receipt at initial roots. Replace the Parent N_v+O_v input only at this consumer. Pending O and sibling pending density P retain their inherited exploration and reservation roles; they never become rewards. Thus a newly started, unobserved terminal cannot itself grant a new sibling. Narrower branching should concentrate later real returns on existing occurrences; whether this improves useful search remains a separate prediction.
nodes.finding:
All fifteen Search sessions completed. The new law suppressed 1,993 pending-only expansion permissions across 11,194 ordinary decisions, including 1,316 at occurrences with no completed return. Every audited width, route-credit ledger and sibling-selector calculation matched its registered rule. The final fraction of nonroot occurrences with at least two real returns increased from 2,440/13,049 (18.70%) to 3,175/13,024 (24.38%), and repeated-prefix terminal feedback rose slightly from 3,298/4,350 to 3,316/4,350. These activation and repetition predictions hold. Useful conversion fails: incumbent gain per optimizer evaluation fell from 0.0003555903 to 0.0003047999, and late-half gain fell from 0.735300 over twelve improvements to 0.428153 over seven. Mean final Top1 fell from 0.3116133 to 0.2968841, a paired change of −0.0147292 against the registered +0.002 target. Seed-macro changes were +0.0530795, +0.0066911 and −0.1039583. Three task means rose, median_2 stayed at its initial best, and docking fell in every seed, with mean loss 0.230566. The Child remains 0.310146 below the separate formal Anchor mean of 0.6070303. Frozen task-safety margins were not supplied, so a formal safety verdict is unavailable; every signed task/seed difference and its dispersion is retained.

Removing permission from pending work really does redirect visits, but the additional repetition is largely within a batch: repeated nonroot updates with earlier-batch support fell from 5,408 to 4,979, while updates sharing an earlier receipt from the same batch rose from 876 to 2,383. These categories overlap when a prefix has both kinds of history. Terminals supported by any earlier-batch return fell from 3,090 to 3,037. Thus a larger final repeated-occurrence fraction does not establish more rounds of adaptive learning. The tree also went deeper: maximum generated depth rose from seven to the fixed cap of twelve, with fourteen failed normal routes but no stored or emergency fallback. Most nonroot occurrences still had only one return (9,753 of 13,024), and retaining the inherited fresh rollouts kept total nonroot creation almost unchanged.

The molecular evidence shows broad scaffold coverage, not scaffold collapse: generic scaffold coverage stayed at 1,832 and typed coverage changed from 2,481 to 2,451. Both size tails increased, from 469 to 502 tiny proposals and from 450 to 475 proposals above fifty heavy atoms. Together with the unchanged initial optimum in all median_2 sessions and the lost higher docking observations, this points to a limitation in preserving useful connected arrangements while proposing new edits. Proposal operators or a search scheme that preserve and refine promising molecular arrangements could address that limitation; simply concentrating additional returns on prefixes did not do so here. The literature-derived completed/pending distinction and visit-dependent action growth operated, but their published domains supply no molecular performance guarantee. This result settles the registered conversion prediction for this particular widening law and controller composition. It leaves open whether a different proposal or selection mechanism can use persistent trajectory feedback effectively; it does not undo the Parent’s established sibling-sharing activation or decide the future of the wider approach.
